description:
**About Us**
 There’s a reason HUNTER is recognized as a PRWeek Best Place To Work and has been named PRovoke “Consumer Agency of the Year” not once, but twice: At HUNTER, we EARN IT — consumer attention, the trust and loyalty of clients, and the dedication of our staff, currently 350\+ strong and counting.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Creative Director is a proven creative leader who consistently develops disruptive, culture\-shaping ideas that cut through and drive earned\-worthy moments for clients. Leading an integrated Art and Copy team, you bring both conceptual rigor and the self\-editing skills to shape campaigns with minimal oversight. You thrive as a hands\-on creative, formulating bold ideas on brief, directing executions, and presenting directly to clients with confidence and clarity. As an emerging leader, you mentor and elevate your team while demonstrating the creative maturity and strategic thinking that positions you as the next generation of creative leadership at HUNTER.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Creative Leadership \& Idea Development**
* Lead and own creative work across assigned accounts, consistently and independently generating a high volume of original, disruptive ideas grounded in strategy and on brief
* Develop compelling creative concepts that align with HUNTER client objectives and measurable KPIs; demonstrate strong self\-editing skills to shape ideas into award\-worthy, culture\-disrupting campaigns
* Translate complex briefs and strategy into clear creative direction; understand and appreciate the importance of strategy and ensure all ideas ladder to client business objectives
* Lead creative concepting, brainstorms, and strategy sessions with energy and conviction, fostering bold thinking and pushing boundaries within strategic intent
* Concept and direct across disciplines; developing storyboards, comps, copy, and integrated executions that showcase creative excellence
* Deliver compelling pitch presentations and new business concepts; serve as a confident external\-facing creative voice for HUNTER when needed
* Review all work with ECD and Sr. Integrated Creative Director to ensure alignment and creative excellence before presenting to internal account and client teams
* Lead the charge for Creative Exploration across the agency by leading Creative Competitions, hack\-a\-thons and open calls for ideas to help get the best creative thinking available in the agency.


**Creative Direction \& Execution**
* Establish strong visual \& copy direction and creative standards for assigned work, guiding Art Directors, Copywriters, Designers and Producers toward executions that match creative intent
* Demonstrate strong conceptual design thinking and creative strategy skills; collaborate with design, experiential and production teams to ensure visual storytelling is compelling and on brand
* Demonstrate strong conceptual writing skills paired with strategic thinking; ability to articulate ideas with precision and clarity
* Provide precise, actionable feedback that elevates creative work across ideation, design, and visual execution
* Ensure executions are delivered on time and on budget, with quality matching or exceeding creative vision
* Work seamlessly with Creative Production Leads to handle all production and post\-production across design, video, and experiences
* Support the integration of emerging tools and AI into creative workflows, leveraging technology to enhance ideation and execution without compromising craft


**Team Leadership \& Mentorship**
* Lead, inspire, and mentor an integrated Art and Copy team, setting clear expectations and providing regular coaching, feedback, and professional development support
* Mentor Copywriters, Art Directors and Designers at various levels, elevating their thinking, strengthening their craft, and growing the next generation of creative leaders
* Model creative leadership through clear direction, decisive creative judgment, strong taste, and empowerment of individual contributors
* Foster a collaborative team culture where bold ideas are encouraged, feedback is constructive and respectful, and exceptional work is celebrated
* Conduct project\-based performance feedback and contribute to formal performance review processes; support career development and growth
* Demonstrate maturity in navigating challenging client situations, finding creative opportunities even within difficult constraints
* Collaborate with flexibility and confidence to build account team and client trust and ensure satisfaction while maintaining HUNTER's creative standards
* Identify growth opportunities with existing clients; support account expansion through strong creative work and strategic thinking


**New Business \& Agency Growth**
* Support HUNTER’s new business initiatives by developing concepting and pitch presentations that showcase HUNTER's creative capabilities
* Bring thoughtful, fresh, and strategic ideas to new business opportunities; demonstrate the energy and enthusiasm that wins pitches
* Contribute to agency marketing and thought leadership by sharing strong work and participating in industry conversations


**Budgeting and Finance**
* Track team members hours/rates and OOP costs against budget and work with the ECD to manage billability and useability across the team
* Establish a clear line of communication with account teams, ECD and COO with respect to scoping and pricing models for all projects
* Work with account/HR/Finance team on all vendor agreements, ensuring competitive bids are met and costs are appropriate for the size and scale of the project
* Manage all vendor contracts, and insurance (both freelance and production vendor)


**Qualifications**
* 6\-10\+ years of creative leadership, with proven success leading multidisciplinary teams in integrated marketing, brand experiences, or communications
* Exceptional portfolio demonstrating conceptual strength, visual storytelling, and integrated campaign execution
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute innovative campaigns that drive engagement and measurable results
* Record of winning new business and expanding existing client relationships


**Leadership \& People Skills**
* Ability to mentor, coach, and develop creative talent; model strong leadership through clear direction, constructive feedback, and empowerment
* Proven experience managing and inspiring cross\-functional teams across design, content strategy, production, and account management
* Strong communication and presentation skills; confidence when presenting to clients, stakeholders, and executive leadership
* Sharp collaboration and active listening skills, with the ability to align teams and stakeholders around shared vision


**Strategic \& Operational Mindset**
* Strong strategic thinking: ability to dissect briefs, uncover insights, and translate business objectives into compelling creative solutions
* Hands\-on expertise overseeing multiple complex projects at various stages while maintaining high\-level strategic oversight
* Experience managing budgets, resources, and freelance partnerships; commitment to executing projects efficiently and profitably
* Comfort working in fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environments
* A good understanding of working with vendors, materials costs, freelance costs, printing and pricing and the ability to reach agreements that are fair and/or favorable to the agency


**Cultural \& Technical Awareness**
* Cultural curiosity and awareness; ability to create ideas that resonate with diverse audiences and communities
* Knowledge of design, production, emerging technologies, and their application to earned, marketing and experiential work
* Strong understanding of social media and digital integration; ability to amplify activations through strategic content and storytelling
* Genuine interest in AI, automation, and emerging tools; eagerness to explore and implement technologies that strengthen creative output


**Compensation**
 In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, the Company believes the target range of base compensation for this role is $150,000 \- $175,000\. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.
   

  

 At HUNTER, we work hard and play hard, and while we have all the benefits you’d expect —competitive health and dental insurance plans, a 401K company match and generous PTO — we also provide:
   

  

* a hybrid work model;
* a “work from anywhere in the US” policy (up to four weeks a year);
* a year\-round staff training and development curriculum; and
* a staff\-led Action Group dedicated to DEI excellence in the agency and industry (read our DEI statement here: https://hunterpr.com/dei/ )


 Perks? We have perks. When you work at HUNTER, you can expect Bring Your Parents (And Kids) to Work Days, regular volunteer Days of Service, mid\-day Cupcakes and Cocktails mixers and epic Halloween and holiday parties.
   

  

 Founded in 1989, HUNTER has grown into one of the most respected mid\-size marketing communications firms in the country, creating work that matters in strategic planning, earned media relations, social and digital media, talent and influencer engagement, experiential marketing, multicultural outreach and content creation and distribution. And we do it all for esteemed companies and brands across every sector you can imagine:
   

  

* Food \+ Beverage
* Wine \+ Spirits
* Health \+ Wellness
* Beauty \+ Personal Care \+ Fashion
* Home \+ Lifestyle \+ Travel
* Retail \+ E\-commerce


 See us in action here: https://hunterpr.com

title: Creative Director
description:
**The Problem**
 Flock's creative group is expanding as the company raises its standard of visual storytelling and campaign execution across brand, film, and digital experiences. This momentum creates a need for unified creative leadership to turn complex technology and public safety outcomes into compelling, human\-centered narratives. You will own that direction, driving the creative concept, visual identity, and craft bar across design, film, and motion.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Direct integrated campaigns, product launch narratives, and flagship brand films from initial concept through final delivery.
* Define and maintain the visual, cinematic, and editorial standards across design, motion, and video production to build a recognizable creative signature.
* Lead and mentor multidisciplinary craft teams, guiding discipline leads in art direction, storytelling, and creative critique.
* Establish operational systems, including reference libraries, templates, and production guidelines, that elevate quality while improving delivery speed.
* Partner with brand strategy and production leadership to translate executive goals into clear creative briefs and execution plans.


**What This Role Is Not**
* This is not a hands\-off review role, you will actively shape concepts, guide edits, direct art execution, and refine details across all mediums.
* This isn't a high\-volume template production management job, your main focus is establishing concept quality and narrative depth.
* This is not an isolated brand strategy position, you will work directly alongside production and cross\-functional teams to ship live campaigns.


**What You Bring**
* Proven track record leading multidisciplinary creative teams across art direction, design, motion, and cinematic film production.
* Deep portfolio demonstrating high\-craft visual design alongside narrative documentary or high\-paced commercial storytelling.
* Advanced fluency in the complete production lifecycle, including typography, editing pace, color grading, sound design, and finishing standards.
* Experience setting practical brand guidelines, design systems, and creative review frameworks for internal teams and agency partners.
* Ability to direct campaigns that balance emotional human narrative with clear technical product messaging.


**Compensation**
 In this role, you'll receive a starting salary between $200,000 and $250,000 as well as Flock Stock Options. Base salary is determined by job\-related experience, education/training, as well as market indicators. Your recruiter will discuss this in depth with you during our first chat.
   

  

 Why Flock 💚
   

  

 Every community deserves to be safe. Flock builds the technology that makes that real: last year we supported over 1 million criminal investigations and helped locate more than 10,000 missing people. We're 1,700 people building the impossible with over $1B in funding, and the expectations are high on purpose. If you want a role where the stakes are real and the pace matches, this is it.
   

  

 📍Some problems get solved faster in the same room, so we prioritize candidates in Atlanta and Boston. Hub\-based roles mean real in\-person time with your coworkers. Remote roles exist, and when a posting is open to remote work, it says so.
   

  

 🌟 The impossible takes every kind of mind. Flock is an equal opportunity employer, and we know the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, experiences, and skills working together with mutual respect. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, email recruiting@flocksafety.com; your information stays confidential and is used only to arrange the right accommodation for your interviews.
   

  

 💰 On compensation. We pay fairly for the work. Base salary is determined by job\-related experience, education, training, and market indicators. The range in this posting covers base salary only and doesn't include equity, sales bonus plans where applicable, or benefits. The range may be adjusted over time, and this posting may span more than one career level.
   

  

 📣 One last thing. All legitimate communication from Flock comes from an email ending in @flocksafety.com or noreply@ashbyhq.com. We never make offers through messaging apps or third parties, and we never request payment or sensitive personal information during hiring. If you encounter suspicious outreach about a Flock role, report it to recruiting@flocksafety.com.

title: Brand Director, Global Marc Jacobs
description:
**Global Marketing Director, Marc Jacobs Fragrances** 




**New York, NY** 




  





**THE ROLE** 




**COTY is looking for smart leaders who are tenacious, passionate, and fearlessly kind.** 




  





**What You Will Do:** 




 The
 **Global Marketing Director, Marc Jacobs Fragrances** 
 will own together with the Vice President of Global marketing, the strategic leadership of the global fragrance marketing agenda: shaping brand vision, orchestrating long\-term growth initiatives, driving cross\-region alignment and championing the brand’s global footprint. This role combines deep fragrance category expertise, P\&L ownership, team leadership and global execution excellence. The successful candidate will translate global brand ambitions into high\-impact programs that deliver business results across markets.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities:** 



* Define and lead the global fragrance marketing vision and strategy, encompassing brand architecture, global consumer segmentation, positioning across regions, innovation roadmap, and long\-term growth platforms.
* Strongly influence the global fragrance portfolio’s P\&L, including revenue growth, margin management, COGs and marketing spend, setting investment priorities.
* Manage and develop a high\-performing marketing organization fostering talent development, cross\-functional collaboration and consistent brand execution worldwide.
* Oversee the planning and execution of the global product launch calendar for fragrances—concept development, fragrance, naming \& packaging strategy, 360 campaigns and global go\-to\-market.
* Drive omnichannel global marketing campaigns (360°): advertising, digital/social, influencer strategy, experiential, retail activations, e\-commerce, sampling and GWP (Gift With Purchase)—ensuring global scale and local relevance.
* Maintain deep consumer and market insights across the fragrance category globally: trend analysis, competitive benchmarking, country/regional dynamics, consumer journey mapping, identifying white\-space opportunities.
* Ensure global brand consistency while enabling regional/local market customization and adaptations—balancing global standards with local market needs.
* Own the development of strategic communications and deliverables: global business reviews, board\-level decks, agency briefs, internal/external presentations, and marketing toolkits for regional teams.
* Drive the creation and governance of commercial tools and initiatives: global frameworks for GWPs, sampling programs, promotional sets, seasonal activations and merchandising—ensuring they align with brand equity, deliver ROI and support key milestones.
* Lead cross\-functional partnerships (R\&D/Olfactive, Supply Chain, Trade Marketing, Legal/Regulatory, Licensor) to ensure seamless alignment of marketing strategy with brand DNA.
* Lead the relationship with the licensor, serving as the primary point of contact to secure timely approvals, ensure brand alignment, and maintain strong collaboration across projects. Proactively manage communication, timelines, and expectations to keep all initiatives on track and compliant with brand standards.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business or related field; MBA preferred.
* 9\+ years of marketing experience, with at least several years in a senior role within the fragrance, beauty or luxury goods sector.
* Proven track record of leading global campaigns, product launches and fragrance business growth.
* Strong strategic, commercial and analytical acumen; experience managing budgets, P\&L, forecasting and ROI.
* Deep understanding of the fragrance category—including consumer behavior, olfactive trends, regional market dynamics and retail channels.
* Outstanding leadership and people\-management skills; experienced in managing global \& marketing teams and agency partners.
* Excellent communication, storytelling and presentation skills—able to influence senior leadership and external stakeholders.
* Passion for fragrance, sensory experience, brand storytelling and innovation.
* Global mindset with the ability to navigate diverse markets, build consensus and create trustworthy relationships.
* Highly organized, adaptable, and thrives in a fast\-paced environment with multiple priorities.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint) and familiar with marketing analytics/tools.



  





**What We Offer** 




 This is a unique opportunity to make a difference in a diverse environment with a team of professionals who are passionate about their work and know how to have fun along the way.
 



 Coty’s global omni\-working policy provides the option to work up to 50% of your month remotely. We believe that a flexible philosophy of remote working gives everyone the freedom to choose what works for their individual circumstances and empowers them to always perform at their best.
 



  





 Base Salary Range: $150,000\-$200,000
 



  





**About Us** 




 Our people make us who we are. They are the brightest minds bringing the boldest ideas to life every day. If you’re the kind of person who refuses to settle, if you want to think bigger, learn faster and go further than you ever thought possible – we’d love to hear from you.
 



 Coty is deeply committed to Changing the Conversation around Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion to create a more open, inclusive, and diverse workplace where all employees can be their authentic self.
 



  





**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITIES** 








 We offer equal employment opportunity to qualified individuals without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Coty complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact cotyjobsUS@cotyinc.com. We strongly believe that cultivating a diverse workplace gives a company strength. The combination of unique skills, abilities, experiences and backgrounds creates an environment that produces extraordinary results. EOE Minorities/Females/Protected Veterans/Disabled.

title: Design Director (Commercial Interiors)
description:
The Design Director is a senior creative and operational authority on all commercial engagements, accountable for design quality, project economics, team performance, and client experience. This is a full\-time position based in New York City, with some flexibility to work from home.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 Design Leadership:
 


* Follows the creative direction and design standards for all commercial projects, from concept through construction administration, ensuring every project reflects Company values: Elegance, Curation, and Integrity.
* Leads schematic design, design development, and construction documents on complex, high\-profile commercial engagements.
* Integrates interior architecture seamlessly with decorating and FF\&E across project phases.



  






 Client and Business Development:
 



* Serves as the primary client relationship owner for commercial accounts, from first meeting through project closeout.
* Represents Pembrooke \& Ives in pitches, presentations, and industry forums; helps grow the commercial pipeline.
* Identifies and cultivates strategic partnerships with developers, brokers, corporate real estate clients, and hospitality operators.



  






 Team Development and Operations:
 



* Leads, mentors, and develops the commercial design team across all levels (Senior through Junior).
* Manages project scheduling and utilization planning.
* Drives adherence to disciplined phasing, proactive client communication, and margin\-conscious delivery.
* Establishes and refines commercial\-specific SOPs, drawing standards, and quality control protocols.
* Collaborates across Design and Decorating/FF\&E teams to share knowledge and resource talent where appropriate.



  






 Firm Leadership:
 



* Participates in firm\-wide leadership discussions, including strategic planning, culture, and professional development.
* Contributes to the firm’s visibility in the commercial market through editorial placements, speaking engagements, and award submissions.
* Provides mentorship and growth pathways for rising talent in the firm.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 12\+ years of experience in commercial interior design or interior architecture, with 4\+ years in a senior leadership or studio director role.
* Demonstrated portfolio across multiple commercial projects and typologies.
* Deep proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, and Adobe Creative Suite; comfort with 3D visualization tools.
* Strong command of commercial building codes and accessibility requirements.
* Proven ability to manage projects from concept and programming through construction administration in conjunction with external consultants.
* Experience managing project economics: fee negotiation, budget tracking, and margin accountability.
* Outstanding communication and presentation skills; polished client\-facing presence with all parties of commercial projects.
* Experience with large scale presentations to membership groups through multiple phases of projects.
* Bachelor’s degree in Interior Design, Interior Architecture, Architecture, or other relevant degrees.
* Experience working in or with boutique luxury or high\-end design firms where craft and client service are primary differentiators preferred.
* New York City or other targeted geographic market experience and existing client relationships preferred.



  





**Salary Range** 
 $190,000\.00 \- $220,000\.00 (depending on experience) \+ Performance\-Based Bonus
 



  





 Benefits
 


* Health, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave Plans
* Paid Public Holidays
* Hybrid Work Schedule (Office Based in Midtown, Manhattan)
* Commuter Benefits
* 401(k) Match

title: HR Director
description:
Eterniti is the leading operator of vacation rentals in iconic holiday destinations, led by a passion for excellence, authentic adventures, and hospitality. With over €2 billion in assets under management, we operate 800\+ chalets, villas and apartments under 3 consumer brands: Emerald Stay (our 4\* brand), Bo House (our 5\* brand) and Verbier Exclusive (our Palace brand). Our guests can discover our properties in more than 25 exceptional destinations across Europe and North America. We are a fast\-growing company generating around €100M in annual revenue, backed by more than €50M raised from top\-tier investors. Join us at a pivotal moment, with the ambition and the means to keep raising the bar.  

  

We are looking for a talented **part\-time People Director (50\-60%)** to join our dynamic team, at our Barcelona office. In this role, you will be exposed to an international group spanning various business units, where your ability to protect and nurture our culture and to excel at recruitment will be absolutely key to your success.

 **RESPONSIBILITIES**  

  

**Strategic HR \& business partnering**

* Act as HR Business Partner for all companies in the group.
* Ensure HR monitoring and compliance.
* Be accountable for the OKRs process, together with our Chief of Staff.
* Run the annual employee survey and propose an annual HR plan based on the results.
* Own, monitor and act on the people dashboards to steer performance across destinations.
* Prepare the people slides for our board meetings.

**Culture, communication \& engagement**

* Be the guardian of our group's culture.
* Lead HR and internal communication projects (internal newsletters, AI trainings, Learning \& Development, etc.).
* Organise and host our annual offsite for the Eterniti and Emerald Stay team.

**Talent acquisition \& development**

* Oversee recruitment and training.
* Participate in team members' onboardings and offboardings.
* Deliver individual training sessions (e.g. presentation or communication skills).
* Help managers develop their coaching and mentoring skills.

**Team management, entities \& tools**

* Manage two HR team members.
* Complete the HR integration with the Jewels (acquired companies).
* Handle key individual HR matters and HR situations that escalate.
* Be accountable for our HR tools: JazzHR and Skello.


Depending on priorities as well as your bandwidth, skills and interest, you may be involved in other projects, in line with your qualifications.

 **KEY INFORMATION**

* Employment start: as soon as possible.
* Reporting to the CEO (Maxime Friess) and COO (Laurent Lacourt).
* Position based in Barcelona.
* Occasional travel across our entities and destinations, as needed
* Permanent contract (indefinite Spanish contract)
* Part\-time position: 20 to 24 hours / week (i.e 50%\-60%). Workdays will be Tuesdays and Wednesdays (at the office), plus another half\-day or weekday to be confirmed (home office possible).
* The application journey has 5 key steps:
	+ Step 1: screening call for selected candidates.
	+ Step 2: case study.
	+ Step 3: video interview with our Chief People Officer and our HR Manager.
	+ Step 4: video interview with our COO.
	+ Step 5: video interview with our CEO.
	+ Step 6: references check.

 **ABOUT YOU**

**We’d love to hear from you if…**

* You have solid senior HR / People experience, ideally across several entities or countries: at least 5 years.
* You are an entrepreneur at heart and have prior experience at a fast\-growing startup \- we expect you to be proactive and constructive at all times; you thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
* You combine strategic HR business partnering with a hands\-on, get\-things\-done approach.
* You are a natural people leader who builds trust and handles confidential matters with discretion.
* You have a good working knowledge of labour and employment frameworks (France and Spain a plus).
* You are comfortable steering with data, dashboards and KPIs, and strong with digital tools.
* You speak (and write) French and English fluently; Spanish is a plus.
* You can work in the EU without visa sponsorship.

**ABOUT US**


We offer a work environment that values and empowers people while fostering personal development. Our culture is dictated by the following values :

* **Make Mistakes** \- We foster a creative environment where the best ideas win, where it is okay to make mistakes and unacceptable not to learn from them.
* **Question** \- We don't accept the status quo and look for ways to leverage technology while empowering people.
* **Speak Up** \- We are true people who give honest feedback, who are not afraid to share opinions and who don't talk behind one's back.
* **Think Big** \- While staying humble, we aim for the stars and work towards established goals and metrics.
* **Don’t Compromise** \- We are obsessed with quality, like a Swiss watchmaker.
* **Care** \- We care about our team members, our partners and our clients, and make our passion and our work one and the same.


We are demanding \- everyone really counts at Eterniti. But keep in mind that we value hard work and give growth opportunities to those who deserve it. We want you to grow with the company.  

  

*We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to any characteristic unrelated to their skills and experience.*

**Oh, we’ve got perks...**

* **Flexible work environment**: we have a flexible home office policy; you'll work at the office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, the rest of the time, it's up to you. Feeling like working with another view? We offer 15 days yearly of remote work from wherever you’d like
* **Flexible benefits**: you’ll get a card to spend on what matters most to you: food, transport, or health insurance to optimize your net income
* **Discount on Emerald stays**, during specific periods, on selected properties
* **Regular team outings and events**: because work is fun when you’re part of an awesome team
* **External coaching**: for supervisor level and above \- we believe and invest in you
* **Anniversary perks**

 **Ready to join?**

### **If you're willing to bring your creativity, passion for service, and high\-energy vibe to Eterniti, we want to hear from you. Apply today and let's start this exciting journey together!**

title: Senior Manager, Growth Strategy & Operations (PLG & Pricing)
description:
**We power people’s progress.**
-------------------------------


At Preply, we’re all about creating life\-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human\-led, tech\-enabled \- and it’s creating real impact.


We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human\-led, AI\-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000\+ tutors teach 90\+ languages to learners in 180 countries \- and we’re only getting started. As a category\-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.


Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

**Meet the team!**
------------------


Organic Growth builds sustainable, compounding growth engines for Preply. Within the team, Product Led Growth and Pricing \& Discounting are two strategic areas with the potential to unlock non\-linear growth, improve learner lifetime value and strengthen the economics of our marketplace.


Product Led Growth already has a dedicated cross\-functional product team, including Product, Design, Analytics and Engineering. Pricing and Discounting is the next area of strategic development, with further product investment planned as part of Preply's growth agenda.


You will report to the Senior Director of Organic Growth and take responsibility for agreed commercial KPIs across both areas. In your first year, your priorities will be to accelerate the performance and strategic development of Product Led Growth, while defining Preply's Pricing and Discounting strategy, principles and investment priorities.


You will initially manage one analyst responsible for day\-to\-day Product Led Growth analytics, with the potential to grow the team as the scope develops. This high\-visibility role offers the opportunity to scale an established growth engine while building Preply's approach to Pricing and Discounting from the ground up. It is a full\-time role based in Barcelona, combining regular collaboration in our office with the flexibility to work remotely.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Own the business and product strategy for Product Led Growth and Pricing and Discounting, turning Preply's company priorities into clear choices, roadmaps and measurable commercial outcomes.
* Take responsibility for agreed commercial KPIs, including Product Led Growth NSGMV and share of NSGMV, incremental total lifetime value, margin and LTV to CAC efficiency.
* Accelerate Product Led Growth by identifying and prioritising opportunities across referrals, advocacy, sharing, incentives and other product\-led acquisition and retention mechanics.
* Build Preply's Pricing and Discounting strategy across the marketplace, including our approach to tutor pricing, learner\-facing prices, promotions, discounts, credits and incentives.
* Develop business cases, proofs of concept and MVPs that allow Preply to validate opportunities before making deeper product or organisational investments.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Finance and other Growth leaders to shape roadmaps, design experiments and balance learner value, tutor outcomes, growth, margin and marketplace health.
* Own the performance and decision\-making framework for the portfolio, ensuring teams have clear KPIs, reliable measurement and a regular cadence for reviewing progress and reallocating investment.
* Use quantitative and qualitative insight to identify strategic and tactical growth opportunities, challenge assumptions and turn complex analysis into clear recommendations.
* Build alignment across senior stakeholders and communicate strategy, trade\-offs, progress and recommendations with clarity and conviction.
* Lead and develop the Product Led Growth analyst, setting a high bar for analytical quality, commercial impact and effective partnership with cross\-functional teams.

**What success looks like:**
----------------------------

* A clear, prioritised Product Led Growth plan that delivers measurable progress against NSGMV, share of NSGMV and efficiency targets.
* An aligned Pricing \& Discounting strategy with defined principles, priority opportunities and a sequenced roadmap covering both tutor and learner dynamics.
* High\-potential Pricing \& Discounting opportunities validated through robust business cases, proofs of concept or MVPs, creating confidence in where Preply should invest next.
* Demonstrable progress towards improving total lifetime value, margin and LTV to CAC efficiency through better pricing, discount and incentive decisions.
* Strong confidence and alignment across Growth, Product, Finance, Data and senior leadership, supported by concise communication and transparent trade\-offs.
* A high\-performing analyst with clear ownership, strong development and increasing impact on business and product decisions.

**What you need to succeed:**
-----------------------------

* 8 or more years of relevant experience in growth strategy, commercial strategy, pricing, monetisation, business operations or a related role within a product\-led technology business.
* Evidence of owning meaningful commercial KPIs for a growth area, business unit, channel or product, and of translating strategy into measurable business impact.
* Strong commercial judgement and a solid understanding of lifetime value, margin, unit economics and the trade\-offs involved in growing a two\-sided marketplace.
* Excellent strategic and critical thinking, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, make clear choices and move effectively from analysis to execution.
* Experience working directly with Product, Engineering, Data and Finance teams to shape roadmaps, design experiments and deliver complex cross\-functional initiatives.
* Strong analytical fluency and the ability to interrogate complex data, evaluate experiments and distinguish meaningful signals from noise. Hands\-on SQL experience is helpful but not required.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, including the ability to build alignment and communicate concise recommendations to senior leaders.
* Experience leading, coaching or developing analytical talent, with the ability to create clarity and raise the quality of a team's work.
* Practical fluency with AI tools, with evidence of using them to improve analysis, research, decision\-making or operational workflows.

**Experience that would be valuable:**
--------------------------------------

* Direct experience in pricing, monetisation, promotions, discounts, incentives or marketplace economics.
* Experience in a consumer marketplace, subscription business, travel, e\-commerce or another scaled digital product with complex pricing and lifetime value dynamics.
* A background that combines structured strategy or consulting experience with hands\-on operating ownership.

**Why you’ll love it at Preply:**
---------------------------------

* An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;

title: Product Designer - Grow & Engage
description:
### **About the Opportunity**



We're looking for a Product Designer to join N26's UX team in our **Grow and Engage** domain. There are a couple of areas within the domain where we're adding design strength, and we'll match you to the right one based on your background and what you're drawn to.



In this role, you'll work in the Grow \& Engage domain—the heart of the customer experience ranging from the acquisition and signup to our premium membership tiers and the daily engagement of our users. You will work in teams delivering the newest and most innovative features serving our customers in the best way possible. You'll design end\-to\-end on important features and flows that millions of customers use every day. You'll report to our Head of UX, and work in a tight cross\-functional team of product, engineering, research, and data partners. We'll back you to grow your craft on work that matters—to customers, to the business, and to your own development as a designer.



We believe our team's diversity is our strength. The more perspectives at the table, the better. Please apply regardless of your identity, experience, or background.

  

***Please note:***


* ***We highly encourage you to attach your most recent portfolio and CV in English to your application.***
* ***Applications without a portfolio will not be considered***

### **About the Work**



The Grow and Engage domain is where we shape how customers get genuine, lasting value from N26\. It covers a broad slice of the core product—the moments that bring customers back to their day\-to\-day banking, the features that build habits and surface real value, and the way our paid tiers turn into something subscribers actively feel.



The work spans the home screen, in\-app discovery, recommendations and AI\-powered insights, the cross\-cutting patterns that pull the whole product together, and our Smart, Go, and Metal subscription tiers—where the opportunity is to weave value through the product rather than bolt it on. You'll have meaningful scope to shape both how we package what we have today and what comes next.



You'll be designing for a fintech product used by millions, in a category where customers' expectations have been shaped by some of the best digital products in the world. The bar is high, and the work matters.


### **In This Role, You Will:**


* **Design end\-to\-end** on important features within your segment, from problem framing through research, exploration, and shipped work.
* **Bring a high bar for craft**—UI and interaction design that delights customers and converts.
* **Frame design problems sharply**: define user needs, success criteria, constraints, and tradeoffs before jumping into solutions.
* **Develop user flows and interactions** that hold up across the connected parts of the product, anticipating how your work affects adjacent areas.
* **Contribute to our design system**—using and improving the patterns the team relies on.
* **Be data\-informed**: plan and run research that blends qualitative and quantitative methods, and proactively seek out the data you need when it isn't on the table.
* **Partner closely** with product, engineering, research, and data to ship work that actually lands—and to take it further once it's live.
* **Use AI tools fluently** as part of your design practice—for exploration, prototyping, synthesis, and to accelerate the parts of the work that benefit from acceleration.

#### **How We Work:**


* We pair tightly with PM and engineering to develop delightful, scalable solutions.
* Hands\-on leadership—managers still design.
* AI is a real, ongoing part of how we work—across design tooling, prototyping, and product. We expect everyone on the team to be fluent and curious here.
* We ship, and we ship often. We learn from what's live as much as from what's in Figma.

### **What You Need to be Successful:**


#### **You're a good fit if you have:**


* A **strong portfolio** showing end\-to\-end product design work on consumer products—ideally mobile.
* Experience taking complex feature work from problem to ship, owning the design throughout.
* Experience working with a design system—using it, contributing to it, and knowing when to push back on it.
* Experience grounding decisions in research and data—and a willingness to seek them out when they're not available.
* Strong written and verbal communication—you can explain your decisions to product, engineering, and leadership.

#### **Traits:**


* **Pride in quality**: You sweat the details—interaction, visual, copy, edge cases—and you treat your craft as something you're actively growing.
* **Systems thinking**: You see the connections between parts of a product, and you design with the wider experience in mind.
* **Problem\-first mindset**: You're rigorous about understanding the real problem, the real user, and the real constraints before committing to a direction.
* **Bias for action**: You move fast, prototype to learn, and resist the pull of polishing in isolation.
* **AI\-curious**: You're active in using AI tools to extend what you can do and reshape your design practice.
* **Generous collaborator**: You give and receive feedback well, and you're invested in making the work better—not just yours.

### **What's in it for You:**


* **Accelerate your career growth** by joining one of Europe's most talked about disruptors.
* **Employee benefits** that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness \& wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
* **Premium banking services**: As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account, as well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
* **Generous time off**: Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
* **Autonomy \& culture**: A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting\-edge technologies—all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences, and family statuses.
* **Relocation support**: A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

### **Who We Are**


N26 has reimagined banking for today's digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do—and it's how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use. Founded in 2013, N26 serves over 7 million customers across 24 markets. We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.



Our UX team is part of the wider Product \& UX organisation. We're a multidisciplinary group of 40\+ designers, researchers, content designers, and design ops practitioners (we call ourselves "UXers"), most of us embedded in cross\-functional product teams. Our team is based in Berlin and Barcelona.



Sounds good? Apply now for this position.


### **Equal Opportu****nities**


We recognize that our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring to our workforce. We strive to build talented and diverse teams to drive our business success and empower our people to reach their full potential.



We genuinely welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We're committed to creating an inclusive workspace where everyone feels valued and respected, free from harassment and discrimination.



If there's anything you need to make the application process work for you, please let us know by reaching out to candidate.exp@n26\.com. Visit our website to learn more about Diversity, Equity, \& Inclusion at N26\.

Technician for Innovation and Transfer in Digital Humanities

**About BSC**  

  

The Barcelona Supercomputing Center \- Centro Nacional de Supercomputación (BSC\-CNS) is the leading supercomputing center in Spain. It houses MareNostrum, one of the most powerful supercomputers in Europe, was a founding and hosting member of the former European HPC infrastructure PRACE (Partnership for Advanced Computing in Europe), and is now hosting entity for EuroHPC JU, the Joint Undertaking that leads large\-scale investments and HPC provision in Europe. The mission of BSC is to research, develop and manage information technologies in order to facilitate scientific progress. BSC combines HPC service provision and R\&D into both computer and computational science (life, earth and engineering sciences) under one roof, and currently has over 1000 staff from 60 countries.
  

  

Look at the BSC experience:
  

BSC\-CNS YouTube Channel
  

Let's stay connected with BSC Folks!
  

  

We are particularly interested for this role in the strengths and lived experiences of women and underrepresented groups to help us avoid perpetuating biases and oversights in science and IT research. In instances of equal merit, the incorporation of the under\-represented sex will be favoured.
  

  

We promote Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, fostering an environment where each and every one of us is appreciated for who we are, regardless of our differences.
  

  

If you consider that you do not meet all the requirements, we encourage you to continue applying for the job offer. We value diversity of experiences and skills, and you could bring unique perspectives to our team.  

  

**Context And Mission**  

  

We are looking for a proactive and dynamic professional with a hybrid profile (management\-humanities\-technology) to join the management team of the CLARIAH\-CAT network . The selected person will be responsible for coordinating key actions that connect academic research with the cultural, creative, business and civil society sectors, focused on the assessment and transfer of digital humanities.  

  

**Key Duties**  

  

* Open and Participatory Innovation: Organization, coordination and logistics of connection events ( brokerage events ), support in the design of co\-creation workshops, speed networking sessions and writing of catalogs of resulting and transferable projects and technologies.
* Transfer and Valorization: Management of calls for valorization activities, support in the coordination of citizen laboratories, and in the transfer activities proposed by the different working groups of the network. Advice on intellectual property and representation at sector fairs. Prepare the impact and transfer reports of the network. Provide logistical support in each call for action promoted by the working groups. Promote participation in transfer activities. Preparation of transfer reports.
  

  

**Requirements**  

  

* Education
	+ Degree or Master's degree in Humanities, History, Philology, History of Art, Archaeology, Documentation, Cultural Management or related engineering.
	+ A Master's or Postgraduate degree in Digital Humanities, Innovation Management, Knowledge Transfer or related degrees will be highly valued.
* Essential Knowledge and Professional Experience
	+ Event organization (logistics, participant coordination). Previous experience in project monitoring and justification tasks will be valued. (2 years of experience at least)
* Competences
	+ Mediation capacity
	+ Great ability to organize and manage tasks and calendar simultaneously
	+ Proactivity, autonomy and skills for multidisciplinary networking
	+ Problem solving and flexibility

  

**Conditions**  

  

* The position will be located at BSC within the Directors Department
* We offer a full\-time contract (35h/week), a good working environment, a highly stimulating environment with state\-of\-the\-art infrastructure, flexible working hours, extensive training plan, restaurant tickets, private health insurance, support to the relocation procedures
* Duration: Open\-ended contract due to technical and scientific activities linked to the project and budget duration
* Holidays: 22 days of holidays \+ 6 personal days \+ 24th and 31st of December per our collective agreement
* Salary: we offer a competitive salary commensurate with the qualifications and experience of the candidate and according to the cost of living in Barcelona
* Starting date: Pending (as soon as possible)
  
  

**Applications procedure and process**  

  

All applications must be submitted via the BSC website and contain:  

  

  

* A full CV in English including contact details
* A cover/motivation letter with a statement of interest in English, clearly specifying for which specific area and topics the applicant wishes to be considered. Additionally, two references for further contacts must be included. Applications without this document will not be considered.
  

  

  

**Development of the recruitment process**

  

  

  

The selection will be carried out through a competitive examination system ("Concurso\-Oposición"). The recruitment process consists of two phases:  

  

  

* **Curriculum Analysis:** Evaluation of previous experience and/or scientific history, degree, training, and other professional information relevant to the position. \- ***40 points***
* **Interview phase:** The highest\-rated candidates at the curriculum level will be invited to the interview phase, conducted by the corresponding department and Human Resources. In this phase, technical competencies, knowledge, skills, and professional experience related to the position, as well as the required personal competencies, will be evaluated. \- ***60 points.*** *A minimum of 30 points out of 60 must be obtained to be eligible for the position.*
  

  

  

  

The recruitment panel will be composed of at least three people, ensuring at least 25% representation of women.

  

  

  

In accordance with OTM\-R principles, a gender\-balanced recruitment panel is formed for each vacancy at the beginning of the process. After reviewing the content of the applications, the panel will begin the interviews, with at least one technical and one administrative interview. At a minimum, a personality questionnaire as well as a technical exercise will be conducted during the process.

  

  

  

The panel will make a final decision, and all individuals who participated in the interview phase will receive feedback with details on the acceptance or rejection of their profile.

  

  

  

  

At BSC, we seek continuous improvement in our recruitment processes. For any suggestions or comments/complaints about our recruitment processes, please contact recruitment \[at] bsc \[dot] es.
  

For more information, please follow this link.

  

  

  

  

**Deadline**  

  

The vacancy will remain open until a suitable candidate has been hired. Applications will be regularly reviewed and potential candidates will be contacted.  

  

**OTM\-R principles for selection processes**  

  

BSC\-CNS is committed to the principles of the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers of the European Commission and the Open, Transparent and Merit\-based Recruitment principles (OTM\-R). This is applied for any potential candidate in all our processes, for example by creating gender\-balanced recruitment panels and recognizing career breaks etc.
  

BSC\-CNS is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or any other basis protected by applicable state or local law.

title: Head of People Operations & Tech
description:
**The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.**


n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no\-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500\+ builder\-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.


Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 \- working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

* Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
* Earned 190K\+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
* Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment \- bringing us to a $5\.2bn valuation

  

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what *you* can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out \- whether you’re technical or not \- and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.


We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

**Head of People Ops \& Tech**
==============================


You'll own and rebuild the operating system behind n8n's People function: hygiene, analytics, systems, and automation. This isn't a maintenance job. You'll have a real mandate to design it your way, and since n8n builds workflow automation for a living, you'll get to use our own product to do it. If you've ever wanted to turn your own function into your best case study, this is that job.


You're inheriting a People Ops team that's kept things moving through real growth, and you'll get a proper audit period before anyone asks you to change anything. That's real trust, and it means you get to diagnose before you prescribe.


Here's what you'll own:

### **Own the hygiene factors of employment**

* Own employment contracts, payroll coordination, visas, and employee policies end to end.
* Keep n8n's SOC 2\-related compliance processes accurate and audit\-ready.
* Bring clear, centralized ownership to freelancer and contractor engagement approvals, an area with no consistent oversight today.
* Personally step in on hands\-on hygiene work whenever it's the highest\-impact use of your time.

### **Build people analytics in\-house**

* Stand up n8n's own people analytics capability rather than relying on the central data team, given the sensitivity of the data.
* Turn People data into decisions leadership can act on, from attrition trends to org health.
* Report on the health of the People function to the VP People and wider leadership.

### **Own people systems and drive automation**

* Own and evolve People systems like HiBob and Mahana, keeping data clean and workflows scalable.
* Automate repetitive People Ops work, partnering with workflow automation engineers on the most complex builds. You'll be doing it with n8n's own product, so you get to dogfood the exact tool your company sells, on your own function.
* Get the underlying process and data right before you automate it. Solid documentation and a consistent process come first here, not as an afterthought.
* Reduce manual load so the function scales without headcount growing in lockstep.

### **Welcome new hires and grow the team**

* Act as the onboarding liaison, making sure new hires feel welcomed and set up to succeed from day one.
* Build out a small, high\-trust team, hiring 2–3 specialists in analytics, automation, and systems over the next 12–24 months.
* Partner closely with the VP People, Talent Acquisition, People Partners, and Finance/Legal to keep People Operations reliable as we scale.

**REQUIREMENTS**
----------------

### **Must\-haves**

* **Proven scaling experience:** You've scaled or matured an existing People Operations function, not necessarily built one from zero, through a comparable growth range such as 500 to 1,000 employees.
* **Hands\-on hygiene ownership:** You've personally owned contracts, payroll coordination, visas, employee policies, and SOC 2\-adjacent compliance, not just directed others who do.
* **Strategic and hands\-on:** You're comfortable setting vision and prioritizing, and just as comfortable rolling up your sleeves on execution.
* **People analytics fluency:** You have real experience with people analytics and data, and you're willing to build that capability in\-house.
* **Systems and automation:** You've worked hands\-on with HRIS platforms like HiBob and have driven process automation in a People function.
* **Europe\-based:** You're based in Europe.
* **Track record:** You've run or built this kind of function at least once before; twice is a plus.
* **Sequencing judgment:** You know automation is only as good as the process and data behind it, and you don't force AI onto a process that isn't documented or consistent yet.

### **Nice\-to\-haves**

* **Hybrid background:** You've come up through analytics into people ops, or the other way around.
* **Automation partnership:** You've partnered with or managed workflow\-automation or AI tooling specialists.
* **Comp benchmarking exposure:** You've worked with compensation benchmarking or market\-data analysis before.
* **Remote\-first scaling:** You've scaled a People function specifically inside a remote\-first, distributed organization.

**Why join us?**


You'll take real ownership of the systems that let n8n's People function scale. This is a genuine mandate to design them, not inherit someone else's finished blueprint, and you'll get a built\-in audit period so you can diagnose before anyone asks you to prescribe. You'll report directly to our VP People, with real visibility and sponsorship, and you'll shape the next 2 to 3 hires on your own team as it grows.


Since n8n builds workflow automation for a living, you'll get to use our own product to automate your own function. That's a genuinely rare setup, and honestly, the best advertisement for what we build. You're joining at around 400 people, heading past 500 by year\-end, which is exactly the stage where the calls you make on hygiene, analytics, systems, and automation define how the company scales, rather than just keeping the lights on.


n8n is remote\-first, fair\-code, and riding the AI and automation wave as one of the most starred projects on GitHub. You'll work with the same autonomy and talent density that defines how we build our own product. Apply now, and help us build the People operating system that gets n8n to its next 1,000 people.

*n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

title: Lead Animator
description:
**Company Description** **Join The Game!**


Leader in the development and publishing of games, Gameloft® has established itself as a pioneer in the industry, creating innovative gaming experiences for over 20 years. Gameloft creates games for all digital platforms, from mobile to cross\-platform titles for PC and consoles. Gameloft operates its own established franchises such as Asphalt®, Dragon Mania Legends, Modern Combat and Dungeon Hunter and also partners with major rights holders including LEGO®, Universal, Illumination Entertainment, Hasbro®, Fox Digital Entertainment, Mattel®, Lamborghini®, and Ferrari®. Gameloft distributes its games in over 100 countries and employs 3,000 people worldwide. Every month, 55 million unique users can be reached by advertisers in Gameloft games with Gameloft for brands, a leading B2B offering dedicated to brands and agencies. Gameloft is a Vivendi company.

 **Job Description** **WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON**

**Your main challenge**


Gameloft Barcelona is looking for a **Lead Animator** to lead the animation team working on a new action\-based, multi\-platform IP featuring world\-famous characters from a major licensor.


Your challenge will be to establish and maintain a high animation quality bar while leading and developing the team behind it. You will combine people leadership with strong animation expertise, working closely with Art, Game Design, Programming and external partners to ensure every animation supports the personality of our characters, gameplay readability and the overall player experience.

**What it means on a daily basis**

* **Lead and develop the animation team**, providing regular feedback, mentoring and guidance while supporting the individual growth of animators across different seniority levels.
* **Own the animation quality bar**, ensuring character animation delivers the expected level of movement, weight, acting, storytelling and personality while remaining consistent with the project's artistic direction and licensor expectations.
* **Plan and oversee animation production**, managing priorities, workload and delivery while keeping stakeholders informed and stepping into hands\-on animation work when the team needs additional support.
* **Collaborate closely with Game Design, Programming, Art and Technical Animation** to ensure animations work effectively within gameplay, including topics related to rigging, skinning and game\-engine animation states.
* **Coordinate animation work with external partners**, providing clear briefs, reviews and actionable feedback to ensure outsourced animation integrates consistently with the work produced internally.

**What success will look like**

**Within your first 3 months**, you will have developed a strong understanding of the project's animation direction, characters, production pipeline and team, establishing effective ways of working with the animators and key partner disciplines.

**Within 6 months**, you will be confidently leading animation production and team development, maintaining a consistent quality bar, identifying production or quality risks early and ensuring the team receives the direction and feedback needed to deliver.

**Within 9 months**, you will be a key reference for animation across the project, helping the team operate with increasing autonomy while continuously raising animation quality and strengthening collaboration between Animation, Art, Design, Programming and external partners.

**Who you would be working with**


You will report to the **Studio Art Development Director** and lead a team of **3D Animators and Technical 3D Animators**.


You will work closely with the Studio Art Director, 3D Art Lead, Game Design, Programming and other production disciplines, while also collaborating with external animation partners and the project's licensor.

**Your recruitment journey**


Our recruitment process is designed to give you the opportunity to meet the people you would work with and explore both your animation expertise and leadership experience.

* Recruiter interview
* Hiring team interview
* Animation assessment/test, where applicable
* Final interview

**Where this role can take you**


This role gives you the opportunity to take ownership of animation at project level, developing both your craft and leadership expertise while contributing to a major multi\-platform IP.


You will have the opportunity to grow as an animation leader, influence animation standards and workflows, develop other artists and collaborate closely with senior creative and technical stakeholders across the project.

 **Qualifications** **WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED**

* Strong expertise in **3D character animation for games**, with the ability to create and evaluate both realistic and stylized/cartoon animation.
* Excellent understanding of **movement, weight, acting, timing and storytelling**, with the ability to preserve the identity and personality of a character through animation.
* Ability to **establish, communicate and maintain animation quality standards**, translating animation principles into clear visual, written and verbal feedback.
* Strong understanding of **game animation production and real\-time workflows**, including effective collaboration with Technical Animators on rigging, skinning and game\-engine animation states.
* Ability to plan and prioritize animation work, manage production constraints and communicate clearly with stakeholders regarding scope, quality and delivery.
* Professional experience with industry\-standard **3D animation tools and workflows**, particularly character animation pipelines such as Maya and/or 3ds Max.
* Fluent English and the ability to communicate effectively within an international and multidisciplinary development environment.
* A portfolio or showreel demonstrating strong character animation work and relevant game animation experience.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* A supportive people leader who can mentor and develop animators across different levels of seniority.
* Comfortable giving clear, constructive and actionable feedback while maintaining a high creative quality bar.
* Collaborative and able to act as a central point of communication between Animation, Art, Game Design, Programming and external partners.
* Organized and able to manage changing priorities in a dynamic production environment.
* Hands\-on when needed, with a **lead\-by\-example** approach and the ability to balance team leadership with direct creative contribution.

  

**Additional Information** **Why Join the World of Gameloft?**

* Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
* Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
* Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries \& cultures!
* Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
* Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

**Benefits:**

* Permanent contract and full\-time position with excellent social benefits.
* 25 vacation days per year.
* Private medical health insurance.
* Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
* Flexible work\-from\-home hybrid model.
* Free language courses.
* Your birthday off!
* 1 month of remote work.
* Merit\-based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
* Career development opportunities.
* Excellent working conditions, with our office located in the centre of Barcelona.
* ...and Thursday after\-work beers!

**We can’t wait to find our next great talent!**


Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross\-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!


Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted and your CV will be saved in our files for a period of 6 months.

**Want to know more?** Please visit our Website: www.gameloft.com


If the offer interests you, Join the Game!

title: Strategic Brand & Design Manager
description:
Overview:
**WELCOME TO SITA**

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.


You’ll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don’t just move the world forward—we’re proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work®** by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**


SITA is at a pivotal moment. We are investing in our next generation of technology and rebuilding our marketing capability to match.


This role leads the Brand and Design function for SITA. You will own the brand strategy, the visual identity system, and the creative output that represents SITA internally and externally. You will manage the creative director, the brand manager, and the design team, acting as the connective tissue between brand thinking and creative execution. Your job is to set the standard, define where the brand needs to go, and make sure that everything we put into the world looks and feels like a company that leads its industry.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

**Brand platform**

* Build the strategic brand platform: brand architecture, personality, verbal and visual identity.
* Turn the platform into tools that global, business unit and regional teams can use without waiting for approval.
* Define how the brand evolves, and make the investment case to leadership when it needs to.

**Messaging and verbal identity**

* Own the corporate messaging architecture and tone of voice.
* Give portfolio and business unit the framework their product messaging builds on.
* Review flagship corporate content for message and tone.

**Design and creative direction**

* Set a design direction that breaks with legacy telco and IT codes.
* Direct flagship work personally: publications, executive presentations, films and event environments.
* Own the creative brief standard, and approve or reject work from internal teams and agencies.

**Brand experience**

* Own how we are experienced at major industry moments: exhibition presence, demo environments and briefing spaces.
* Translate event narratives into space, staging, demo flow and visual system.
* Brief experiential and production partners and hold them to the standard.

**Governance and partners**

* Own guidelines, templates, the asset library and a review process that works at scale.
* Own creative direction and quality for brand, design and experience agencies.

**Team**

* Lead the brand manager, graphic designer and video team, and set the quality bar for their work.


Qualifications:
**WHO YOU ARE**

* 10 or more years in brand, design, or creative leadership, with at least 3 of those in a senior role managing a team
* Proven track record of owning and evolving a B2B brand, not just executing against someone else's framework
* Experience managing creative directors or senior designers, with a clear point of view on what good looks like
* Background in technology, aviation, or another complex industry sector is an advantage but not a requirement
* Experience working in a matrixed global organization, with the commercial sensitivity to navigate competing priorities
* Experience managing external agencies, from briefing through execution, ensuring high\-quality delivery, brand consistency, and alignment with strategic objectives.
* Strong brand strategist who can operate at both the strategic and detail level when required.
* Excellent written and verbal communicator, able to articulate the case for brand investment to senior leadership
* Confident creative director who can give clear, constructive feedback to designers and agencies
* Comfortable managing timelines, budgets, and agency relationships without losing sight of the strategic picture
* Publication\-ready written English; able to write a brand rationale, a creative brief, or a board\-level summary with equal confidence
* Direct, decisive and highly organized, with the ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining the strategic picture.
* Resilient and comfortable operating in a dynamic and evolving environment.
* Collaborative leader who adapts communication and leadership style to engage effectively with senior executives, peers and junior team members.

**WHAT WE OFFER**
-----------------

  

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.  

**Flex Week:** Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)* **Flex Day:** Make your workday suit your life and plans.

  

**Flex\-Location:** Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.  

**Employee Wellbeing:** We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health \- a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.  

**Professional Development:** At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world\-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From **LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,** and **Airport Council International** \-available to all employees\-to specialized solutions like **Pluralsight** for technology upskilling, **Harvard Business Publishing** for people leadership, **Stanford** for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.  

**Competitive Benefits:** Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status. *SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self\-identify in the application process.*
