title: Head of Engineering
description:
**Lead engineering that powers how thousands of finance teams spend**
=====================================================================


Spendesk is the AI\-powered spend management and procurement platform trusted by thousands of finance teams across Europe. As our **Head of Engineering**, you'll lead a complete engineering group — several Engineering Managers, Senior EMs, and Staff Engineers — reporting directly to our CTO. You'll set the technical and organisational direction for your area, build the leadership team that runs it, and be accountable for the economics, reliability, and pace of everything it ships.


You will work with 2 to 4 Engineering Managers, reporting directly to you. You will collaborate with the Head of Product and the Head of Design, and other Head of Engineering responsible for other groups.


Your will be responsible for a multi\-disciplinary engineering team of 20\-30 people, with different seniority and skillset, spread across Europe.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

**Technical \& organisational strategy**

* Define the multi\-quarter technical and organisational strategy for your group, aligned with Spendesk's company strategy.
* Drive architectural decisions and simplification across your domain — clear domain boundaries, “platformisation”, debt reduction.
* Make build vs. buy vs. partner calls, and own your group's AI/tooling strategy: what to standardise, what to pilot, and how you measure impact.
* Own your area's economics — cost\-to\-serve, infra efficiency, hiring ROI — with a clear quarterly view, and present the commercial rationale behind your investment decisions.

**Delivery \& operations**

* Be accountable for delivery and outcomes across your full portfolio of squads, balancing competing priorities without losing sight of quality.
* Establish group\-level KPIs, SLOs, and operating rhythms so your teams run well without you in every room.
* Champion end\-to\-end observability, sensible on\-call, and postmortems that actually change things — reducing incident frequency and MTTR over time.
* Sequence hiring and headcount to maximise impact, and defend that plan to stakeholders with data.

**Building your leadership team**

* Hire, develop, and retain a strong, balanced leadership team of EMs, Senior EMs, and Staff Engineers.
* Coach your managers through their hardest calls: performance conversations, hiring decisions, prioritisation trade\-offs.
* Lead performance calibration for your group and make the final call on promotions and compensation.
* Build succession plans for your key leadership roles, so no single departure puts your group at risk.
* Actively invest in retaining your best people, and keep a genuine pulse on team sentiment.

**Influence beyond your team**

* Represent Engineering in company\-wide forums, partnering closely with Product, Design, Data, and customer\-facing teams.
* Communicate your strategy and trade\-offs clearly to both engineers and executives — you're as comfortable defending a roadmap to the leadership team as you are challenging an incident response plan.
* Champion diversity and inclusion in how you hire, develop, and run your organisation.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 8\+ years in software engineering with increasing scope, including 3\+ years managing managers (Team Leads/EMs).
* A track record of delivering complex, multi\-stakeholder programmes in product\-led SaaS on time, on budget, with measurable results. Fintech, payments, or compliance experience is a strong plus.
* Hands\-on experience operating distributed systems at scale in production, and enough technical depth to earn credibility with ICs and Team Leads, not just manage around them.
* Comfort with our stack (TypeScript, Node, React, AWS…). You don't need to write code daily, but you need to read it and question it.
* Real business acumen: you can talk unit economics, ROI, and trade\-offs as fluently as you talk architecture.
* A genuine track record of growing managers into better managers, not just engineers into better engineers.

**Why his role, why now**
=========================


You'll join at a moment where the group you lead has room to simplify, room to invest in AI\-augmented engineering, and a leadership team worth building further. You'll have a documented path behind you and ahead of you: Spendesk's Engineering Leadership Growth Journey maps the road from Engineering Manager through Head of Engineering to CTO, so you'll know exactly what's expected of you, and what growing further looks like once you're here.


You'll be based in one of our offices (Paris, London or Barcelona), with a flexible on\-site rhythm agreed with your team.


As we are an international team, please submit your application and CV in English.

 **About Spendesk**  

Spendesk is the AI\-powered spend management and procurement platform that transforms company spending. By simplifying procurement, payment cards, expense management, invoice processing, and accounting automation, Spendesk sets the new standard for spending at work. Its single, intelligent solution makes efficient spending easy for employees and gives finance leaders the full visibility and control they need across all company spend, even in multi\-entity structures. Trusted by thousands of companies, Spendesk supports over 200,000 users across brands such as Payfit, Accor, Welcome to the Jungle, Swile, Big Mamma, Malt and Yousign. With offices in the United Kingdom, France, Spain and Germany, Spendesk also puts community at the heart of its mission.  

  

For more information: www.spendesk.com/press  

  

**About our people \& culture**  

We believe that people do their best work when they’re given the freedom to thrive and grow. That’s why liberation is at the core of everything we do. We empower Spendeskers to take ownership of their work, to navigate ambiguity, and seize every opportunity. Spendeskers come from all over the world (35\+ countries and counting!) but we have plenty in common: we're bold, ever\-curious, committed to kindness, and tackle every challenge with a positive mindset.
  

  

**About our benefits**  

Our culture is built on trust, empowerment, and growth — with benefits to match!

* Flexible on\-site and remote policy
* Latest Apple equipment — the tools you need to excel
* Access to Moka.care — for emotional and mental health wellbeing
* Great office snacks — to fuel your day
* A positive team to work with daily!


We also offer location\-specific benefits tailored to each market, including health insurance, wellness allowances, commuter support, meal vouchers, and gym memberships — ensuring you're well supported wherever you're based.

 **Diversity \& Inclusion**


At Spendesk, we're committed to fostering an environment where all differences are encouraged, supported and celebrated. We're building our culture for everyone, with everyone. Our goal is to attract and build a diverse, equal and inclusive team, where everyone feels welcome and we truly embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Senior Director, Strategic Projects
description:
**Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Why Vonage, Why Now**
-----------------------



The network is becoming programmable and Vonage is at the centre of that transformation.



As part of Ericsson, Vonage is uniquely positioned to bridge the gap between carrier network capabilities and enterprise demand. Our Network APIs portfolio, spanning Quality on Demand, Silent Authentication, SIM Swap, Identity Insights, Location Services, and more, is rapidly scaling across 17\+ countries and growing.



We are at an inflection point: the market is validating, enterprise customers are deploying, and the window to establish category leadership is now.



This is not a traditional strategy role. It is a senior, highly autonomous in\-house engagement function (think Senior Engagement Manager or Associate Partner) embedded inside Vonage and working directly on the most consequential strategic bets in the Network API space. You'll operate independently: anticipating needs before they are articulated, self\-directing across complex and ambiguous engagements, and always thinking several moves ahead.


**The Role**
------------



As Senior Director, Strategic Projects, you'll serve as a trusted advisor and execution partner to the VP, Business Innovation.



This is a senior role operating with a high degree of autonomy. You will own complex, cross\-functional initiatives end\-to\-end; defining priorities, identifying the right problems to solve, and driving work from first principles through to measurable impact.



Working at the intersection of strategy, business development, product, and go\-to\-market, you will help shape and execute Vonage's strategy in the Network API ecosystem. The ideal candidate is highly resourceful, proactive in connecting across the organisation, and brings strong strategic judgment and a big\-picture mindset to execution.


**What You Will Do**
--------------------


### **Strategic Problem Solving \& Project Leadership**


* Drive end\-to\-end ownership of high\-priority strategic projects for the Network API business, from scoping and hypothesis development through to synthesis, recommendations, and stakeholder alignment.
* Define project objectives, assemble cross\-functional teams (product, engineering, BD, marketing, legal), and manage delivery against plan.
* Translate ambiguous, complex business challenges into clear, defensible answers with "make or save money" logic.

### **Executive Advisory \& Stakeholder Engagement**


* Act as a strategic advisor to senior leadership; prepare and present executive\-level materials for internal and external audiences including CSP partners, enterprise customers, and Ericsson leadership.
* Manage relationships with key internal clients (e.g., members of the Network API and BGCP leadership teams) and external partners.
* Represent Vonage's Network API strategy in high\-stakes engagements, including CSP negotiations, partner discussions, and industry forums (e.g., CAMARA, GSMA Open Gateway).

### **Market Intelligence \& Business Planning**


* Develop and maintain a rigorous view of the competitive landscape, market dynamics, and emerging opportunities across the Network API ecosystem.
* Translate market intelligence into actionable implications for Vonage, informing portfolio choices, go\-to\-market strategy, and capital/resource allocation.
* Conduct scenario planning and business case development to evaluate strategic options and investment decisions.

### **Go\-to\-Market \& Business Model Innovation**


* Construct GTM strategies for new and emerging Network API opportunities, including business, commercial, and operating model design.
* Identify and develop new business opportunities across target verticals (Banking \& Financial Services, Mobility, Industrials, Healthcare, and beyond).
* Support the development of thought leadership content and strategic narratives for external audiences.

### **Operational Excellence \& Reusable Assets**


* Build reusable frameworks, playbooks, and analytical models that scale impact beyond individual engagements.
* Contribute to the overall management of the Special Projects function, including project prioritisation, staffing, and operational development.

title: HR Generalist
description:

 *As an HR Generalist, you are a key member of ICEYE’s local subsidiary in Spain and part of our globally distributed HR team, responsible for ensuring a seamless and positive employee experience across the entire employee lifecycle for ICEYErs in Valencia.*

*You are the face of HR for our local office and the "1st Line of Defence" for all country\-specific people matters.*

*While our Global HR Operations team (the "2nd Line of Defence") designs global frameworks, tools, and data standards, you are responsible for the local tailoring and practical execution of these standards.*

*In short, your mission is to ensure that ICEYErs in Spain are happy and engaged so that they can deliver better business results!*

  

**Who We Are**
--------------

  

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

  

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

  

ICEYE\-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

  

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia\-Pacific.

**Your day\-to\-day responsibilities**
--------------------------------------

* Serve as the primary point of contact for employees in Spain via our ticketing system or other dedicated tools, addressing a wide range of HR inquiries and issues related to benefits, policies, and employee lifecycle events, providing timely and accurate responses in alignment with our global standards.
* Lead new joiner onboarding and orientation, including relocation support and country\-specific paperwork, ensuring a smooth transition into ICEYE.
* Handle individual cases for onboarding and offboarding, including the preparation of local employment contracts, registrations, and country\-specific documentation.
* Manage local third\-party HR providers, including benefit brokers and vendors, to effectively address employee needs.
* Manage the local practicalities of offboarding to ensure all legal requirements and exit procedures are met.
* Enter and audit payroll\-related data in the HRIS, collaborating with internal teams and the local payroll vendor to support accurate local processing.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records in HiBob and other relevant systems, ensuring data integrity, confidentiality, and compliance with local and global data privacy regulations.
* Support the development, communication, and implementation of local HR policies, procedures, and programs, including the employee handbook and guides.
* Identify opportunities to automate local HR tasks in collaboration with the Global HR Operations team, ensuring global “ways of working” meet Spanish legal standards whilst preserving ICEYE’s core culture.
* Provide local logistics and individual support for global HR initiatives such as Wellbeing, Performance Management, and L\&D.
* Assist in planning and executing employee engagement initiatives and culture programs.

**What we’re looking for**

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent experience), with 3\-4 years of experience in a generalist HR or people role.
* Strong working knowledge of Spanish labor law, local benefits, and market HR best practices, with a track record of creating compliant HR policy documentation and internal knowledge base pages.
* A “hands\-on” approach with high attention to detail in contract management, local onboarding experience, and the management of local third\-party providers (e.g., benefit brokers).
* Exceptional communication skills in Spanish and English, with the ability to bridge the gap between global standards and local needs, influencing both local leadership and the global HR team.
* Strong analytical skills and high emotional intelligence to act as the “1st Line of Defence,” handling sensitive “individual case” employee relations with the wisdom to escalate complex issues to the Global HR Operations team.
* Comfort using HRIS (HiBob would be amazing!), utilizing data to audit local payroll and maintain “source of truth” records.
* A proactive and service\-oriented mindset and the ability to remain effective in a fast\-scaling


environment, adapting global policies to local contexts without losing speed.

**Application Process**
-----------------------

* TA Screening interview
* Hiring manager \& Head of Global HR interview
* Culture fit interview
* CEO final stage interview

**Working at ICEYE**
--------------------


At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale\-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

----------------------------

**Make the impossible possible**: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

* **Be curious**: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

------------------------------------------------------


We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.


We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.


Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

130 years of trust, time to shape what's next. Allianz Group is one of the world's leading insurers and asset managers \- built on over a century of stability, expertise, and financial strength. Allianz Services is where that legacy meets the future. 8,200\+ people. Eight countries. Three continents. We deliver specialized services to clients within Allianz Group, powered by AI, advanced analytics, and a mindset that refuses to stand still. From core insurance operations to engineering and consulting services, we reimagine how insurance works. What truly sets us apart are our people and the trusted partnerships we build, anchored in our values of expertise, integrity, and empowerment. We don't support the business. We shape it.
  
  

Role Overview
  
Are you passionate about data and AI and eager to see how they transform the world's leading insurance brand? Join Allianz Services as a Data AI Engineer (m/f/d) and dive into impactful data science and engineering projects within our Az Services Spain Engineering Hub. Collaborate with a dynamic, international team to design, build, and productionize models and data\-driven systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. Partner closely with the Business Owner to translate goals into working solutions with clear SLAs, governance, and ROI to truly "Make AI Happen."
  
  

**What you do:**  

* Design and implement machine learning models and data\-driven applications, with a focus on robust system design and clean, maintainable pipelines.
* Develop and deploy a diverse range of models, moving comfortably between classical machine learning (e.g., LightGBM, XGBoost, Scikit\-Learn) for structured data and other modeling approaches for unstructured or text\-based data as needed.
* Design evaluation frameworks and feedback loops, including offline/online testing and regression checks, to ensure model accuracy and reliability over time.
* Create secure integrations between models and internal APIs, databases, and SaaS systems, applying REST principles and API versioning so consumers keep working as model behavior evolves, and returning structured, validated response schemas rather than raw model output.
* Deploy new model versions behind stable, versioned endpoints, backed by automated testing suited to non\-deterministic outputs (contract tests, output validation, regression benchmarks) and containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Optimize services for latency, reliability, and cost\-efficiency, and build in the logging, monitoring, and traceability needed to run them confidently in production.
* Write high\-quality, testable code and maintain CI/CD pipelines; produce clear technical documentation to ensure long\-term maintainability.


**What you bring:**  

* 5–7 years of professional experience delivering end\-to\-end ML or data engineering projects, from data preparation through production deployment and monitoring.
* Strong Python programming and software engineering fundamentals (unit testing, type hinting, packaging).
* Solid understanding of the machine learning product lifecycle and hands\-on experience with MLOps practices.
* Proficiency in CI/CD automation (GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure preferred); comfort designing versioned, well\-documented APIs is a plus.
* A demonstrable ability to coordinate with cross\-functional teams and the self\-motivation to drive delivery within an agile environment.
* Good level of English (required);
* We highly welcome candidates with a genuine interest and affinity for Information Technology (IT) and Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI), as these attributes are considered valuable assets to our team.


**What we offer:**  

* We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in\-person collaboration and remote working incl. up to 25 days per year working from abroad.
* We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes a company bonus scheme, pension, employee shares program and multiple employee discounts (details vary by location).
* From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered.
* Flexible working, health and wellbeing offers (including healthcare and parental leave benefits) support to balance family and career and help our people return from career breaks with experience that nothing else can teach.


About Allianz
  
Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer.We are united by a shared commitment: to put our customers first and at the center of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions.Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future – for our customers and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture.We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural Internal background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.
  
Join us.Let's care for tomorrow.

title: Senior Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**About Youtrust**
------------------


Youtrust is a European Digital Trust provider, fully compliant with eIDAS and the highest European standards. Our four modules \- electronic signatures, identity and document verification, and e\-seals \- can be used independently or combined within sector\-specific workflows, ensuring simple, secure and legally compliant processes for SMEs and mid\-sized companies. Hosted and processed entirely in Europe, we guarantee sovereignty, transparency and reliability. As a certified B\-Corp, we combine innovation with responsibility \- building trust at the heart of every digital exchange. We are entering a key moment as we expand from eSignature to the full Digital Trust chain.

#### **Your Role**


Youtrust is a \~200\-person European scale\-up on its way to €100M ARR. You join the People team as our sole HRBP, owning the full business\-partnering scope. You raise our HR processes to the next level (talent, performance and salary reviews, HR steering, innovation) and support leaders and teams day to day through coaching, change and organizational design. You work in a small People team that bets on impact over headcount, where everyone owns a vertical and stretches to help the others.

**Your Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Act as a trusted business partner to leaders and managers: own the toughest people calls with them and shape how they handle difficult conversations, team reorgs and high\-stakes decisions.
* Own the talent, performance and salary review cycles end to end, including calibrations, and set the analytical standard behind People decisions.
* Level up and harmonize HR processes and journeys, and lead People and cross\-functional projects to a mid\-market/enterprise standard.
* Drive individual and collective coaching, transitions and career paths as a retention lever.
* Bring solid Comp \& Benefits and social\-law judgement to people decisions, working with lateral partners like Payroll or Finance.
* Build and run AI workflows and agents that sharpen People operations: analysis, reporting, steering and internal comms.

**Your Profile**
----------------


You have run HR business partnering as a true partner to leaders, not a support function, and you have owned talent, performance and salary review cycles end to end. You build HR processes from scratch and get managers to adopt them. You bring sound Comp \& Benefits and social\-law judgement, and you know when to involve lateral partners like Payroll or Finance. You use AI daily, generative and beyond, and build workflows or agents that others adopt. You have strong social and situational intelligence, you form accurate reads and make recommendations that hold up, and you stay steady when everything lands at once. You work with humility and a win\-as\-a\-team spirit. You are fluent in English and French (C1\); Spanish is a plus.

**Why join Youtrust now?**
--------------------------

* A mission that matters in a world challenged by AI\-driven fraud
* A vision built on integrity
* A European \& sovereign platform
* A certified B Corp
* The golden age of Youtrust.

**Benefits**
------------

### **France**

* Time off: 10 RTT days/year, plus menstrual leave, parenthood benefits, seniority days

### **Spain**

description:
Overview:
**WELCOME TO** **SITA**

  



We're the team that keeps airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our tech and communication innovations are the secret behind the success of the world’s air travel industry.


You'll find us at 95% of international hubs. We partner closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients, each with their own unique needs and challenges. Our goal is to find fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to make their operations run like clockwork. Want to be a part of something big?

  

Are you ready to love your job?

  

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

 **ABOUT THE ROLE \& TEAM**

  

SITA is accelerating its transformation toward a modern, AI\-enabled and data\-driven enterprise. As **Functional Lead – Finance Digitalisation \& AI Transformation**, you will provide functional leadership across finance processes, financial systems and ERP while shaping the practical adoption of AI, automation and digital capabilities. You will translate business, reporting and control priorities into scalable solutions that strengthen financial transparency, operational efficiency, data quality and compliance. Working across Finance, IT, Risk, Data and business teams, you will drive change from use\-case identification through delivery, adoption and measurable value realisation.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

  

* Define and deliver the **finance digitalisation and AI roadmap**, translating business priorities into governed use cases with clear outcomes and success measures.
* Act as a **catalyst for change**, enabling finance teams to adopt AI, automation and digital tools in their daily work.
* Embed **responsible AI and strong governance**, including human oversight, data protection, financial controls and clear accountability.

* Apply analytics and AI to identify trends, anomalies, risks and opportunities, ensuring outputs remain explainable and appropriately validated.

* Lead cross\-functional delivery and build team capability through coaching, experimentation, reusable practices and targeted upskilling.


Qualifications:

Demonstrated ability to apply:

  

* Finance digitalisation and technology\-enabled change, from prioritising use cases through delivery, adoption and value realisation.
* Strong functional knowledge of financial systems and ERP, preferably Oracle Financials, across core finance modules, integrations and process design.
* Financial reporting expertise, including management insight, statutory reporting, reconciliations, forecasting and performance analysis.
* Financial controls, audit requirements, data governance, security, regulatory compliance and operational risk.
* Practical application of generative AI, intelligent automation and analytics within a responsible finance environment.
* ERP optimisation, workflow tools, reporting platforms, APIs and secure systems integration.
* Leadership and influencing skills to mobilise teams, challenge established practices and build confidence in new ways of working.
* Clear stakeholder communication, translating complex finance, control and technology topics into decisions and actions.

 **QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE**

  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems or a related discipline.
* 10\+ years’ experience in finance digitalisation, financial systems and ERP, internal controls, reporting, process improvement and team leadership.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle Financial ERP and enterprise\-scale finance transformation.

 **NICE\-TO\-HAVE**

  

* Professional finance certification, such as CPA or CFA, is desirable.
* Experience with Oracle reporting and analytics tools, such as OAC, OTBI or equivalent enterprise solutions.
* Knowledge of treasury platforms such as Kyriba.
* Experience using process\-mining platforms or methodologies in ERP\-based finance processes.

 **WHAT WE OFFER**

  

We’re all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We’re proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
##### **About our Crew**


Click\&Boat is a rental platform product of Boats Group, the fastest\-growing digital business in the recreational boating space. We are a talented team of techies, creatives, marketers, closers and customer advocates who spend each day pushing the boundaries of technology to make buying, selling \& renting boats easy. We spend each day surrounded by 500,000 boats from across the globe!


Click\&Boat is the European leader in boat rentals. Our marketplace makes boating accessible around the world, from a day trip to a week\-long adventure, while enabling private and professional boat owners to generate additional income through rentals.


**How do we do it?**


At Click\&Boat, we believe in empowering our developers to build the company's strategy and shape the future of boating. People joining Click\&Boat are always delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

* **Product\-Focused:** Our focus is on delivering exceptional products that truly benefit our users.
* **Data\-Driven:** We prioritize data\-driven decisions to ensure our products meet user needs.
* **Tech for Purpose:** We believe technology is a means to solve real problems, not an end.
* **Full Empowerment**: Our developers are not just coders; they are strategic partners who have a direct impact on our product roadmap and company objectives.
* **Full Transparency**: You'll have access to the entire company strategy and be a key player in achieving our OKRs.
* **Boring architecture:** we are always seeking the simplest solution for our complex challenges… and that is not simple! (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=msnQbIQFsw4 if you want to know more).
* **Diversity :** We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace, where all individuals are valued and respected.


️ **The Engineering Team ️**


Our engineering team is currently composed of 4 agile squads, each responsible for a specific functional scope. As we expand into the US market, we will grow to 6 squads, with two new squads dedicated to building and scaling our product for US users. Together, the teams build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications that provide a first\-class experience for our users: boat owners, customers renting boats, and Click\&Boat internal teams.


By joining Click\&Boat, you’ll meet a team of talented, committed, and passionate engineers with a lot of product interactions. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of projects quickly, whilst being mentored by talented senior engineers who have made significant contributions at renowned companies like Doctolib (VP of Engineering, Engineering Director \& Principal Engineer) and ManoMano.


We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems! Being a developer at Click\&Boat means more than just coding. Our developers are also responsible for preparing their features, collaborating with product managers and designers, monitoring and validating features once in production.


Our stack includes up\-to\-date Angular, PHP, MySQL, Symfony.


️ Are you the one **we’re looking for? ️**


We are looking to recruit a Senior Engineering Manager who will manage **two squads.**

**You're a Great Fit at Click\&Boat if:**

* You are fluent in English. French is a plus.
* You enjoy delivering features that impact the company's KPIs ;
* You have solid experience delivering high\-quality feature ;
* You have at least 5 years of experience managing a technical team ;
* You enjoy supporting and coaching your individual contributors, providing regular feedback to help them grow in line with company\-wide objectives ;
* You feel comfortable working with various stakeholders across the company ;
* You’re a clear and effective communicator with your teammates.

**What We Value :**

* **Customer Focus:** Understanding our customers and fully embracing our mission will make your journey with us exciting and fulfilling.
* **Curiosity Acumen:** We seek individuals who are curious and eager to learn.
* **Diversity and Inclusion:** We value and actively promote gender diversity and inclusion. We appreciate candidates with diverse backgrounds.
* **Boat Interest:** We appreciate candidates with a background or interest in boating. If you share our passion for the industry, it's a significant advantage.


Make sure to highlight these qualities during your interviews.

**What awaits you on board**

* 8 additional days off;
* Lunch vouchers (Cobee);
* Gym partnerships (Wellhub);
* PNB Boat licence offered and exclusive discounts on your next boat trips;
* Breakfast every Tuesday morning;
* A welcoming office in Barcelona, next to the centrally located Cathedral and just a 20\-minute walk from the sea;
* Team\-building activities.
* Hybrid role based in Barcelona, with 3 days per month spent in Paris — around 6 to 9 trips per year.

**Contract: Permanent position**

**Start date: ASAP**


Ready to take the helm and drive our success? Join Click\&Boat and be part of a team where your voice truly matters. Let's navigate the future of boating together!

title: Client Advisor, Casa LOEWE Barcelona
description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.
  

  

As **Client Advisor** , you will ensure that our client service expectations are exceeded in a personable, playful, and engaging way, enabling you to deliver your individual and team goals.


### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will be:**

* Achieve individual and store objectives.
* Connect with clients in an engaging emotional way to provide an exceptional and memorable client experience.
* Engage with all clients and develop long lasting relationships.
* Maintain relations with clients through regular communication and connection via email, phone, messages, or personalized notes.
* Master and transmit our brand history and heritage.
* Highlight our product categories through your product knowledge and storytelling.
* Develop and grow your client book, updating client information on the relevant company tools.
* Perform as a team player, participating and collaborating in all activities contributing to the overall objectives of the store.
* Actively participate in visual merchandising in accordance with LOEWE’s visual standards.
* Maintain products in an efficient, clean, secure, and organized manner; front and back of house.
* Support with inventory management and ad hoc back of house tasks.
* Follow the company’s policies and procedures including LOEWE’s standards in terms of grooming and behavior.
### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* Proven experience in achieving individual goals and contributing to team results.
* Experience within a similar customer centric role.
* Deep interest in Fashion, Art, and Culture.
* Be naturally inclusive and open minded.
* Confident, service orientated, adaptable and empathetic in style and approach.
* Effective communication skills with the sensitivities to build and maintain a client portfolio.
* Results driven with a commercial mindset without compromising on the Team Player attitude.
* Fluent in English and Spanish; any other language will be considered a plus.
### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. title: Podcast Producer
description:
**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for an organized, creative and hands\-on **Podcast** **Producer** to lead the end\-to\-end production and delivery of Alea’s two podcasts.


The Podcast Producer will be responsible for the complete operational process, from initial planning and pre\-production through recording, post\-production, approval and final publication. The role will ensure that every episode is produced on time, meets Alea’s quality standards and supports the company’s communications and brand objectives.


Working closely with the **Head of PR \& Communications**, the **Podcast** **Producer** will help define the strategy, positioning, editorial direction and distribution approach for both podcasts. This person will then translate that strategy into a structured production plan and manage its day\-to\-day execution.


This role is ideal for someone who combines editorial judgement, project management and technical production skills and who is comfortable coordinating guests, managing recordings, reviewing edits and overseeing publication across multiple platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1\.** **Podcast** **Strategy and Editorial Planning**

* Define the strategy, positioning, objectives and target audience for both podcasts in collaboration with the Head of PR \& Communications.
* Contribute ideas for themes, episode topics, formats, guests and editorial series.
* Develop and manage an editorial calendar and release schedule for both podcasts.
* Ensure podcast topics and guests are aligned with Alea’s brand positioning, communications priorities and business objectives.
* Research relevant industry topics, trends and conversations to identify new editorial opportunities.
* Prepare episode concepts and proposals for review and approval by the Head of PR \& Communications.
* Regularly review the performance and direction of both podcasts and recommend strategic improvements.

### **2\. Pre\-production**

* Manage the complete pre\-production process for every episode.
* Research topics, guests and relevant background information.
* Identify and coordinate potential guests in collaboration with the Head of PR \& Communications and other stakeholders.
* Manage guest invitations, confirmations, calendars and all pre\-recording communications.
* Prepare episode briefs, scripts, interview structures, talking points and run\-of\-show documents.
* Organize recording schedules, locations and required resources.
* Coordinate studios, external production partners or technical suppliers when needed.
* Confirm that recording equipment, software, lighting, sound and other technical requirements are ready before each session.
* Brief hosts, guests and relevant stakeholders before recording.
* Ensure all necessary permissions, consent forms and content approvals are obtained.

### **3\. Recording and Live Production**

* Lead and coordinate each recording session, ensuring the process runs smoothly from start to finish.
* Set up or supervise cameras, microphones, lighting and recording software.
* Perform technical checks before every recording.
* Direct hosts and guests during the session when required.
* Monitor audio and video quality throughout the recording.
* Follow the agreed episode structure while allowing space for natural and engaging conversations.
* Identify strong moments, quotes and potential promotional clips during the recording.
* Resolve operational or technical issues quickly and efficiently.
* Ensure all recorded material is correctly saved, backed up and organized after each session.

### **4\. Post\-production and Quality Control**

* Manage the full post\-production process for every episode.
* Edit or coordinate the editing of audio and video content.
* Review all edits and provide clear feedback to internal or external editors.
* Ensure the final episode has strong pacing, narrative flow and consistent audio and video quality.
* Coordinate the addition of intros, outros, music, graphics, subtitles and other branded elements.
* Identify and prepare the strongest moments for trailers, teasers and promotional clips.
* Ensure every episode follows Alea’s brand guidelines and editorial standards.
* Manage the internal review and approval process with the Head of PR \& Communications.
* Complete a final quality check before publication, including audio, video, titles, descriptions, links, subtitles and visual assets.
* Maintain an organized archive of raw recordings, project files, final episodes and supporting materials.

### **5\. Publication and Distribution**

* Manage the publication of each episode across the relevant podcast and video platforms.
* Upload and publish episodes on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Amazon Music, Audible, YouTube and any other selected distribution channels.
* Prepare accurate and engaging episode titles, descriptions, show notes, timestamps and supporting copy.
* Coordinate thumbnails, cover images and other visual assets with the Design team.
* Ensure episodes are correctly categorized, tagged and optimized for discoverability.
* Coordinate publication dates and promotional activity with the Head of PR \& Communications and Social Media \& Content Manager.
* Verify that every episode is published correctly and is accessible across all relevant platforms.
* Update or correct published content when necessary.
* Ensure podcast information and episodes are properly featured on alea.com when relevant.

### **6\. Promotional Content Coordination**

* Identify the strongest quotes, insights and moments from each episode for promotional use.
* Create or coordinate trailers, teasers, audiograms and short\-form video clips.
* Provide the Social Media \& Content Manager with the materials, context and key messages needed to promote each episode.
* Collaborate on the preparation of an episode\-specific promotional plan.
* Ensure all promotional assets are delivered before the agreed publication date.
* Coordinate with the Design team on thumbnails, templates, graphics and other branded materials.
* Support the repurposing of podcast episodes into articles, social media posts and other communication formats.

### **7\. Production and Stakeholder Management**

* Own and maintain the production workflow for both podcasts.
* Coordinate hosts, guests, internal teams, studios and external suppliers.
* Create clear timelines and ensure all milestones and publication deadlines are met.
* Keep the Head of PR \& Communications informed about progress, risks, delays and required decisions.
* Manage feedback and approvals efficiently to avoid production bottlenecks.
* Maintain production documentation, episode trackers, guest information and content archives.
* Monitor external production costs and resources when applicable.
* Identify opportunities to make the production process more efficient, scalable and consistent.

### **8\. Performance Analysis and Optimization**

* Track podcast performance across the relevant distribution and video platforms.
* Monitor metrics such as downloads, plays, views, watch time, audience retention, completion rate and subscriber growth.
* Analyse performance by podcast, episode, topic, guest and content format.
* Prepare regular performance reports with key findings and actionable recommendations.
* Report results and insights to the Head of PR \& Communications.
* Use audience and performance data to improve topics, formats, episode duration, production and distribution.
* Monitor podcast trends, competitors and industry benchmarks to identify opportunities for growth.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* At least **2–3 years of experience** in podcast, audio, video, broadcast or digital content production.
* Demonstrable experience managing the complete podcast production process, from pre\-production to publication.
* Experience recording and editing professional audio and video content.
* Hands\-on knowledge of microphones, cameras, lighting, recording software and editing tools.
* Experience with podcast hosting and distribution platforms, as well as YouTube Studio.
* Strong editorial judgement and storytelling skills.
* Ability to prepare briefs, scripts, interview structures and production documents.
* Excellent organizational and project management skills.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to manage multiple episodes, deadlines and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Confident working with senior leadership, hosts, guests and external suppliers.
* Proactive, resourceful and comfortable taking ownership of the full production process.
* Full professional proficiency in English.
* Spanish proficiency is considered an advantage.
* Previous experience in B2B, technology, media or iGaming is desirable.

**What We Offer**

As it’s not all work, we maintain the team spirit with team building events, parties and workshops where you can enjoy our achievements. When you leave in the afternoon, you can join our paddle tennis games near the office.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**The role**


You will own our most senior internal searches end to end, from first conversation with the candidate through to offer. The people you'll be hiring are directors and C\-level, so you are the first impression this company makes on them. You'll run intake directly with our founders and department heads, which includes telling them when the brief they've given you will not produce the hire they want.


This is not a coordination role. It is not suited to someone who needs the search strategy decided before they start.  

  

**Who we are**


AI Acquisition is a multi\-8\-figure business helping founders and operators scale with AI. T vchousands of clients, hundreds of mastermind participants, with the US as our primary market. We're bootstrapped with no outside capital, so we set our own timelines and hire people who can operate without a script.


Our Talent function was built from zero in the last fifteen months: ATS, AI screening gates, tiered assessment frameworks, and a hiring bar the founders now use. A delivery team handles high\-volume pipeline operations. You'll take whatever needs judgement, at any level, and you'll pick up the rest when the load demands it.

 **Requirements** **Engagement and hours**


This is an independent contractor engagement, not employment. You invoice monthly and handle your own tax and statutory obligations in your country of residence.


Expect a 50 to 60 hour week. Our team spans the UAE, the UK and the US, and this role holds the middle of that span. Your day starts on UAE business hours and runs into the US East Coast morning, with senior candidate calls landing outside conventional hours.


We say this plainly because the people who do well here choose it. If you need fixed hours, this is not the right role and we would rather you know before you apply.  

  

**What you'll own**

* The full range of searches, end to end, several at once. A C\-level hire and a junior specialist role in the same week, and both get done properly
* Pipeline building ahead of the requisition. Talent mapped, warmed and ready before the role opens, not scrambled when it does
* Candidate engagement over months, not days. Keeping strong people warm when there is nothing live for them, and giving them a reason to take your call the next time
* Employer brand in practice. Being able to answer "why would I leave what I have for AIA" with something specific and true, and building the narrative that makes senior people want the conversation
* Strategic advisory to hiring managers. Market reality, realistic timelines, what the role needs to pay, and when the brief they've written will not produce the hire they want
* Intake and calibration with founders and department heads, including the disagreement
* First contact with director and C\-level candidates, and being the reason they stay in process instead of going quiet
* Direct sourcing where no pipeline exists and inbound is useless
* Written candidate evaluations a founder can decide on without a follow\-up call
* Quality oversight on shortlists coming through the delivery team  

Testing what works. Running A/B on titles, post copy and channels, and making the call on what to keep based on quality of applicant rather than volume
* Assessment design and execution. Building and running structured evaluations, scorecards and one\-way assessments against a defined hiring bar, not judging on gut

**What you need**

* 6\+ years in talent acquisition, at least 3 of them in\-house, embedded or RPO. Agency\-only will not clear the bar
* Senior or leadership search experience. Volume\-only backgrounds are not a fit for this seat
* Demonstrable hiring into the US or UK market, representing an employer to candidates in that market
* Near\-native spoken and written English. You will improvise on camera with senior people, not read from notes
* Evidence of managing senior stakeholders, including disagreeing with them productively
* Direct sourcing that works, with response rates you can point to
* Comfortable operating as an independent contractor, invoicing monthly and managing your own tax position
* Real schedule flexibility across UAE, UK and US East Coast hours. Calls outside standard business hours are routine, not occasional
* Evidence of building talent pipelines ahead of demand, not only filling open roles reactively
* You have kept candidates engaged over months and converted them later. You can name one
* You can articulate an employer value proposition and adapt it by audience, rather than repeating the careers page
* Experience designing or running structured candidate assessments. Scorecards, structured interviews, work samples, psychometric or cognitive tools
* You have tested and iterated on your own job posts and can tell us what changed and what it produced
* An active, credible LinkedIn presence. You post, you engage, and people in your market know who you are. Passive profiles will not clear this bar

**What stands out**

* Multi\-country or multi\-entity hiring
* You've built process, not only run someone else's
* You've been the only recruiter in the room and it was fine
* You've overseen or coached junior recruiters
* You've run A/B tests on titles, posts or channels and have the data to show for it
* AI\-assisted sourcing and outreach stack. Clay, HeyReach, n8n, Exa, or equivalent. Name what you've built with it, not what you've heard of
* You've built a talent pipeline that produced a hire months after the first conversation
* You've worked somewhere with no employer brand and had to create the reason people said yes

  

**Benefits** **What you get**

**Up to $80K/Annually**, as an independent contractor, based on experience

**Direct access to founders.** You will sit in calibration with the people who make the decisions. No layers between you and the call

**A real AI stack, used daily.** Clay, HeyReach, n8n, Exa, LLM screening built into the workflow. You will use agents as part of the job, not as a side experiment, and you will have room to build your own

**A seat that rewards building.** The function was built from zero in fifteen months. What you build here stays and gets used. If you want to inherit a finished process and maintain it, this is the wrong seat. If you want to put your own frameworks into a company that will actually run them, this is a rare one  

  

**How we hire**


Application, one\-way video, short written exercise, structured interview with our Global Head of People \& Talent, working session with a founder. You'll know where you stand at every stage.

title: Lead Product Designer, The Bump
description:
**ABOUT US**



In more than ten countries around the world, The Knot Worldwide champions the power of celebration. Our global family of brands provide best\-in\-class products, services and content to take celebration planning from inspiration to action. At the core of our business is our industry\-leading global online wedding Vendor Marketplace, connecting couples with local wedding professionals and a comprehensive suite of personalized wedding websites, planning tools, invitations, and registry services that make wedding planning easier for couples around the globe. Each year, we connect more than 4\.5 million users with around 900,000 global small businesses through our Vendor Marketplace.


**LIFE AT TKWW**



At The Knot Worldwide, we believe in doing work that matters. Each year, we help millions of couples around the world celebrate life's most meaningful moments, while also helping hundreds of thousands of global small business owners get discovered and scale. Life here means working alongside a team that cares deeply, not just about the work you do, but about the life you live. We prioritize employee well\-being and development through meaningful opportunities for growth, and we celebrate milestones and wins in a big way. After all, celebrations are what we do best.


**ABOUT THE ROLE AND OUR TEAM:**



We are looking for an experienced Lead Product Designer to join our Design team in Barcelona to lead day\-to\-day product design for The Bump, while supporting strategic media initiatives across The Knot Worldwide (TKWW) brand portfolio.



This role is structured so you spend most of your time on The Bump, shaping core consumer product features, content tools, and user journeys across web, iOS, and Android. The remaining time will focus on Global Media Sales (GMS), creating sponsored features and scalable monetization solutions that serve all TKWW brands.



You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Editorial, and GMS stakeholders to understand customer needs, define opportunities, and shape product strategy. Sitting at the intersection of trusted content, digital product tools, and media monetization, this role requires a designer who can balance user value with business outcomes and move fluidly between strategy, systems thinking, and execution.



The Knot Worldwide Design team is a close group of Product Designers, Product Writers, and Researchers who value strong craft, open critique, thoughtful collaboration, and shared ownership of the overall customer experience.

  


**RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Lead end\-to\-end product design for The Bump across web, iOS, and Android, owning day\-to\-day feature execution while setting the UX/visual quality bar and shaping core product strategy.
* Partner with the Global Media Sales (GMS) team to design sponsored content integrations and monetization touchpoints across the full family of TKWW brands.
* Partner directly alongside our Engineering and Product Management teams to shape direction, align execution priorities, and accelerate delivery timelines.
* Connect content, product functionality, and pathways that help users discover relevant tools on The Bump, while ensuring ad\-tech integrations across TKWW brands maintain customer trust and high usability standards.
* Drive design from problem framing through rapid prototyping, iteration, UX/UI design, and delivery\-ready specs, helping teams validate solutions quickly and move into development with clarity.

* Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with a portfolio showing polished execution, clear UX architecture, and scalable system patterns.
* Versatility to switch fluidly between core app/web product design (The Bump) and cross\-brand ad\-tech/monetization solutions (GMS across TKWW).
* Advanced systems thinking, with the ability to connect experiences across multi\-brand platforms, dynamic journeys, and commercial touchpoints.
* Strong product judgment, with experience using research, usability testing, and behavioral analytics to inform design choices.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills, with experience partnering closely with dev teams and Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Design leadership.
* A bias toward rapid prototyping and leveraging AI to make abstract ideas tangible, explore solutions quickly, and unblock engineering partners.
* Comfort navigating ambiguity, bringing structure to undefined problem spaces, and driving domain\-level alignment independently.
* Experience with consumer mobile apps, content\-rich platforms, ad\-tech, commerce, or multi\-brand ecosystems is a strong plus.

  


**WORK MODEL:**



This role is Together@TKWW\-eligible and based near one of our office hubs. You'll be expected to work in the office **two days a week** as part of our hybrid work model.



\#LI\-Hybrid



\#professional

title: Social Media Manager
description:
**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for a hands\-on, creative and content\-driven **Social Media Manager** to own and grow Alea’s presence across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Telegram and other relevant digital channels.


The person in this role will be responsible for developing and managing Alea’s monthly social media content plan, proactively proposing new ideas and formats, creating and editing content, coordinating publishing schedules, engaging with our online communities and analysing the performance of each channel.


You will report to the Head of PR \& Communications and work closely with the Head of Marketing, Megan, our Content Specialist, the Design team, Product team and other internal stakeholders to transform company news, product updates, industry insights, events and business initiatives into engaging, channel\-specific content.


This role is ideal for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands\-on execution: someone who can build a content plan, record and edit content, write compelling copy, manage multiple channels and use performance data to continuously improve results.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1\. Social Media Strategy and Monthly Content Planning**

* Develop and manage a structured **monthly social media content plan** aligned with Alea’s marketing priorities, business objectives, product launches, events and industry calendar.
* Proactively propose new content ideas, formats, campaigns and storytelling opportunities.
* Define the most appropriate content pillars, formats, publishing frequency and messaging for each platform.
* Manage the complete content workflow, from ideation and briefing to production, approval, scheduling and publication.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to collect the information and materials required to deliver content on time.
* Work closely with Megan, our Content Specialist, to align the social media plan with the wider editorial calendar, content priorities and upcoming campaigns.
* Maintain an up\-to\-date editorial calendar and ensure a consistent flow of relevant content throughout the month.
* Adapt content to the audience, purpose and best practices of each channel.
* Ensure all content follows Alea’s brand positioning, tone of voice and visual identity.

### **2\. Content Creation, Recording and Editing**

* Act as a hands\-on content creator for Alea, producing engaging content for social media and other digital channels.
* Record video content at the office, conferences, events, interviews, product presentations and behind\-the\-scenes moments.
* Edit videos into Reels, Shorts, interviews, event recaps and other short\-form or long\-form formats.
* Repurpose webinars, events, presentations and interviews into multiple pieces of social media content.
* Write engaging captions, scripts, headlines, interview questions and calls to action.
* Collaborate with the Content Specialist to adapt articles, interviews, thought\-leadership pieces and other editorial materials into effective social media content.
* Create platform\-specific content for LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Telegram and other relevant channels.
* Work with the Design team on more complex visual assets, animations, branded templates and campaign materials.
* Ensure all audiovisual content is professional, on\-brand and optimized for each platform.
* Stay up to date with content formats, editing styles and social media trends, identifying which ones are relevant to Alea’s B2B audience.

### **3\. Channel Management and Community Engagement**

* Manage Alea’s day\-to\-day presence across its social media channels.
* Schedule and publish content consistently according to the approved content plan.
* Monitor comments, messages, mentions and relevant industry conversations.
* Engage with clients, partners, operators, industry professionals and other members of the iGaming community.
* Support relevant employee advocacy and leadership content when required.
* Amplify PR, event, product and company content in a timely manner.
* Protect and strengthen Alea’s tone of voice across every interaction.
* Identify opportunities to join relevant industry conversations and increase the visibility of the brand.

### **4\. Channel Analysis and Optimization**

* Regularly assess the role, audience and performance of each social media channel.
* Identify which platforms and content formats should be prioritized based on Alea’s objectives and audience behaviour.
* Analyse reach, impressions, engagement, audience growth, video views, website traffic and conversions.
* Compare performance by channel, topic, format and content pillar.
* Use insights to improve future content plans, publishing schedules and creative approaches.
* Identify underperforming channels or formats and recommend actions to improve, reposition or deprioritize them.
* Monitor competitors, B2B marketing trends and relevant conversations within the iGaming industry.

### **5\. YouTube and Social Video Content**

* Publish and manage Alea’s social video content on YouTube and other relevant social media channels.
* Ensure video titles, descriptions, thumbnails and supporting copy are accurate, engaging and aligned with Alea’s brand.
* Adapt and repurpose content from events, webinars, interviews and company activities into engaging social media videos.
* Create and edit short\-form video content tailored to each platform and audience.
* Coordinate with the Design team when additional visual assets or branded elements are required.
* Monitor video performance and use the results to improve future content.

### **6\. Website and Blog Content**

* Transform interviews, events, product information and industry insights into engaging, SEO\-friendly blog articles.
* Upload and publish company news, product updates, event recaps and thought\-leadership content.
* Keep the blog and relevant website sections current, clean and well organized.
* Coordinate website content updates with the appropriate internal stakeholders.
* Ensure website content is accurate, engaging, on\-brand and optimized for organic visibility.

### **7\. Collaboration with the Content Specialist**

* Work closely with Megan, our Content Specialist, to ensure strong alignment between Alea's editorial content and social media activity.
* Coordinate content calendars, priorities, messaging and delivery timelines to ensure both roles work in a complementary and efficient way.
* Transform long\-form editorial content, interviews, articles and industry insights into platform\-specific social media formats.
* Share social media trends, audience feedback and channel\-performance insights with the Content Specialist to inform future editorial opportunities.
