title: RevOps Product Owner – AI & Automation
description:
**Descripción de la empresa**


Doctoralia es una plataforma global líder en el sector de la salud digital. Nuestro objetivo es conectar pacientes con profesionales de la salud de forma sencilla, rápida y eficiente. ¿Cómo hacemos esto? A través del marketplace y la App móvil, conseguimos que los usuarios puedan buscar profesionales y/o clínicas del sector privado, leer reseñas de pacientes, consultar la disponibilidad y reservar directamente online.


Doctoralia forma parte del grupo Docplanner desde 2017, una empresa multinacional con presencia en más de 13 países.


Contamos con el respaldo de inversores como Goldman Sachs, One Peak Partners, Point Nine y Target Global, hemos recaudado más de 450 millones de euros y estamos cerca de alcanzar la rentabilidad con más de 180 millones € ARR.


Buscamos un/a **RevOps Product Owner – AI \& Automation** para ser dueño/a de cuatro productos clave de RevOps en España como un portafolio: diagnosticar qué está roto o falta acercándote a cómo se hace el trabajo realmente, escribir las specs que justifican el caso de negocio, negociar prioridad con los equipos globales que controlan estos sistemas, y construir directamente lo que esté al alcance local — incluyendo testeo práctico y prototipado de herramientas e integraciones, aunque la implementación final sea de otro equipo.

### **Los productos de los que serás dueño/a**

* **CRM Process \& Automation** — la salud de nuestros flujos comerciales core en Salesforce/HubSpot: cumplimiento de SLA, higiene de pipeline y la automatización declarativa que mantiene los registros correctos a medida que deals y leads avanzan por el funnel — por ejemplo, que una propiedad se actualice automáticamente cuando un deal pasa a la siguiente etapa — además de la infraestructura de dashboards/reporting que los equipos usan cada día.
* **Lead Creation \& Assignment** — la lógica de enrutamiento y asignación que lleva cada lead al rep correcto en el momento correcto (construida sobre DP Lead), evolucionando hacia un modelo ponderado por capacidad y rendimiento en lugar de round\-robin plano.
* **Omni\-Channel** — la capa de WhatsApp (Kraken), llamadas, email/secuencias y agendamiento/calendario en todo el journey de sales \+ CS: qué canal, qué mensaje, en qué secuencia y cuándo — incluyendo el agendamiento y reagendamiento de demos, onboarding y reuniones de farming.
* **CRM UI/UX** — la experiencia diaria real que tienen reps y team leads dentro del CRM: comportamiento del action center, vistas, filtros y los gaps que causan tareas perdidas o workarounds mal usados.

### **Qué harás**

* **Ser dueño/a del backlog de cada producto** — diagnosticar qué está roto, falta o funciona mal en las cuatro áreas, acercándote a las personas que hacen el trabajo: shadowing, entrevistas, peticiones directas y observación propia — no suposiciones.
* **Triar lo que es tuyo** — las peticiones rutinarias de business\-as\-usual van a COE como siempre; los bottlenecks reales e issues sistémicos llegan a tu backlog para un zoom\-in adecuado.
* **Escribir las specs que justifican el caso** — convertir un problema diagnosticado en una solicitud clara y priorizada: qué está mal, qué nos cuesta, cómo sería la solución, por qué vale la pena el tiempo de ingeniería global.
* **Negociar prioridad con los equipos globales dueños de estos sistemas** — la mayoría de los cambios core en Salesforce, Kraken y otras plataformas subyacentes solo pueden hacerlos equipos fuera de RevOps España; tú eres quien construye el caso de negocio y asegura un lugar en su roadmap.
* **Testear y prototipar, de forma práctica** — validar herramientas de terceros, prototipar integraciones y entender cómo se conectan las piezas antes de pasar una spec al equipo que la construirá. Construir directamente la automatización y configuración que esté al alcance local.
* **Medir lo que lanzas o desbloqueas** — horas ahorradas, impacto en conversión/engagement y adopción, por producto. Reportar en términos de los OKRs de RevOps.
* **Hacerlo repetible** — documentar lo que funciona en playbooks o templates reutilizables.

### **Qué buscamos**

* Conocimiento profundo de las herramientas y procesos de GTM de Doctoralia España — ya lo tienes en la mayoría de estas cuatro áreas.
* Mentalidad de builder para lo que sí es construible localmente, e instinto de tester para validar herramientas e integraciones antes de que se entreguen a otro equipo. Experiencia práctica con automatización de Salesforce/HubSpot (flows, reglas de validación, triggers) es un plus importante.
* Comunicación escrita sólida — capaz de convertir un problema reportado de forma informal en una spec clara y convincente que un equipo global, con sus propias prioridades, realmente atienda.
* Cómodo/a negociando capacidad de ingeniería escasa con equipos que no te reportan, y dando seguimiento hasta que se lance.
* Fluidez en español e inglés.

### **Métricas de éxito**


La medida principal de éxito es el **throughput por operador de GTM** — cada cambio lanzado debe permitir que la gente haga más de lo que ya se espera de ella, no solo "ahorrar tiempo" de forma abstracta. Se mide como una tendencia direccional para el rol afectado tras un cambio lanzado, no como una atribución estrictamente aislada — hay demasiadas otras iniciativas en paralelo (la migración a Salesforce, la ingeniería de outbound, etc.) como para separar causas de forma limpia. Esto se acumula en **revenue (o output) por FTE de GTM**, nuestra métrica de eficiencia principal.

**Throughput por rol (principal):**

* SDRs / reps de outbound — reuniones agendadas por rep por semana/mes.
* Account Executives — oportunidades avanzadas o deals cerrados por AE.
* Especialistas de onboarding — onboardings completados por especialista en un período dado.
* Reps de CS / soporte — casos o solicitudes resueltas por rep.
* Reps de farming / cuentas — acciones de renovación o upsell completadas por rep.

**Prerrequisito (hito inicial, no asumido):** la instrumentación fiable de throughput por rol todavía no existe del todo — el reporting ha sido poco fiable en varias de estas áreas hasta hace poco. Establecer un tracking de baseline limpio para al menos tres de los cinco roles anteriores (en parte a través del trabajo de dashboards de CRM Process \& Automation) es en sí mismo un entregable del primer trimestre, no algo asumido de antemano.

### **Qué ofrecemos**

* Ownership total de cuatro productos reales y ya diagnosticados — no ejecución de tareas, sino responsabilidad genuina de producto de principio a fin.
* Espacio para profundizar de forma práctica donde importa — testear, prototipar y conectar herramientas, no solo escribir specs.
* Un camino hacia un conocimiento más profundo de cómo está construido y configurado Salesforce internamente, más allá de lo que tendrías quedándote solo en el lado local/HubSpot.
* Colaboración directa con el Head of Revenue Operations y, una vez cubierta, con el/la futuro/a RevOps Product Manager – AI Solutions.
* Modelo de trabajo híbrido.

**Información adicional**


Salario adecuado a tu experiencia.


Lo más importante: un equipo increíble que te acompañará y te apoyará en el camino.


Seguro médico privado.


Día de cumpleaños libre para pasar el día con tus seres queridos.


Clases de idiomas gratuitas.


Acceso ilimitado al chat de iFeel para apoyo en salud mental y bienestar emocional.


Modalidad híbrida con presencia mínima de 1 día a la semana desde nuestras oficinas de Barcelona.

**Nuestro proceso de selección**

Primer match – Una charla con Fito (TAP).  

Conversación estratégica – Entrevista con Elías .


Presentación de un Business Case \- con Elías nuestro Head of RevOps.

* Strong portfolio or case studies demonstrating your UX process, including problem definition, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, iteration, and final solutions

* Experience creating and evolving UX/UI design systems, interaction patterns, and reusable component libraries
* Experience designing UX for both mouse \& keyboard and controller\-based interaction
* Experience validating UX solutions through usability testing, playtesting, player research, player feedback, analytics, telemetry, or similar methods
* Knowledge of accessibility principles in game UX

* Ability to work effectively with Game Design, UI Art, Engineering, Production, and QA, understand technical and production constraints, and incorporate them into UX solutions

* Experience working on sci\-fi, simulation, engineering, or other technically oriented games

* Report to the Production Director and be part of a Game design team
* Take ownership of UX across **Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2**, covering both existing systems and new features
* Identify player friction and usability problems, understand their root causes, and propose practical improvements

* Translate complex mechanics, systems, and requirements into clear and intuitive player experiences

* + player flows and navigation
	+ information architecture and interaction patterns
	+ menus, HUD, and in\-game interactions
	+ system feedback
	+ onboarding and discoverability
* Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and UX specifications, exploring and validating solutions early before significant development time is invested
* Take solutions beyond UX documentation where appropriate to your skill set – whether through polished UI/visual design, high\-fidelity prototyping, or contributing to UI integration and implementation
* Use playtesting, player feedback, analytics, telemetry, and other available evidence to validate solutions and guide iteration
* Follow UX solutions through development, review implementation, and help ensure the intended player experience is preserved in the final product
* Establish and evolve consistent UX principles, interaction patterns, and design systems across both games
* Clearly communicate UX problems, design decisions, and trade\-offs to stakeholders using evidence, player needs, and clear reasoning
* Balance usability with game depth, technical limitations, development cost, existing player expectations, and long\-term maintainability
* Help improve UX practices across the wider development team and ensure UX is considered throughout development rather than treated as a final review step

**What we value**
-----------------


* Hold yourself to A\-player standards
* **Player\-first thinking without oversimplification** – make complex systems understandable while preserving the depth that makes Space Engineers unique
* **Hands\-on, versatile design** – UX should not stop at diagrams or recommendations; be comfortable turning ideas into tangible solutions and contributing beyond a narrowly defined UX role when needed
* **Problem solving over screen production** – understand the underlying player problem before designing the interface
* **Systems thinking** – understand how individual interactions connect to the broader player experience
* **Strong judgment and prioritisation** – recognise where UX problems have the greatest impact, understand trade\-offs, and focus effort where it matters most
* **Clarity over cleverness** – favour solutions that players can understand naturally, without unnecessary complexity
* **Iteration over attachment** – explore quickly, test assumptions, take feedback well, and change direction when a better solution emerges
* **Ownership and proactivity** – do not wait for perfectly defined UX problems; identify what needs to be solved and help drive it forward
* **Evidence over opinion** – use player behaviour, usability principles, testing, and clear reasoning rather than personal preference
* **Clear and direct communication** – explain UX problems, decisions, and trade\-offs clearly and challenge ideas constructively

* Leave your mark on one of the most technically ambitious sandbox engineering games ever made.

description:
**Responsibilities**

  

Strategic Responsibilities

  

* Development and continuous improvement of the performance and portfolio governance framework for the Hub's digital and data initiatives.
* Accountability for end\-to\-end Business Case \& Value Realization — ensuring that promised benefits (adoption, savings, quality) are tracked, measured, and delivered.
* Accountability for Project \& Delivery Performance — ensuring that all projects are delivered within budget, scope, and timeline.
* Ownership of the digital product portfolio structure — creating global visibility across domains, products, maturity levels, and strategic alignment.
* Development and consolidation of the integrated digital product roadmap, including alignment with IT capacity and development capabilities.
* Prioritization of the AI use case pipeline based on business value, feasibility, and strategic fit.
* Design, implementation, and governance of the Hub\-wide KPI framework for projects and digital products.
* Team building — defining the target structure, recruiting, onboarding, and developing team members for Phase 2 growth.

  

Operational Responsibilities

  

* Operation of the Approval Gate for digitalization requests and projects — preparing decision recommendations for the Head of Hub.
* Continuous tracking of project progress across all Hub streams (Data, Digitalization \& AI) regarding budget, scope, timeline, and quality.
* Budget controlling for all transformation projects — planned vs. actual comparison, burn rate, forecast, Capex/Opex transparency.
* Prioritization and management of the cross\-stream backlog in collaboration with the Data Team (P2\) and Digitalization \& AI Team (P3\).
* Planning and communication of tool and feature releases in coordination with the Digitalization \& AI Team (P3\) and the Implementation Team (P4\).
* Analysis of digital product usage to define optimal user experience and derive improvement recommendations.
* Post\-go\-live benefit tracking — measuring adoption rates, realized savings, and qualitative impact against business case promises.
* Monitoring enablement progress of business units and tracking rollout milestone delivery by Digital Champions.
* Building and operating multi\-level dashboards (Power BI): strategic (SteerCo/Hub Lead), tactical (program level), and operational (project level).
* Close alignment and collaboration with all Hub teams and interfaces: P1 is the only function with Responsible (R) or Accountable (A) assignments across all four governance pillars. The Head of P1 coordinates closely with the Data Team for project data and KPI inputs, with the Digitalization \& AI Team for product performance and backlog, with the Implementation Team for release readiness and change status, and with Digital Champions for adoption data and domain milestones. P1 provides the consolidated performance view; the Head of Hub uses this as the basis for SteerCo reporting and strategic decisions.

 **Profile Requirements**

  

Professional Requirements

  

* University degree in business administration, business informatics, industrial engineering, or comparable qualification.
* 5\+ years of experience in project management, portfolio management, or performance management within a complex organization.
* Proven expertise in business case development and evaluation (ROI, NPV, TCO).
* Strong track record in designing and operating KPI frameworks and performance reporting systems.
* Hands\-on skills in dashboarding and reporting tools (Power BI, Excel, or comparable).
* Experience in budget controlling — creating cost transparency and managing variances.
* Knowledge of Agile (preferably SAFe) and traditional project management methodologies.
* Good understanding of digital products, data products, and IT delivery processes.
* Excellent German and English language skills.

  

Personal Requirements

  

* Entrepreneurial thinking — ability to build an entire function from scratch with a startup mentality.
* Leadership without a team (initially) — ability to deliver as a one\-person function while preparing for growth.
* Analytical and data\-driven — numbers, dashboards, and KPIs are the daily tools.
* Structured and systematic — bringing order to complexity across multiple parallel streams.
* Strong communication skills — ability to make complex performance data accessible for all audiences, from project teams to SteerCo.
* Diplomatically assertive — holding teams accountable and challenging constructively, including upward.
* Hands\-on mentality — willingness to build templates, dashboards, and processes personally before delegating.
* Resilience and patience — building a new function requires navigating ambiguity and incomplete data.

title: HEAD OF PRODUCTION
description:
**Presentación de grupo**  

We are TK Airport Solutions, a business unit of TKE Group.



TK Elevator (TKE) is a global leader in vertical transportation and urban mobility, providing engineering — from design through installation, maintenance and modernization — for elevators, escalators, moving walkways, passenger boarding bridges, stairlifts, platform lifts and home elevators. TKE employs more than 50\.000 people around the world, being present in more than 100 countries.

 **Quiénes somos**  

From our engineering and manufacturing site in Mieres, Asturias, TKAS offers a full portfolio of airport apron and gate mobility solutions. Our **passenger boarding bridges** connect terminals to aircraft safely and efficiently. Our **ground support equipment** covers preconditioned air, ground power units and potable water units for aircraft turnaround. Our **advanced visual docking guidance systems (A\-VDGS)**, including the LiDAR\-based Apron Vision, ensure precise and safe aircraft docking. Our **digital solutions** — MAX Automate, MAX Monitor \& Control and MAX Maintenance Manager — bring AI and remote operation to the apron.



We also provide **modernization and service** programs, including upgrades and spare parts that extend equipment life and performance, and we adapt this same engineering expertise to **seaports**, with our Seaport Passenger Boarding Bridges (SPBB) for ferry and cruise terminals.



Our equipment is used at more than 370 airports in over 100 countries, and TK Elevator boarding bridges have carried over 1\.8 billion passengers worldwide.



Joining TKAS means working on real engineering challenges at global scale, combining German engineering heritage with a strong local team in Asturias, and contributing to safer, smarter and more sustainable airport infrastructure.

 **Qué esperamos** **Key Responsibilities:**


* Lead the daily execution of production across assembly lines, workshops, shifts, and teams, ensuring compliance with safety, quality, delivery, and cost objectives.


* Exercise visible safety leadership on the shop floor, ensuring that higher\-risk tasks are properly controlled, and investigate incidents to implement sustainable corrective actions.


* Lead and develop direct labor, supervisors, and line leaders, ensuring appropriate staffing levels, shift planning, multi\-skilling, training, and succession planning.


* Ensure the stability, standardization, and performance of assembly lines and production processes, coordinating with Engineering on new products and process changes.


* Lead preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance of equipment and facilities, ensuring the availability, reliability, and legal compliance of production assets.


* Control production hours, efficiency, conversion cost, and cost centers, preparing and monitoring the annual production and maintenance budget.


* Apply Lean Manufacturing and Kaizen methodologies, with structured problem\-solving, to drive sustainable productivity and quality improvements.


* Propose and support the prioritization of industrial investments in production and maintenance, ensuring proper execution once approved.


* Coordinate closely with Logistics, PSM, Engineering, Quality, Projects, and HR to ensure material availability, sequencing, and on\-time delivery.


* Maintain a professional and constructive relationship with HR and worker representatives on matters within their scope.

 **A quién buscamos** **Requirements:**


* Degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Organization, or equivalent technical qualification.


* Solid, proven experience leading production in complex, configurable, or project\-based industrial environments.


* Demonstrable responsibility for direct labor, production supervisors, assembly lines, and operational results.


* Relevant experience in industrial maintenance or in close coordination with a maintenance function.


* Proven track record recovering production plans, managing bottlenecks, and stabilizing operational processes.


* Experience in labor relations, change management, and factory team development.


* Practical, hands\-on knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, problem\-solving, standardization, and visual management.


* User experience with ERP/MRP systems for production, cost, and maintenance control; knowledge of SAP is especially valued.


* Exposure to international environments or collaboration with plants and teams in other countries.


* Professional English to collaborate at Business Unit level and with other sites.


**Competencies we value**



Visible safety leadership, focus on execution and production results, people leadership and labor relations management, focus on maintenance and reliability, quality, productivity, and cost management, financial and budgetary control, and cross\-functional collaboration without encroaching on other areas' scope.

 **Contacto**  

APPLICATIONS VIA WEB

 **Qué ofrecemos**  


* The opportunity to lead production at a specialized, growing engineering and manufacturing center within the airport mobility sector.


* An on\-site leadership role in Mieres (Asturias), close to the shop floor and the production teams.


* Real opportunities for development and internal promotion within the organization, based on individual performance and business growth.


* Professional development within a specialized, expanding technical environment, part of the TK Elevator group.


* Terms to be negotiated based on the candidate's profile.

title: Head of GTM Systems & AI
description:
### **Introduction to the Team \& Role**



What if your team was the one that got to build the future of how a company runs — and tried it on itself first?

GTM Systems owns the tech stack behind 360Learning's commercial engine — Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment and AI tooling across sales, marketing, customer success and services. Our mission is to be a force multiplier for the business: making go\-to\-market faster, smarter and more effective.

We already have a high\-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level.

You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams and engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there.

This is a high\-impact role for someone who loves working at the intersection of product, systems, AI and go\-to\-market strategy.

### **Key Responsibility Areas**


* Own the internal AI operating model for GTM — the library of skills, agent evals, cost, adoption and ROI — in partnership with Data and Enablement.
* Keep the team a step ahead as customer zero for AI, turning what works into patterns other functions adopt.
* Own the long\-term design of the GTM stack — CRM, marketing automation, CS tooling — deciding what to build vs. buy.
* Help the company prioritize by identifying the best solution to each business problem and sizing its cost and feasibility.
* Lead and coach five senior ICs across Salesforce, marketing/BDR, CS systems and web ops. Set a high bar for documentation, testing and deployment — and hold it without slowing the team down.
* Run vendor management end to end: evaluations, the quarterly keep\-or\-kill review, and renewals.
* Partner as a peer to the leaders of Data, Enablement, Security, Finance and every commercial function.
* Drive adoption and change management for new GTM capabilities across distributed teams.
### **What You'll Do**

**Within 1 month, you will:**
* Know the team, the stack, and the cross\-functional leaders and teams you’ll partner with
* Understand the main business challenges and opportunities for each GTM function
* Own the team's current quarterly objectives and the routines that keep them visible.


  

**Within 3 months, you will:**
* Have taken one major cross\-functional change from plan to done
* Own the full vendor\-renewal cycle across the commercial stack
* Have co\-written the next quarter's objectives with the performance and enablement teams, each one stating the business problem, the current state, the expected impact and the plan.


  

**Within 6 months, you will:**
* Have co\-written the next quarter's objectives with the performance and enablement teams, each one stating the business problem, the current state, the expected impact and the plan.
* Have shipped at least one AI agent that watches business data and reaches people on its own, with a named business owner and outcome measures agreed before launch.
* Have a 12\-18 month roadmap, setting the high\-level vision across our systems infrastructure, ways of working, and AI portfolio


  

**Within 12 months, you will:**
* Show, in numbers, the capacity the commercial organization reinvested because of what the team built.
* Have a development path agreed with each member of the team.
* Have the team recognized as the company's reference for AI\-native operations
### **The Skill Set**


* 5\+ years across GTM systems, agentic/AI workflow products, revenue technology, enterprise SaaS — or an adjacent path like technical product management or consulting where you designed and shipped real systems with a strong AI mandate.
* Turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable tooling — you read a process, tell whether it's any good, spot where AI creates value, and judge when to automate (and when not to), across the full revenue engine.
* Have fluency in modern GTM systems: Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, routing, attribution, lead\-to\-quote, billing or customer lifecycle tools. Deep Salesforce fluency is a strong plus.
* Have built with modern AI tooling: agents, plugins or skills on top of LLMs, connectors to business systems, and evals that tell you whether an agent is good.
* You define KPIs, run experiments, and use data to prioritize where to invest and to measure real impact on pipeline, conversion, efficiency and revenue.
* You drive strategic alignment and executive communication — conclusion first, tradeoffs named, complex topics made simple — and you drive change through to adoption.
* Thrive in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments where the first version of the strategy has to be shaped, tested and improved quickly.

title: Founding Head of GTM - Cipherscale
description:
**The Opportunity:** **Zero\-to\-one category creation for AI\-Native Zero Trust Access**

**Cipherscale** is building an AI\-native Zero Trust access and enforcement plane for humans, software/workloads, and AI agents.


The product doctrine is simple: AI may reason and propose; deterministic policy authorizes; trusted enforcement executes.


**We are looking for a commercial founder/operator who can turn that architecture into a category, a repeatable customer problem, real deployments, and initial revenue.**

**Mission:** discover and prove the repeatable commercial truth for Cipherscale \- who urgently needs it, what gets them to deploy, what makes them pay, and what causes them to expand.

**What You Own**

* Own ICP discovery, exclusion criteria, buyer/champion mapping, problem validation, positioning, initial wedge, and design\-partner recruitment.
* Personally lead early customer discovery, technical/commercial conversations, executive outreach, design\-partner conversion, and initial closing.
* Build an evidence\-driven GTM system: every important assumption has supporting/contradicting evidence and a next falsification test.
* Use AI agents aggressively for research, account intelligence, personalization, competitive monitoring, meeting preparation, call synthesis, content, and experiment analysis.
* Work directly with the CEO on category creation and major strategic accounts.
* Work with Product and Engineering to convert recurring customer evidence into governed product inputs \- without turning prospect anecdotes into roadmap commitments.
* Define the first repeatable acquisition, deployment, conversion, and expansion motion before scaling a team.

**What This Role Is Not**

* It is **not** a traditional marketing leadership job.
* It is **not** an MQL, impressions, content\-calendar, or brand\-campaign role.
* It is **not** a decision to hire SDR, demand\-gen, content, and marketing\-ops teams **before** product\-market evidence exists.
* It is **not** ownership of OpenVPN growth. Rod, Head of Growth, owns the established\-business growth mandate;

**This role is focused on Cipherscale zero\-to\-one GTM and must collaborate cleanly without duplicating authority.**

**Important:**

* This is a full\-time remote job, and it will be **a long\-term** **B2B contract.**
* This can be **a permanent employment** opportunity for candidates based in **Spain, Poland, and Germany.**

**Our philosophy is that we are a small, close\-knit team, and we care deeply about you:**

* Highly competitive salary \+ Bonus
* Fully remote work environments.
* Self\-managed time off.

 **Who We Want**

* You have personally helped take a deeply technical B2B security, infrastructure, identity, developer, cloud, or AI


product from near\-zero to repeatable initial revenue.

* You can sit with a CISO, CTO, security architect, platform engineer, and AI\-platform leader and earn credibility.
* You understand enough security architecture to reason about identity, delegated authority, credentials, policy,


enforcement, trust boundaries, auditability, and blast radius.

* You are comfortable selling before there is a polished playbook and learning directly from rejection.
* You treat AI as operating leverage. Your instinct is to build agentic workflows before asking for headcount.
* You are analytical enough to distinguish activity from evidence and evidence from causality.
* You are comfortable challenging the CEO and product assumptions when customer evidence disagrees.

**Strong Background Signals**

* Early\-stage Zero Trust, identity, cloud security, developer security, infrastructure security, AI security, developer infrastructure, or adjacent enterprise\-security categories.
* Founder, first\-GTM, product\-led commercial operator, technical seller, or hands\-on GTM executive backgrounds can all fit.
* Large\-company titles alone are not compelling.

**Anti\-Profile**

* Your first answer to a growth problem is "hire a team."
* You depend on agencies for core positioning or customer discovery.
* You optimize lead volume before proving deployment and retention.
* You cannot personally run technical discovery or executive selling.
* You treat AI as a copywriting assistant rather than an operating system.
* You blur probabilistic AI recommendations with authorization or security enforcement.

**First 90 Days:** Window Expected outcome

* **0\-30 days:** 10\-15 qualified ICP conversations; \~5 credible design\-partner candidates; evidence\-backed recommendation on ICP, problem, buyer, positioning, and wedge.
* **31\-60 days:** Convert the strongest partners into real or production\-like deployments; measure time\-to\-value, blockers, security objections, and willingness to pay.
* **61\-90 days:** Target 5\+ production or production\-intent deployments where product readiness permits; first paying customers; prove or disprove repeatability with a second cohort; document the acquisition/onboarding motion.

**How Success Is Measured**

* **Business:** paid customers, initial ARR/MRR, expansion and eventually defensible unit economics.
* **Customer:** time\-to\-first\-value, production activation, repeated authorized usage, protected resources/principals,


retention and expansion.

* **Funnel:** qualified conversations \-\> design partners \-\> deployments \-\> production \-\> paid \-\> expansion.
* **Learning velocity:** experiment cycle time, evidence quality, speed at which weak assumptions are killed or corrected.

**Operating Model and Reporting**

**This role works directly with the CEO during zero\-to\-one discovery and partners closely with Rod, Head of Growth.**


Decision rights will be explicit: CipherScale market discovery cannot become an overlapping second growth


organization, and OpenVPN growth priorities cannot dilute CipherScale category discovery. As the motion becomes


repeatable, responsibilities can be consolidated based on evidence rather than titles.

**Security Expectations**

**You will operate with customer and prospect data, AI agents, email/CRM systems, call transcripts, and potentially**

**technical environments.** Treat agents as potentially compromised actors. Use scoped identities, least privilege,


deterministic authorization for external actions, credential isolation, customer\-data boundaries, prompt\-injection


defenses, audit trails, and human approval for high\-impact commitments until explicitly delegated.

**Compensation Philosophy**

**We would rather pay exceptional compensation and meaningful upside for one outstanding founder\-level operator**

**than assemble a large conventional GTM organization.** Final structure should reflect experience, location, scope, and


demonstrated ability to create zero\-to\-one enterprise value.

**The Test**


A strong candidate should be able to take the Cipherscale thesis, identify the first market to attack, design the first ten


customer experiments, explain what evidence would invalidate the strategy, and show how they would use AI to


execute the work with minimal human headcount.

title: Digital Product Owner – EMR & API Integration
description:
*At the Vitrolife Group, we work every day to unlock the full potential of science and technology to reduce the barriers towards building a family. Together we help our customers and their patients to fulfill the dream of having a baby.*

###### **We are looking for a** **Digital Product Owner – EMR \& API Integration** **to join our Customer Success Development team.**


Help shape how fertility clinics connect their EMR systems with Vitrolife's products and services—and make every day work simpler for the people supporting patients on their journey to parenthood.


Our vision is to create a connected, scalable integration experience that makes clinic onboarding and integration quick and easy, improves workflows in IVF clinics and within Vitrolife, and makes it simpler for clinics to work with Vitrolife products and services, including genetic testing, time\-lapse systems, and electronic witnessing solutions.


The product is at an early stage, with an initial MVP. This is a hands\-on building role in which you will help develop the product into a scalable offering and establish effective ways of working as the domain grows. Strong technical product judgment will be especially valuable in the near term as you work closely with the Tech Lead, developers, and external technical teams. As the product develops, the role will increasingly focus on business value, adoption, and expansion.

##### **Main Purpose**


You own product direction, scope, priorities, and outcomes, aligned with business strategy. You are accountable for value realization, return on investment (ROI), risk management, and long\-term product health. The Tech Lead owns architecture and technical direction.


You will work directly with fertility clinics to understand their workflows and needs. Your other primary external collaborators are EMR providers, with occasional contact with customers' integration partners. Internally, Business Process Owners are your key collaborators for process and data requirements.


Location: Valencia \| 4\+1 remote work policy \| Full\-time


Reports to: Head of Customer Care Center of Excellence (CoE).


Please note that only CVs submitted in English will be reviewed.

##### **Key****Responsibilities**

**Product Direction \& Delivery**  

Own and communicate the vision, roadmap, backlog, and release priorities. Prioritize by value, reuse, risk, dependencies, feasibility, and total cost of ownership. Define requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria; accept delivered functionality and validate outcomes with Business Process Owners and subject matter experts.

**Customer \& Internal Process Requirements**  

Talk directly with clinics to understand and validate what they need to send, receive, and retrieve through their EMRs. With Business Process Owners, define the data, quality, completeness, and timing needed for efficient internal processes.

**API \& EMR Provider Experience**  

Make integrations straightforward to implement and support, covering API documentation, onboarding, testing, production readiness, monitoring, support, versioning, and backward compatibility. Balance provider\-specific needs with consistent, scalable API capabilities.

Work with the Tech Lead, developers, and external technical teams on product options and trade\-offs; provide technically credible feedback on reliability, security, privacy, data flows, and integration design. Align shared capabilities and dependencies with other Digital Product Owners, the Enterprise Architect, and enabling teams; resolve or escalate cross\-domain conflicts.

**Adoption \& Continuous Improvement**  

Coordinate rollout and operational readiness with EMR providers, Customer Success, and internal teams. Use feedback and KPIs to improve adoption, data quality, integration reliability, operational efficiency, and realized business value.  

  

**What You Need to Succeed**


Predictable EMR onboarding, growing adoption of reusable integrations, and reliable data flows that reduce manual work and improve customer and internal processes.

##### **Core Requirements**

* Proven experience personally building and scaling a B2B API or integration product from MVP or first production launch to adoption across multiple customers or systems.
* 5\+ years in product ownership or product management, combining product strategy with hands\-on prioritization and delivery in agile or product\-oriented environments.
* Strong technical product experience from software, APIs, or integrations, including the ability to give constructive feedback, discuss solution options with internal developers and external technical teams, and translate clinic workflows and internal process needs into API requirements.
* Technical fluency in APIs, data contracts, authentication, versioning, backward compatibility, and reliability. Able to read API documentation, follow data flows, and make technically credible product trade\-offs with the Tech Lead and developers; coding is not required.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills, including collaboration with Business Process Owners, aligning expectations, and saying no to misaligned or low\-value requests.
* Fluent English, written and verbal.
##### **Additional Qualification**

* EMR/EHR, healthcare, or laboratory\-system experience, and familiarity with standards such as FHIR or HL7\.
* Previous experience as a software or integration developer, solution architect, technical business analyst, or implementation consultant is beneficial but not required.

##### **What We Offer**

* Meaningful product ownership in an international healthcare company, working closely with business, IT, and product colleagues.
* Competitive compensation, medical insurance, and flexible benefits.
* Discounts on our employee platform and gym memberships.

 **Please submit your CV in English. Interviews will be conducted in English.**

###### ***The employee will be based in Valencia (Parque Tecnológico de Paterna)***

**Vitrolife Group is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities.**

*Vitrolife Group is a global provider of medical devices and genetic services. Based on science and advanced research capabilities, we develop services and products for personalised genetic information and medical device products. We support our customers by improving their clinical practice for the patient's outcome of a fertility treatment.*

*We are currently approximately 1 100 colleagues worldwide, with headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden. Vitrolife Group's products and services are available in more than 110 countries through our own presence in 30 countries and a network of distributors. Vitrolife Group is a sustainable market leader and aims to be the preferred partner for IVF\-clinics by providing superior products and services with the vision of fulfilling the dream of having a baby. The Vitrolife share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm.*

title: Head DDIT ISC Software Development Governance, Integrity & Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
description:

This role makes secure, compliant, audit\-ready software delivery the fastest path for engineers — not a gate they route around. You will own the enterprise SDLC governance model and build much of it yourself: policy as code, automated evidence capture, pipeline controls and reference architectures.  

  

This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor leadership role. You will set enterprise direction, influence hundreds of engineers and lead through a federated community — but you will not have a large direct team, and you will spend meaningful time in repositories, pipelines and control code. Candidates seeking pure oversight or people management should not apply.
### **About the Role**

\#LI\-Hybrid

description:

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal and Belgium.

* Own banking experience design from discovery delivery measurable impact
* Design and iterate on high\-frequency surfaces that balance simplicity with functional depth
* Diagnose and improve daily\-use flows: account management, payments, card features, navigation
* Lead discovery with customers, synthesize usage data and research insights into decisions

* Proven **end\-to\-end ownership** with shipped outcomes and impact validation
* Excellent **craft and interaction design** sensibility — you care deeply about details and feel
* Hands\-on **user research \& synthesis,** strong collaboration with PM/Engineering

4️⃣ A team introduction, followed by a soft skills interview based on personality assessments to see how we can best support your growth at Shine

title: Senior CRM Lifecycle + Journeys Manager
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**



Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer\-to\-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.



What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross\-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.


**OUR CULTURE**



Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before.


* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long\-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade\-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member \- no matter their level \- has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.


If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug\-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

**THE ROLE**



The **Senior Manager, CRM Lifecycle \+ Journeys** owns every triggered flow in the customer journey across email, SMS, push, and in\-app for UK, Germany, and France. You will build the automation engine that runs Quince's retention programme: from the welcome series a UK customer sees the day we launch, to the win\-back flow that recovers a French customer six months later.



This is a builder role. You will spend most of your first six months in Iterable and the CDP. You will write the flow logic, set up the data pipes, design the experiments, and ship the AI agents that take work out of building, testing, and reporting on flows. The Director, CRM owns the retention strategy and the campaign calendar. You own the triggered flow programme that runs alongside it.



Two constraints shape this job. UK and EU privacy rules mean the US lifecycle playbook does not transfer unchanged: you will rebuild the identity\-resolution layer and shift weight toward logged\-in and app behaviour. Channel economics also differ across markets, with SMS in particular materially more expensive in Europe than in the US, so the sequencing of email, SMS, push, and in\-app per flow per market is not the same as the US default.



You will be joining a team that values speed, candor, and rigour. This role is for you if you like building things, you can hold a roadmap in one hand and a SQL query in the other, and you have an opinion on how AI changes lifecycle work over the next 18 months.


**Responsibilities**


* Build, launch, and own every triggered lifecycle flow for UK (July 2026\), DE (October 2026\), and FR (November 2026\): welcome, browse abandon, cart abandon, post\-purchase, low stock, back in stock, win\-back, replenishment, care instructions.
* Partner with MarTech to Ship AI agents and tooling that take work out of flow build, copy, segmentation, and QA. Target at least one end\-to\-end CRM agent in production by EoY1 and a 50% reduction in flow concept\-to\-deployment time within 90 days.
* Partner with the Data team to run the triggered\-flow testing roadmap with statistically sound design. Minimum 6 A/B tests per quarter per flow per market.
* Build channel\-cost decision logic across email, SMS, push, and in\-app per flow per market.
* Recover signal lost from fingerprinting and consent restrictions in UK/EU by pushing app and logged\-in routing for non\-consenting users.
* Stand up and run the localisation pipeline with freelance copywriters for EN\-UK, DE, and FR. Localised flow content live before each market launch.
* Partner with tech team to maintain CDP quality across UK/EU: data model, integrations (Iterable, Attentive, app SDK, site events), data hygiene, latency, and identity\-resolution accuracy.


**Qualifications**


**Required:**

* 6\+ years lifecycle/CRM marketing in DTC or ecommerce, including at least 3 years owning automated/triggered flows end to end (not campaign/blast).
* Hands\-on with Iterable (preferred), or comparable ESP (Braze, Klaviyo, SFMC). Must have built flows in the tool, not just briefed them.
* Hands\-on with a CDP: Segment, mParticle, Hightouch, Census, or similar. Must understand identity resolution and data hygiene.
* Has built or deployed AI agents or LLM workflows in a marketing context (copy, segmentation, flow logic, QA). If you have not shipped one yet, you can describe the one you would ship in your first 90 days here.
* SQL proficient. Can self\-serve in Looker, Lookr, or BigQuery without waiting for an analyst.
* A/B testing rigour. Knows what statistical significance means and where it breaks in lifecycle (sample size, primary metric selection, novelty effects).
* Working knowledge of UK/EU privacy law (GDPR, PECR) and consent management. Understands what changes operationally when fingerprinting is restricted.
* Detail\-oriented. Triggered flows live or die on edge cases (locale, currency, time zone, opt\-in state, suppression rules).
* Strong cross\-functional operator. Will work daily with creative, brand, data science, tech, and US CRM counterparts.


**Preferred:**


* Multi\-market lifecycle experience (UK \+ DE or FR), fashion or home goods background, app\-native lifecycle experience, fluency in DE or FR.

**WHY QUINCE?**



Joining Quince means being part of a mission\-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.


**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY \& HIRING INTEGRITY**



Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.



Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case\-by\-case basis.



Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.


*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*



At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit\-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

description:

### **Job responsibilities**

* Drive time\-to\-production targets and manage launch schedules
* Review and validate aesthetics with Design in alignment with industrialization constraints
* Manage testing processes (request, follow\-up, and validation) alongside suppliers and quality teams
* Conduct price negotiations, capacity analysis, and tooling/mould investments for production
* Optimize manufacturing methods for each launch to drive cost improvements

* Ensure system price updates and manage production risk analysis
* Provide technical expertise for root cause analysis and quality issue resolution
* Define, improve, and deploy technical standards across projects
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and countertyping analysis

### **Profile**

* 3 to 4 years of experience in a similar role managing development and/or purchasing for leather goods accessories, jewelry, or trimmings
* Degree in Industrial Engineering or Materials Engineering
* Strong negotiation and communication skills

title: Senior Coordinator, PASS Housing
description:
About CEA CAPA

  

At CEA CAPA, we believe studying and interning abroad is a transformative experience. By immersing themselves in new cultures, our students gain valuable skills and perspectives that shape their futures.

  

We’re proud to be a recognized sector leader, known for our delivery of impactful academic, professional and cultural experiences. This is achieved through our dedicated global team who provide comprehensive guidance, instruction, support and resources to maximize the benefit of our students’ time abroad.

  

A sense of belonging is central to CEA CAPA’s mission. We foster a work environment that values diversity and is free from bias. Our hiring practices are based on professional qualifications, skills and competence.

  

With a footprint that spans 53 cities in 20 countries across Europe, Latin America and Australia our 450 strong global workforce deliver exceptional cultural experiences abroad to over 7,000 students per annum.

  

Position Summary  

The Senior Coordinator, Housing and Student Services plays a key operational role in the delivery of student housing and student services in Madrid. The role combines hands\-on student support with responsibility for coordinating the day\-to\-day work of the Housing team, organizing workflows and priorities, overseeing housing operations, and supporting the PASS Director with budget management and semester planning. The Senior Coordinator serves as a senior point of reference for housing\-related matters, helps ensure consistent service standards, and coordinates effectively with students, colleagues, landlords, residences, vendors, and other external partners.
The role supports students throughout their programs, from logistics to cultural integration, ensuring a seamless and enriching experience. It also involves administrative tasks such as managing program materials and handling student accommodation issues.  

Responsibilities  

* Serve as a senior point of contact for students, providing guidance, information, resources, and support throughout their program.
* Coordinate the day\-to\-day work of the Housing team, organizing workloads, priorities, schedules, coverage, and operational deadlines.
* Support, guide, and coordinate team members, ensuring clear allocation of responsibilities, effective communication, and consistent service delivery.

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to coordinate people, competing priorities, schedules, and deadlines.
* Demonstrated leadership and team coordination skills, with the ability to guide colleagues and promote accountability and collaboration.
* Strong budget management, financial tracking, forecasting, and cost\-control skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong relationship\-management and negotiation skills with internal and external stakeholders.
* Able to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and contribute effectively to a wider team.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities and a practical, flexible, and creative approach to operational challenges.
* High attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records and follow through on complex operational matters.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM systems, and other digital tools.

* Fluency in English and Spanish.
* Significant experience working with students, particularly international students.
* Demonstrated experience in student housing, accommodation operations, property coordination, or a closely related area.
* Experience coordinating or supervising team members, workflows, or operational projects.
* Experience managing budgets, monitoring expenditure, and preparing forecasts or financial projections.
* Experience working with external vendors, landlords, service providers, and other operational partners.

title: Sr. Manager, Global Packaging
description:

* Develop and own the **Global Packaging Engineering strategy** , aligned with business priorities and focused on standardization, quality, sustainability, safety and cost optimization.

* Drive continuous improvement in packaging processes and technologies, identifying opportunities for **automation, standardization and sustainability** .
* Establish appropriate **KPIs and governance** to measure packaging performance, compliance, cost improvements, quality and returnable packaging effectiveness.
* Support packaging integration for **new products, technologies and acquired businesses** , establishing common standards and ways of working across the organization.
Maintain a hands\-on approach, including regular engagement with suppliers, manufacturing locations and project/customer sites globally.  
* 

  

### **What you'll need**

* **15\+ years of experience** in industrial Packaging Engineering, either within a manufacturing organization or packaging solutions provider.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Packaging Engineering** , Mechanical/Industrial Engineering with significant packaging specialization, or equivalent relevant technical background.
* Strong technical knowledge of **industrial packaging materials, design, specifications and validation** , including returnable and expendable/one\-way packaging solutions.
* Proven experience developing and implementing **returnable packaging programs** .
* Demonstrated **people\-management experience** , including leading and developing technical teams across different locations and time zones.
* Experience working in a **global manufacturing, automotive, energy or similar industrial environment** .
* Strong experience working cross\-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, Quality, Logistics and suppliers.
* Ability to combine **strategic thinking with hands\-on execution** — we are looking for someone who can define the strategy but is also comfortable getting into the technical details when needed.
* Strong change\-management and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to challenge existing approaches and drive implementation.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Fluent English.
* **Based in Madrid, Spain** , with willingness to travel globally to suppliers, manufacturing locations and project sites as required.

  

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

The successful candidate will help us build a stronger, more scalable Global Packaging Engineering organization, moving Packaging further upstream into product development while improving standardization, returnable solutions, quality, sustainability, and total landed cost across NextPower's global operations.  



  

This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to shape how Packaging Engineering supports NextPower's continued growth, new products and business verticals.


At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility\-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data\-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.


**We are Nextpower**

As **VM Specialist South Europe** , you will be a key member of the Visual Merchandising team within the EMEA region. Based in Madrid, you will report to the Head of VM Europe and support the regional VM Managers.
  

In this role, you will support both retail and wholesale channels across South Europe, ensuring the consistent and high\-quality execution of Visual Merchandising in line with global guidelines. You will work closely with regional stakeholders and store teams to deliver impactful and commercially effective VM across your network.


### **Job responsibilities**

* Support the execution of visual merchandising across South Europe (Spain, Italy, Portugal), including retail stores, department stores, and wholesale locations.
* Assist in the implementation of seasonal product launches, window installations, and in\-store activations, ensuring alignment with global VM guidelines, creative direction, and regional business needs.

* Monitor and support regular store rotations (bi\-weekly), ensuring VM reflects local market needs, client profiles, and commercial priorities.

* Support VM training initiatives, including onboarding sessions, VM guidelines, and best practice sharing.
* Assist in regional projects such as new store openings, pop\-ups, events, and marketing activations.
* Collaborate with merchandising and retail teams to align VM execution with product strategy and stock priorities.
* Act as a key point of coordination between central VM and local teams, ensuring smooth communication and execution.
* Maintain a proactive, solution\-oriented approach, adapting quickly to evolving business needs and priorities.
### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* Degree or academic background in Visual Merchandising, Fashion, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 2–4 years of experience in Visual Merchandising, ideally within the luxury or fashion industry.
* Experience working with RTW and Accessories categories is a plus.
* Strong understanding of retail and wholesale environments.
* Excellent attention to detail with a strong visual sensibility.
* Creative mindset with a commercial approach.
* Strong interest in fashion, styling, and current trends.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work across multiple markets and teams.
* Organised, proactive, and adaptable.
* A collaborative team player with a positive and hands\-on attitude.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Proficiency in MS Office and design tools (e.g., Photoshop is a plus).
* Fluent in English (Spanish and Italian are a plus).
* Willingness to travel frequently across South Europe.
### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE:**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

description:
Picsart's creator channel (agencies across the US, Asia, LatAm and Europe, thousands of active creators, tens of millions of views a week, and a creator program that pays for results) is something we want to make much bigger. You own the relationships and the execution: finding and signing agencies and creators, the agreements, getting content published, tracking what it drives, and deciding which partnerships to keep, grow or end.

  



You'll run a network the size of a department with a team of two. AI does what a team of ten used to: it builds the outreach lists, screens agencies and creators, scores every partner's performance and drafts the reporting. Data, Finance and Legal do their parts. You decide what the machine does and make the calls it can't. This is a role for someone who already works this way.

  



Please note that this is a **Full\-time Contractor (12 months)** role.


**How You'll Make an Impact**
-----------------------------


* **Find and sign partners.** Agencies and creators in every market that matters, working toward 50 agencies and 500,000 creators. You know where the good ones are and how to reach them.
* **Get the agreements done.** Terms, exclusivity, data access, rights and payment: in writing, on Picsart's terms, with Finance and Legal behind you.
* **Get campaigns published.** Live on time, in every market, at the volume agreed. Every post carries its link, its code and its creator, so nothing goes out untracked.
* **Track what each partner drives.** Signups, first generations, credits used, paying users and big spenders, in dashboards the Data team builds to your spec.
* **Decide who continues.** Recommend which partnerships to grow, hold or end based on what they convert, not what they view. Scale what repeats; cut what was lucky.
* **Grow revenue and usage.** 100x the revenue and AI credit use coming from the influencer and affiliate programs. Pay for results, never for views, and put the money behind what converts.
* **Build Picsart's own creator base.** Creators that agencies bring in end up on Picsart's terms, in Picsart's database, with a direct relationship, so agencies stay a choice, not a dependency.
* **Sell the network to partners.** AI model partners and brands already pay to run campaigns with our creators. Bring in more of that money so it covers a growing share of what the network costs.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------


* **Partnerships you've run at scale.** Creator, affiliate, UGC or influencer.
* **A network you grew from a handful to dozens.** You signed the partners that worked and ended the ones that didn't.
* **A head for numbers.** You can work out what a partner costs you per paying user, and whether they earn back what you pay them.
* **Judgment about what's real.** Results that came from a few individual creators aren't proof the model works, they're proof those creators work. You can tell which one you're looking at.
* **Negotiation that closes.** Terms, exclusivity, data, exit: signed, not agreed in principle.
* **A way of working that uses tools instead of headcount.** And you work well with Finance, Legal and Data without needing to be them.
* **Experience across markets is a big plus.** You know what wins in one country rarely copies to the next, and you're good at finding the local agency, operator or creator who can open a market you can't open yourself.

title: Open Innovation Associate
description:
Are you passionate about shaping the future of corporate open innovation? Do you want your strategies to end in deployment rather than in a final presentation?

  

We are looking for an **Innovation Strategist** to help companies and governments define, design, and implement cutting\-edge open innovation strategies and formats. The role is based in Valencia, Spain, with a genuinely global mandate and significant travel. You will work in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and international environment, leading open innovation projects at the forefront of technology and creativity.

 **WHO WE ARE:**



Plug and Play is the world's largest open innovation platform, with 60\+ locations worldwide. We support leading corporations with their innovation efforts by strategizing innovation and connecting them with break\-through startups to drive joint innovation and strategic growth. Our mission is to bring Silicon Valley's innovation mindset to companies and governments worldwide.

 **WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**



We are looking for a proactive and creative team member to shape and execute open innovation strategies for our corporate and public\-sector partners. This role combines consulting, research, and service design to enhance innovation methodologies, optimize processes, and deliver impactful projects. You'll lead and contribute to workshops, strategy development, and execution, ensuring real\-world impact for our clients.

  

Open innovation is our operating model: you will work across corporates, governments, and startups at the same time, and the same platform that writes the strategy also sources the startups and takes the solution through to deployment inside the client organization. Our definition of success is not a pilot. It is a solution in operation, at scale.

 **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


**1\. Strategy \& Execution**


* Develop and implement open innovation strategies tailored to corporate and government challenges and objectives.
* Optimize innovation processes, integrating best practices in corporate innovation, venture clienting, venture building, and open innovation.

  


**2\. Workshop Facilitation \& Stakeholder Engagement**


* Design and lead workshops to drive ideation, strategy formulation, and open innovation roadmaps.
* Collaborate with corporate teams, executives, startups, and external partners to ensure seamless execution and measurable impact.

  


**3\. Research \& Insights**


* Analyze emerging trends, market insights, and disruptive technologies to inform open innovation strategies.
* Provide thought leadership by translating research into actionable recommendations.

  


**4\. Business Development \& Growth**


* Identify opportunities to expand open innovation initiatives and craft innovation\-driven proposals.
* Support business development efforts by contributing insights, strategy recommendations, and proposal writing.

  


**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:**


* 3\+ years of experience in open innovation, innovation consulting, corporate innovation, product development, digital transformation, or a related field.
* Hands\-on experience facilitating ideation sessions, design sprints, or co\-creation workshops with senior stakeholders.Practical command of Design Thinking, Lean Startup, and Agile methodologies applied to real projects.
* Strong ability to translate research insights into actionable strategies and solutions.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills, including presentations that carry an argument to an executive audience.
* Entrepreneurial mindset: self\-motivated, proactive, and results\-driven.
* A genuine team player. Our team is fast\-moving: we share client work, cover for each other across time zones, and expect people to pull in the same direction rather than optimize for their own project. Lone wolves are not a fit here.
* Fluency in English, and readiness to travel frequently for global client engagements.
* Experience working with startups as solution providers, such as scouting, assessment, or venture clienting, is a plus.
* Public sector or government innovation experience (procurement, national innovation programmes, EU funding instruments) is a plus.
* Working fluency with AI tools for research, synthesis, and production is a plus.
* Additional languages, particularly Spanish, German, French, or Arabic, are a plus.

  



A completed University Degree (Master's level preferred) is an advantage, and a strong analytical or technical background, such as engineering, natural sciences, design, business, or economics, will serve you well in front of deep\-tech and government stakeholders.

 **WHY JOIN US?**


* Work in a dynamic, global open innovation environment at the intersection of startups, corporates, and governments.
* Collaborate with future\-oriented corporations and pioneering governments across EMEA, Asia, and the Americas.
* Based in Valencia, one of Europe's most liveable cities.
* A clear development path
* Be part of a fast\-growing, energetic team with flat hierarchies, short decision paths, and a genuinely collaborative culture
