description:
**Lead, Product Management, ELL Institutional Courseware**

This role aligns to industry\-level titles such as Head of Product, Director of Product Management, Product Portfolio Director, or similar product leadership positions with responsibility for portfolio strategy, commercial performance, and team leadership.


**Role Overview**

The Lead, Product Management, ELL Institutional Courseware owns Pearson’s global portfolio of English language learning materials for schools, higher education and adult education. The portfolio spans print, blended and digital courseware, supplementary materials, teacher professional development, and partner\-created content.


This is an opportunity to shape the future of a major global education portfolio. The role will decide where Pearson invests, grows, localises, simplifies and exits, with accountability for creating products that teachers choose, improve student learning outcomes, and deliver sustainable revenue growth and strong returns.


A central part of the mandate is leading the evolution of a print\-heavy portfolio towards connected, digital and AI\-enabled learning experiences. Pearson intends to lead this transition while staying grounded in the needs and readiness of teachers and institutions.


The role owns the full product lifecycle, from customer discovery and portfolio strategy through development, launch, performance management and retirement. It owns investment cases for approval by the ELL Leadership Team, recommends pricing and packaging, and drives initiatives to improve revenue and profitability.


The role leads a global team of approximately 15 colleagues through managers and works across Content, Learning Science, Engineering, Assessment, UX and AI. It is a member of the ELL Product Leadership Team and ELL Content Leadership Team, acting as the senior product owner for institutional courseware and aligning Product, Content, Sales, Marketing, Customer Service and Finance around a clear portfolio direction.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Set the Portfolio Strategy**

* Define and execute the global strategy and roadmap for institutional courseware, based on customer needs, market opportunities, learning outcomes, and commercial performance.
* Manage portfolio investments, prioritisation, localisation, innovation, and product lifecycle decisions.
* Act as the senior product authority, providing strategic recommendations to the ELL Leadership Team.

**Understand Customers and Markets**

* Build deep understanding of learners, educators, institutions, ministries, and partners across priority markets.
* Use customer insight, market trends, learning evidence, and performance data to drive product and investment decisions.
* Support strategic customer and ministry engagements alongside Sales teams.

**Create Market\-Winning Courseware**

* Translate strategy into compelling value propositions, product roadmaps, and requirements.
* Lead cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-impact learning solutions that balance customer value, learning effectiveness, quality, speed, and commercial outcomes.
* Validate opportunities through customer research, pilots, and data\-driven decision\-making.

**Lead the AI and Digital Transition**

* Drive the evolution from print\-first products to digital, blended, and AI\-enabled learning experiences.
* Identify and scale responsible AI opportunities that enhance learning, teaching, accessibility, and product efficiency.
* Ensure AI\-enabled products meet standards for transparency, safety, privacy, accessibility, and intellectual property compliance.

**Drive Growth and Investment Return**

* Develop business cases, pricing strategies, and investment recommendations for new and existing products.
* Partner with Sales, Finance, and Revenue Operations to achieve customer, learning, revenue, profitability, and ROI objectives.
* Take decisive action to optimise, reposition, or retire underperforming products.

**Measure Learning and Product Performance**

* Establish and monitor success metrics across learning outcomes, adoption, engagement, satisfaction, retention, revenue, and profitability.
* Use evidence and performance data to continuously improve portfolio effectiveness.

**Lead the Team and Organisation**

* Lead and develop a global team of approximately 15 product professionals.
* Foster excellence in product management, customer discovery, strategy, commercial thinking, and AI\-enabled product development.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and customer focus.

**Expected Results**

* A clear global portfolio strategy and roadmap, understood across ELL.
* Sustainable revenue growth, improved profitability and stronger returns from courseware investment.
* A simpler, more intentional portfolio with clear investment and retirement choices.
* Global products that combine scale with effective localisation.
* A credible transition towards digital and AI\-enabled courseware that customers can adopt successfully.
* Measurable improvements in student learning outcomes, teacher effectiveness and customer value.
* Trusted relationships with major institutions, ministries, distributors and partners.
* Strong alignment across Product, Content, Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Finance and Technology.
* A high\-performing global product management team with strong managers and clear accountability.

**Experience**

* Relevant experience in product management, portfolio leadership, general management or a related field, including experience leading multiple teams or managing managers.
* Proven success setting strategy and making investment choices across a complex portfolio of products, markets or customer segments.
* A track record of turning customer insight into differentiated products and successful commercial outcomes.
* Experience owning business cases and managing performance against revenue, profitability, customer and return expectations.
* Strong judgement across investment, prioritisation, pricing, packaging and portfolio rationalisation.
* Experience leading cross\-functional product development in a global, matrixed organisation.
* Experience building product teams and developing product leaders.
* Experience in education, publishing, courseware, EdTech or learning products is strongly preferred.
* Experience applying AI, data or emerging technology to products is preferred.
* No specific degree is required. Relevant experience and demonstrated outcomes are valued.

**Skills, Leadership \& Capabilities**

* Strong commercial and strategic acumen, with the ability to balance customer and learning outcomes with revenue, profitability, risk, and return.
* Proven expertise in product strategy, portfolio management, customer discovery, roadmap development, and stakeholder engagement.
* Data\- and evidence\-led decision maker, using customer insight, learning science, analytics, and sound judgement to shape investment and product decisions.
* Strong leadership capabilities, with experience leading global teams, influencing senior stakeholders, and creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Customer\- and learner\-focused, with the ability to make clear decisions in complex and ambiguous environments.
* Practical understanding of AI and machine learning concepts, including prompt engineering and the application of AI to products, workflows, and decision\-making. Hands\-on model development expertise is not required.

**Location \& Work Set Up**

This is a full\-time hybrid role based in the UK, Spain or Poland, with regular collaboration from a local Pearson office.


**Who we are:**

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

You will work on strategic engagement and outreach with privacy and data policy stakeholders in the EU. The role will involve proactive policy development, project management, and the creation of networks across different sectors. You will work in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment and present to both internal and external audiences. This role involves working on novel public policy issues. In this role you will combine substantive policy expertise with programme leadership: shaping and executing our external engagement strategy with regulators, policymakers, academics and civil society across the EU privacy and AI community, and translating the fast\-moving EU digital rulebook — GDPR, the AI Act, DSA, DMA, Data Act and the EU data strategy more broadly — into clear guidance and priorities for internal partners.The ideal candidate has a track record of public engagement (e.g., published thought leadership, conference speaking, or advisory roles) in the EU data and privacy community and is comfortable operating independently at senior levels both externally and internally. ### **Privacy and Data Policy Manager Responsibilities:**

* Identify and monitor data policy issues affecting Meta in the EU

* Develop proactive strategies and initiatives to address policy challenges

* 6\+ years of professional experience in privacy, data or technology policy, regulatory affairs, or a closely related field
* Fluency in English and French, as the role requires direct engagement with French\-speaking regulators and policymakers in the EU
* Bachelor's degree or higher in a relevant fields
* Demonstrated expertise in AI policy and in the privacy and data protection framework of the EU digital landscape (GDPR, AI Act, DSA/DMA, Data Act)
* Established familiarity with and a network in the data and privacy community in at least one of the countries where the position may be based (Spain, France, Italy)

* Strong presentation, writing, and stakeholder\-management skills, including those with senior external audiences

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimise/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

* Additional official EU languages to support stakeholder engagement across EU member states

* Experience working with or within an EU data protection authority, the EDPB, a national digital regulator, or an EU institution
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. description:
**About WebBeds**



Launched in 2013, WebBeds is a global marketplace for the travel trade, providing powerful distribution solutions that make selling and buying travel products easier. It sources accommodation and destination services from travel suppliers, aggregates and merchandises that content in the WebBeds platform, then distributes it to its global network of travel trade buyers, who sell to the travelling public.  

Hotels and other suppliers \- global and regional hotel chains, independent hotels, apartments, resorts, attractions, transfer and sightseeing companies and more \- can sell their products to a global network of online and offline travel buyers through robust solutions that provide greater inventory control to simplify distribution, and leverage WebBeds enhanced analytics to inform inventory optimisation choices – saving costs and increasing revenue.

  

Travel buyers \- online travel agencies, retail travel agents, corporate travel managers, tour operators, wholesalers, tourism boards, super apps, DMC’s, group providers, airlines and more \- can integrate the hundreds of thousands of hotels and ground services in the WebBeds marketplace through simple and seamless API connectivity, or they can search, shop and book online through one of WebBeds trade only booking sites.

  

WebBeds operates globally through four geographic regions – Europe, Asia Pacific, MEA (Middle East and Africa) and Americas \- with over 1,900 travel professionals working in 120 cities across 50 countries worldwide.

 **Job Description**  

We are looking for a **Process Mining Consultant** to join a business process analysis and improvement project within an international corporate environment. The successful candidate will work with transactional data from SAP systems and other sources to reconstruct how processes are actually executed, generate process statistics and KPIs, and identify measurable improvement opportunities.


The objective of this role is to provide end\-to\-end visibility into processes such as **Procure\-to\-Pay, Order\-to\-Cash, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing**, translating analytical findings into actionable recommendations for business teams.


Responsibilities

* Extract, model, and prepare event logs from SAP and other source systems.
* Build and configure analyses in **Celonis** and/or **SAP Signavio Process Intelligence**.
* Reconstruct As\-Is processes and identify process variants, deviations, and rework.
* Calculate and monitor process KPIs and statistics, including throughput time, cycle time, waiting time, rework rate, automation rate, and conformance.
* Identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and root causes, quantifying their operational and financial impact.
* Design dashboards and visualizations to support decision\-making.
* Present findings and improvement plans to business and IT stakeholders.
* Measure the impact of implemented actions and perform continuous follow\-up.
* Collaborate with SAP functional teams, data engineering teams, and process owners.

  

**Qualifications**  

Mandatory Requirements

* 3\-5\+ years of experience in **Process Mining**, process analysis, or process intelligence.
* Hands\-on experience building analyses in **Celonis** and/or **SAP Signavio Process Intelligence** (not limited to consuming existing dashboards).
* Strong SQL skills and experience in data modeling and data processing.
* Experience working with data from **SAP ECC** and/or **SAP S/4HANA**.
* Knowledge of at least one of the following end\-to\-end processes: **Procure\-to\-Pay, Order\-to\-Cash, Supply Chain, or Manufacturing**.
* Ability to define KPIs and translate data analysis into business recommendations.
* Professional level of English to work in an international environment.


Nice\-to\-Have Requirements

* Knowledge of SAP modules and tables, including **MM, SD, FI, PP, and WM**.
* **Celonis PQL** and/or **SAP Signavio Process Intelligence** certification.
* Experience with **Python**, ETL tools, or **Power BI**.
* Knowledge of **BPMN**, **Lean Six Sigma**, or continuous improvement methodologies.
* Previous experience in **FMCG**, food industry, or industrial environments.
* Knowledge of **SAP Activate** or **S/4HANA transformation programs**.

  

**Additional Information** **What do we offer you?**

* B2B or employment contract

title: Senior Platform Security Engineer
description:
**Our story:**
--------------


Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

-------------------


We are seeking an experienced Senior Platform Security Engineer to design, implement, and maintain security solutions for our cloud\-native infrastructure and AI systems. This role will be responsible for securing our platform across multiple cloud environments, ensuring container and Kubernetes security, protecting AI/ML workflows, and implementing robust security controls throughout our SDLC. The ideal candidate will have deep technical and programmatic expertise in cloud\-native security, along with demonstrable hands\-on experience securing AI/ML systems.

  

**Your responsibilities and decisions:**
----------------------------------------


### **Cloud \& Infrastructure Security**

* Design and implement comprehensive security architectures for cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Implement security best practices for container and Kubernetes deployments
* Develop and maintain secure Infrastructure as Code (IaC) codebases
* Design and deploy zero\-trust network architecture and secure service mesh solutions
* Build and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines following DevSecOps principles

### **AI/ML Security**

* Secure AI\-powered product features end to end, covering context assembly, tool invocation, and output handling
* Design and review security controls for RAG implementations
* Secure agentic solutions and their extension points: tool integrations (MCP clients and servers), agent skills, and autonomous action boundaries such as scoped credentials, sandboxing, and human\-in\-the\-loop gates
* Build defenses against direct and indirect prompt injection and other adversarial inputs to LLM applications
* Establish data security controls for sensitive data flowing through inference, retrieval, and fine\-tuning

### **Security Operations**

* Lead incident response for cloud and AI infrastructure security incidents
* Develop and implement security monitoring and detection strategies
* Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for cloud\-native and AI systems
* Perform regular security assessments of cloud infrastructure and container deployments
* Create and maintain security documentation, including policies, procedures, and run\-books

### **Leadership \& Collaboration**

* Collaborate with development, data science, and operations teams to integrate security
* Communicate security requirements and recommendations to technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Stay current with emerging threats and security trends in cloud\-native and AI security
* Participate in technology selections for security tooling and platforms

**Your profile:**
-----------------


### **Experience**

* 5\+ years of experience in information security, with at least 3 years specializing in cloud security
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience securing containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Demonstrable hands\-on experience securing AI/ML or LLM\-based systems
* Strong background in at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP)

### **Technical Skills**

* Expert knowledge of container security, Kubernetes security, and cloud\-native security patterns
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.)
* Strong understanding of network security, identity management, and access control
* Experience with security tooling for cloud environments (Cloud Security Posture Management, CSPM)
* Working knowledge of AI/ML and LLM security, including familiarity with frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch and their security implications
* Proficiency in scripting and programming languages (Python, Go, Bash)
* Experience with security automation and orchestration

### **Preferred Experience**

* Deep experience securing Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI systems
* Familiarity with AI/LLM security frameworks (e.g., OWASP LLM Top 10\) and AI governance or compliance requirements
* Experience with secure multi\-tenant AI infrastructure
* Experience with privacy\-enhancing technologies for AI/ML (differential privacy, federated learning)
* Contributions to open\-source security projects or public security research
* Experience building security tools or automation frameworks

**Why Taxfix?**
---------------

* A chance to do meaningful, people\-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.
* Holistic well\-being with free mental health coaching sessions.
* A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.
* Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.
* 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.
* Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.
* Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal tech meetups, our international team hosts regular get\-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.
* Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax\-related questions.
* Have a four\-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.

  

Excited? So are we. Learn more about Team Taxfix on our blog and get a glimpse of our culture.

  

*At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.*

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
   

  

**Who You’ll Work With**
 You’ll join our Creative Services team, working with a talented group of design professionals who support Bain teams across offices, regions, and service lines. This role will be based in our Lisbon Global Business Services (GBS) center. Creative Services plays an important role in helping our teams communicate clearly, creatively, and with visual impact.
   

  

 As Design Manager, Creative Services, you’ll lead a design operations team while continuing to deliver high\-quality design services to supported offices. You’ll work closely with team members, senior leadership, internal stakeholders, and regional or global partners to drive strong service delivery, effective resource management, and a high\-performance customer\-centric culture.
   

  

**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**
 In this role, you’ll lead a Creative Services design operations team and manage related workflows within approved budget. You’ll be responsible for the team’s service levels, including quality and productivity, as well as the professional development of team members.
   

  

 Alongside your leadership responsibilities, you’ll also dedicate a portion of your time to providing design services to supported offices. This allocation will vary depending on team size and business needs.

You’ll help build and sustain a high\-performance, customer\-centric service culture and set up quality control processes that reinforce a zero\-defect mindset across team operations.
* You’ll troubleshoot service and staffing issues, manage escalations as needed, continuously improve processes, and drive improvement initiatives. You’ll also deliver high\-quality design services on assigned work.
* You’ll manage resource planning by regularly assessing workload, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and productivity, and recommending paid overtime decisions when needed in line with office policies.
* You’ll lead and develop the team by contributing to recruiting and hiring decisions, overseeing onboarding for new hires, managing training plans, and monitoring training quality. You’ll provide timely feedback, coach team members, manage performance, and conduct regular one\-on\-one meetings to review skill plans and track progression.
* You’ll drive the annual review process for team members and create opportunities for knowledge and experience sharing across the team.
* You’ll also contribute to project work by supporting global and regional standards and strategies, advising on layout, design, and technical solutions that maximize visual impact across relevant service lines. You’ll liaise with internal stakeholders on high\-stakes presentation design projects, regional and global marketing projects, and campaigns, particularly as they relate to resource and capacity management.
* You’ll lead and shape the implementation of departmental, regional, or global initiatives and strategic programs.


**About You**
* You bring a university degree or equivalent experience in graphic design, marketing, or a related field.
* You have at least six years of experience working in a demanding corporate environment, ideally within professional services or a blue\-chip company.
* You have supervisory experience and workflow management experience.
* You are highly proficient in Microsoft Office, including PowerPoint, Excel, and Word, as well as Adobe Creative Suite.
* You have strong management and leadership skills, including the ability to support, develop, coach, and mentor individual contributors. You are confident and systematic in giving and receiving feedback.
* You have a portfolio of work in presentation design and/or other examples of relevant design work.
* You bring expertise in tools and software relevant to your area of specialization.
* You communicate clearly and effectively, both in writing and verbally, and are fluent in English.
* You have a strong interest in developing technologies and their application within a corporate environment.
* You are an exceptional people leader with a track record of supporting and engaging direct reports.
* You bring an outstanding professional customer service attitude and are a skilled, customer\-centric communicator and negotiator. You can build strong working relationships in person and remotely.
* You are an effective decision maker and a resourceful problem solver, with a practical and innovative approach to process improvement.
* You have a strong work ethic and take ownership and responsibility for achieving results.
* You are detail\-oriented and quality\-focused, with a proactive approach to skill development.
* You bring strong organization, prioritization, and time management skills.
* You are team\-oriented and able to work autonomously.

**Location**

This post can be based in London (1 Horse Guards Road) or Darlington (Feethams House).**About the job**
-----------------

### **Job summary**


Working at HM Treasury puts you at the heart of government, making a difference to the UK economy and ultimately to peoples lives right across the UK.


Jobs at the Treasury are fast\-paced, fun and can offer unparalleled perspective  not least the opportunity to advise Ministers on the decisions which directly determine the UKs prosperity. Deep in our DNA is a commitment to empowering our people: maximising individual and collective impact, with interesting work no matter your role or seniority.


Day\-to\-day you could be supporting Ministers to decide the right level of a specific tax or line of government spending; helping maintain the stability of financial markets; analysing the long\-term trends impacting the future of the economy; or enabling this work as part of our vital corporate functions.


We are a high\-performing department and proud to have outstanding staff from a wide range of backgrounds. We are also a friendly, inclusive and sociable workplace that prides itself on fostering great team spirit. Our two largest offices are 1 Horse Guards Road in London, opposite St James Park, and the Darlington Economic Campus, which also contains eight other departments. We work seamlessly across all our sites, including Norwich, Birmingham and Leeds, as one Treasury.


We are both a 1,000\-year\-old institution and dynamic, forward\-looking economics and finance ministry, with a strong direction set by our organisational strategy, the Future Treasury Vision. The 21st century offers huge opportunities and poses new challenges for the UK. Working at the Treasury is your chance to help the country chart the right course.

### **Job description**


The Growth Strategy Unit is a new team in EGU, established earlier this year, tasked with leading HMTs work on growth in support of the Chancellor, in partnership with No 10 including No 10 North.


It does this by developing the overall approach to boosting growth and living standards through supply side reform. It advises the Chancellor, Exchequer Secretary, EMB, as well as the PM, No10 including No 10 North, and the Cabinet Secretary on the drivers of the UK's economic performance, the sufficiency of our existing strategy, and opportunities to go further  including navigating fiscal and wider trade\-offs.


It works in close partnership with teams across HMT, No 10 including No10 North and beyond, with responsibility for specific growth policies. GSU seeks to ensure strategic and narrative coherence; and provides constructive challenge to wider policy development injecting creativity and alternative ideas.


It leads external engagement on growth, including with economic commentators, think tanks and academics. This engagement is strategic, and two\-way: hearing stakeholders views, whilst also proactively and confidently setting out the Governments strategy and responding to challenges.


It undertakes strategic growth projects on specific priority areas  for example, where these are crosscutting, or require a new perspective. This currently includes work on economic dynamism.


It leads work on growth economics and analysis for HMT, working across a large, expert analytical community in EGU, Economics Group and beyond.


As head of the Growth Strategy Unit, you will shape and drive the UKs growth agenda and economic strategy. You will work in partnership with No 10 including No 10 North, and the Cabinet Office, to deliver the PM and Chancellors growth agenda. You will also build and use key relationships across businesses, think tanks, academia, departments and the policy community, and drive ambitious policies that will shift the dial on this countrys economic future.


The role involves:


1\. Advising the Chancellor and other Treasury Ministers on the governments overall growth and economic strategy, developed in partnership with No 10 including No 10 North. The role involves shaping and synthesising work from teams across HMT, such that the growth strategy is greater than the sum of its parts; and encouraging ambition and innovation. The role also involves bringing this work together at set piece events  the Chancellor has committed to two growth updates a year.


2\. Building, maintaining and deploying positive relationships with No 10, including No 10 North, and a wide range of partners, across the centre of government and key growth departments to shape the agenda and ensure alignment and buy\-in


3\. Proactively shaping and engaging in external research and the debate on growth, working closely with colleagues leading on communications, business engagement and inward investment


4\. Embedding economic analysis in strategic policy\- making: leading the Growth Economics Branch, and working in partnership with the HMT Economics Group, the AI Economy Institute, and key Chief Analysts in other departments, to steer and support a creative and collaborative analytical work programme that underpins strategic prioritisation and ensures that growth policy development is informed by rigorous, evidence\-based analysis


5\. Leading the project function within the Growth Strategy Unit comprising cross\-functional teams to develop strategic thinking on specific policy challenges. This will include partnering with Direct Ministerial Appointments, external analysts and thought leaders to commission and drive studies that inform strategic policy.


6\. Displaying strong leadership and people management skills with the ability to build and develop a diverse, inclusive and supportive team. This includes strong economic/analytical skills to be able to lead the analytical function.


7\. Showing a clear commitment to promoting diversity, inclusion and belonging, role modelling excellent behaviours at all times.

* Sound judgement and strong strategic vision, with good knowledge of the various tenets of the Economic Strategy, and a track record of leading in uncertain and complex policy and political environments.

description:
Clarity is redefining how private companies and their shareholders access liquidity. Through its institutional\-grade platform, Clarity brings together buyers, sellers, and issuers to facilitate secondary transactions in venture\-backed, pre\-IPO companies, introducing efficiency, transparency, and standardization to an otherwise opaque asset class.
   

  

 Recognized as one of Canada's fastest\-growing companies and backed by leading U.S. investors, Clarity is profitable, well\-capitalized, and building a high\-performance team to meet growing demand and pursue new market opportunities.
   

  

 Interested in learning more about life at Clarity? Check out our careers page to see how you can grow with us!

 **Director of Product Design**

title: Director of Human Resources - London Marriott Hotel County Hall
description:
**Additional Information**  

**Job Number**26122490

**Schedule**Full Time  

**Located Remotely?**N

**Director of Human Resources**

**London Marriott Hotel County Hall**

 **Position Summary**


This is an exceptional opportunity to lead the people agenda at one of London’s most distinctive and iconic hotels.


As **Director of Human Resources at London Marriott Hotel County Hall**, you will be a key member of the hotel’s Executive Committee, partnering directly with the General Manager and leadership team to shape a workplace where our associates can thrive and our business can perform at its best.


This is much more than an HR operational role. You will be a **strategic business partner, culture champion, talent leader and trusted coach**, translating the priorities of the hotel into a compelling people strategy.

 **The Impact You Will Make**


Our people are at the heart of everything we do.


You will create an environment where associates feel they **belong, can grow, perform and build meaningful careers**. Through your influence, coaching and leadership, you will help us attract exceptional talent, develop our future leaders and create an associate experience that translates directly into an outstanding guest experience.


As a member of the Executive Committee, you will bring the people perspective to our most important business decisions. You will use insight, data and your understanding of the operation to challenge thinking, influence decisions and ensure our people strategy supports the continued success of the hotel.

 **What You Will Do**

**Lead our people strategy**

* Partner with the General Manager and Executive Committee to translate business priorities into an effective property Human Resources strategy.
* Own the development and execution of the hotel's Human Resources Business Plan.
* Act as a trusted adviser and coach to senior leaders and managers across the property.
* Lead key people initiatives, ensuring they are embedded effectively and deliver meaningful business results.
* Champion associate engagement and lead the hotel's response to engagement survey insights and priorities.
* Use people data and insight, including retention, vacancies, engagement, succession and development, to inform Executive Committee discussions and decision\-making.
* Represent the people agenda within owner and senior leadership discussions as required.
* Act as a key change leader for initiatives with a significant impact on our associates.

**Build our talent and leadership pipeline**

* Lead succession and workforce planning across the property.
* Build a strong and diverse pipeline of talent for future leadership opportunities.
* Coordinate the Human Capital Review process and ensure meaningful follow\-up and development actions.
* Partner with leaders to identify high\-potential talent and create opportunities for associates to grow their careers.
* Coach leaders on performance, development and talent conversations.
* Balance internal development and progression with the recruitment of exceptional external talent.

**Champion reward and recognition**

* Maintain a strong understanding of the internal and external employment and compensation landscape.
* Support the development of an effective total compensation strategy.
* Champion the effective use and communication of compensation, benefits, recognition and incentive programmes.
* Review internal equity and identify areas requiring action.
* Develop creative approaches to recognition that reinforce the culture and priorities of the hotel.

**Create an exceptional associate experience**

* Be a visible and trusted HR leader for associates throughout the hotel.
* Champion positive employee relations and a culture built on respect, inclusion and belonging.
* Provide expert guidance on employee relations matters.
* Lead, coach and develop the on\-property Human Resources team, ensuring they have the expertise and confidence to provide outstanding support.
* Ensure Marriott HR systems, tools, policies and programmes are used effectively across the property.
* Continually look for opportunities to improve the way we work and the experience we create for associates.

 **Education and Experience**


We are looking for an accomplished HR leader who combines **strong HR expertise with commercial thinking, excellent judgement and a genuine passion for people**.


You will bring one of the following:

* A **2\-year degree from an accredited university** in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related discipline, together with **at least four years' experience** in Human Resources, management operations or a related professional area

**OR**

* A **4\-year bachelor's degree** in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related discipline, together with **at least two years' experience** in Human Resources, management operations or a related professional area.

  

Experience gained within **hospitality, luxury, a large operational environment or another people\-intensive service business** would be particularly valuable.

 **London Marriott Hotel County Hall**

**Imagine coming to work with some of London's most famous landmarks on your doorstep.**


Embrace history and luxury at **London Marriott Hotel County Hall**, located on London's vibrant South Bank, just steps from Westminster Bridge.


Occupying London's former County Hall, the hotel combines the building's remarkable heritage with quintessentially British hospitality. It is a destination unlike almost any other and an extraordinary environment in which to build your career.


Our teams create memorable experiences in a setting steeped in history, with inspiration around every corner. The hotel's **Gillray's Steakhouse \& Bar** is known for its distinctive British character and extensive collection of more than 100 gins.


Quite simply, this is an opportunity to **work in one of London's most photographed destinations while shaping the culture and people experience behind it.**

 **Be You. Belong With Us.**


At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.


Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non\-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status or any other basis protected by applicable law.

**Ready to make your impact at London Marriott Hotel County Hall? We would love to hear from you.**

  

Marriott Hotels strive to elevate the art of hospitality, innovating at every opportunity while keeping the comfort of the oh\-so\-familiar all around the globe. As a host with Marriott Hotels, you will help keep the promise of "Wonderful Hospitality. Always." by delivering thoughtful, heartfelt, forward\-thinking service that upholds and builds upon this living legacy. With the name that's synonymous with hospitality the world over, we are proud to welcome you to explore a career with Marriott Hotels. In joining Marriott Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. **Be** where you can do your best work, **begin** your purpose, **belong** to an amazing global team, and **become** the best version of you.


JW Marriott is part of Marriott International's luxury portfolio and consists of more than 100 beautiful properties in gateway cities and distinctive resort locations around the world. JW believes our associates come first. Because if you're happy, our guests will be happy. JW Marriott associates are confident, innovative, genuine, intuitive, and carry on the legacy of the brand's namesake and company founder, J.Willard Marriott. Our hotels offer a work experience unlike any other, where you'll be part of a community and enjoy true camaraderie with a diverse group of co\-workers. JW creates opportunities for training, development, recognition and most importantly, a place where you can pursue your passions in a luxury environment with a focus on holistic well\-being. Treating guests exceptionally starts with the way we take care of our associates. That's The JW Treatment. In joining JW Marriott, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. **Be** where you can do your best work, **begin** your purpose, **belong** to an amazing global team, and **become** the best version of you.

title: Senior Policy Officer – 24 Hour London
description:
**Key information**
-------------------


Salary: £58,217 per annum


Grade: 9


Contract type: Permanent, Full Time


Reference: 5646


Application closing date: Mon, 12/10/2026 \- 23:59


**Good Growth**
---------------


Good Growth is responsible for delivering and implementing the Mayor’s culture, 24 hour city, licensing, environment, transport and economic strategies and for the effective implementation of the London Plan. The Directorate is also responsible for regeneration (where the programme is not housing led), enterprise, growth, capital projects and design work.

  

**About the team**
------------------

The 24 Hour London and Licensing Team leads on the The Mayor’s ambition for London to be a leading 24\-hour global city. That is because a quarter of London’s economic output (£139bn) happens at night, supporting 1\.3 million jobs. The night time economy includes industries like media and transport, health and hospitality. It also includes our £21bn nightlife scene which attracts people and businesses from around the world and makes them want to stay in London.

  

**About the role**
------------------


This is an exciting opportunity to join the Culture, Creative Industries and 24 Hour London Unit.


The aim of this role is to deliver key 24 Hour London projects, bringing in expert knowledge on nightlife and insights on the night time economy. It includes devising and delivering programmes that support the recommendations of the London Nightlife Taskforce and support for the hospitality sector.


It requires partnership working with the nightlife sector, boroughs, police, developers, place\-makers, GLA teams, business and community groups, TfL and others.


You’ll be at the heart of a fast\-paced team that also includes the Mayor’s new Strategic Licensing function.


This is a unique opportunity to:


* Work with the new independent London Nightlife Taskforce
* Deliver a new Nightlife Fund to support growth, diversity and innovation of London’s nightlife scenes
* Deliver the Mayor’s flagship Summer Streets programme to support the hospitality sector through outdoor dining, later opening and events
* Support the development of London as a 24 hour city
* Work with senior stakeholders across government, industry, and the city
* Make a visible impact on how London works, plays, and grows

The post\-holder will have experience of working with nightlife, hospitality and other key 24 hour London stakeholders. They will ideally be familiar with working in, or with government.

  

**What your day will look like**
--------------------------------


* Leading meetings in your project area and attending team and unit meetings
* Managing a busy inbox and Teams chats
* Writing papers to secure approval for project plans, reports and other activity, from the Mayor’s Office or GLA Directors
* Developing detailed programme delivery plans, evaluations and reports
* Responding to questions from the public, the London Assembly, the Mayor’s Office or other stakeholders
* Having regular contact with nightlife and hospitality stakeholders, keeping abreast of industry issues, and briefing colleagues as required.
  

**Skills, knowledge and experience**
------------------------------------


To be considered for the role you must meet the following essential criteria:


* Experience and knowledge of nightlife, night time economy and 24 hour economy policy and stakeholders
* Leading the development and delivery of strategic initiatives and projects
* Developing and maintaining effective strategic relationships with key partners to support Mayoral objective
* Support the delivery of communications and marketing campaign
* Managing grant funding programmes and follow public sector governance requirements
* Procuring and managing consultants
  

**Behavioural Competencies**
----------------------------

  

  

**Strategic Thinking**


…is using an understanding of the bigger picture to uncover potential challenges and opportunities for the long term and turning these into a compelling vision for action.


Level 3 indicators of effective performance:


* Translates GLA vision and strategy into practical and tangible plans for own team or delivery partners

* Informs strategy development by identifying gaps in current delivery or evidence

… is presenting information and arguments clearly and convincingly so that others see us as credible and articulate, and engage with us.

* Negotiates effectively to deliver GLA priorities
* Synthesises the complex viewpoints of others, recognises where compromise is necessary and brokers agreement

… is understanding and being sensitive to organisational dynamics, culture and politics across and beyond the GLA and shaping our approach accordingly.


Level 3 indicators of effective performance:


* Uses understanding of differences between the GLA and its partners to improve working relationships
* Helps others understand the GLA and the compel environment in which it operates

* Considers the diverse needs of Londoners in formulating GLA objectives

title: Portfolio Digital Marketing Officer
description:
### **Step Into a Role With Strategic Ownership, Commercial Impact \& Real Influence**


**Salary:** Competitive \-we want to find the right person for the role  

**Working Hours:** Full\-time \- UK or Dubai working hours  

**Location:** Fully Remote  

**Working With:** Founder, Portfolio COO \& Senior Leadership Team

**The Opportunity**
-------------------


We are looking for an exceptional **Portfolio Digital Marketing Officer** to lead marketing strategy, growth and commercial performance across a portfolio of businesses, brands and offers.


This is **not a conventional single\-brand marketing role**.


You will work closely with the Founder, COO and senior leadership team to shape and execute marketing strategy across multiple businesses at different stages of maturity \- from established brands through to new offers, launches and growth initiatives.


Your role will be to create clarity across the portfolio: where growth should come from, which channels deserve investment, which offers are underperforming, where positioning needs to change, and where marketing resource should be deployed for maximum commercial return.


This role requires both **strategic leadership and strong digital marketing depth**. You must be comfortable operating at executive level while understanding the mechanics of funnels, paid media, conversion, lifecycle marketing, CRM, content, organic acquisition and digital product marketing well enough to challenge teams and drive better outcomes.


You will not be expected to personally execute every campaign or channel. Your role is to build the strategy, set the standard, allocate resources, create accountability and ensure marketing activity translates into measurable commercial growth.

**Portfolio Marketing Strategy**
--------------------------------


You will:

* Develop and own the overarching marketing strategy across the portfolio.
* Translate business objectives into clear marketing priorities, growth plans and measurable targets.
* Identify the strongest growth opportunities across brands, products, markets and customer segments.
* Determine where marketing investment should increase, decrease or stop based on performance and commercial potential.
* Ensure individual brand strategies align with wider portfolio objectives without unnecessary duplication.
* Support the Founder and COO in evaluating new offers, markets, partnerships and acquisition opportunities from a marketing perspective.
* Maintain a clear view of the portfolio marketing roadmap, major launches, campaigns and strategic priorities.

**Growth \& Commercial Performance**
------------------------------------


You will own marketing performance against commercial outcomes, including:

* Revenue
* Lead generation
* Customer acquisition
* Conversion
* Customer retention
* Return on marketing investment


You will monitor customer acquisition cost, ROAS, funnel conversion, lifetime value and other relevant performance measures, identifying underperforming funnels, campaigns and offers and ensuring corrective action is taken quickly.


You will work closely with Sales, Finance and Operations to improve forecasting and understand the full customer acquisition economics of each business.


A disciplined test\-and\-learn culture should underpin acquisition, conversion and retention, with marketing decisions supported by reliable data and clear attribution wherever possible.

**Digital Marketing Leadership**
--------------------------------


You will provide senior oversight across:

* Paid media
* Organic social
* Content marketing
* Email and lifecycle marketing
* CRM and marketing automation
* Funnel strategy
* Landing pages and conversion optimisation
* SEO and organic acquisition
* Webinar and VSL funnels
* Affiliate and partnership marketing
* Product launches
* Lead generation
* Customer retention and reactivation
* Digital analytics and attribution


You should be capable of evaluating the performance and strategic direction of each area without needing to personally operate every platform.


You need sufficient depth across these disciplines to challenge performance, diagnose issues and ensure the right people are delivering the work.

**Brand \& Positioning**
------------------------


You will ensure each brand within the portfolio has a clear positioning, target audience and market proposition.


This includes:

* Challenging weak or undifferentiated messaging.
* Maintaining consistency between brand promise, customer journey and product experience.
* Overseeing major brand, messaging and campaign decisions.
* Working with creative and content teams to ensure output supports commercial objectives while protecting brand integrity.
* Identifying where legacy positioning, creative or messaging is constraining growth.

**Marketing Organisation \& Resource Allocation**
-------------------------------------------------


You will be responsible for ensuring the right people, skills and resources are focused on the highest\-value opportunities.


You will:

* Assess the structure, capability and effectiveness of internal and external marketing resources.
* Identify capability gaps and recommend recruitment, agency or technology solutions where required.
* Set clear ownership and performance expectations across marketing functions.
* Prevent duplication across brands and identify opportunities for shared infrastructure, systems and expertise.
* Build a high\-performance marketing operating model across the portfolio.
* Ensure agencies and external partners are commercially accountable and deliver measurable value.

**️ Marketing Operations \& Systems**
-------------------------------------


You will ensure the marketing function has the systems and processes required to operate effectively.


This includes:

* Campaign planning, attribution, reporting and performance management.
* Establishing a reliable single source of truth for key marketing metrics.
* Improving CRM, automation and data infrastructure with Technology and Operations.
* Ensuring effective use of AI, automation and emerging technology.
* Reducing manual work and improving speed to market and marketing productivity.
* Establishing clear processes for campaign planning, testing, approval and post\-campaign review.

**Leadership \& Cross\-Functional Working**
-------------------------------------------


You will work across the organisation to ensure marketing is connected to wider commercial priorities.


This includes:

* Working directly with the Founder and COO on growth strategy and commercial priorities.
* Partnering with Sales to improve lead quality, conversion and revenue performance.
* Working with Product teams to ensure customer insight informs offer development.
* Collaborating with Finance on budgets, forecasting and marketing ROI.
* Coordinating with PR, Events and Brand teams on integrated campaigns.
* Providing senior marketing leadership and mentoring marketing leaders and specialists.

**What This Role Is Not**
-------------------------


This is **not** a role for someone who wants to personally run every campaign.


You will not be expected to:

* Personally build every funnel.
* Manage every paid campaign.
* Write every email.
* Approve every social post.
* Become the project manager for routine marketing execution.
* Spend your time pulling reports manually.
* Accept activity as a substitute for commercial performance.


There is, however, one area where ownership is absolute:

### **You will be expected to 100% own the profitability of every funnel across the portfolio.**


This does not mean personally operating every element of every funnel.


It means knowing exactly how each funnel is performing, understanding the economics behind it, identifying where profitability is being lost, ensuring the right people are fixing it and being accountable for the commercial outcome.


You must always know:

* Which funnels are profitable and which are not.
* What CAC, conversion, AOV, LTV and payback period look like.
* Where margin is being eroded.
* Which offers should be scaled.
* Which require intervention.
* Which should be stopped.


You need to be able to go deep enough to diagnose a problem without becoming the person doing everyone else's job.

**Skills \& Experience**
------------------------


We are looking for a senior marketing leader with significant experience driving digital growth and commercial performance.


You should have:

* Significant experience in a CMO, Marketing Director, VP Marketing, Head of Growth or equivalent senior role.
* Strong experience in digital\-first, direct\-to\-consumer, education, coaching, subscription, SaaS, information products or similarly performance\-led environments.
* Demonstrable responsibility for revenue\-generating marketing strategies.
* Strong understanding of paid acquisition, funnels, CRM, lifecycle marketing and conversion optimisation.
* Experience managing significant marketing budgets and making investment decisions based on ROI.
* Strong knowledge of customer acquisition economics, including CAC, LTV, ROAS and conversion.
* Experience leading multi\-disciplinary marketing teams.
* Strong analytical and commercial capability.
* Experience managing external agencies, freelancers and specialist partners.
* Strong understanding of brand positioning and customer messaging.
* Experience working with senior executives and Founders.
* Excellent communication and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to move between strategic portfolio\-level thinking and detailed performance analysis.
* Experience working across multiple businesses or brands simultaneously would be highly advantageous.

**The Person We're Looking For**
--------------------------------


The ideal candidate is **commercially obsessed**.


You care about brand, creative and customer experience, but understand that marketing ultimately needs to generate **profitable, sustainable growth**.


You are comfortable challenging assumptions, legacy approaches and underperforming activity.


You do not simply accept:


“We’ve always done it this way.”


“The agency says the campaign is performing well.”


“Engagement is up.”


“The leads just aren’t converting.”


You want to understand the **economics behind the statement**.


You are highly analytical without being paralysed by data and highly creative without becoming subjective.


You are comfortable moving between a board\-level conversation about market positioning and a detailed discussion about why a landing page is converting at 1\.2%.


You understand the difference between **managing marketing activity and leading a growth engine**.


Most importantly, you can operate across multiple businesses without becoming consumed by whichever brand happens to be shouting the loudest.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


Success in this role will be measured against:

* Revenue attributable to marketing.
* Marketing contribution to portfolio growth.
* Customer acquisition cost.
* Return on marketing investment.
* Return on ad spend where appropriate.
* Lead volume and quality.
* Lead\-to\-sale conversion rate.
* Funnel conversion rates.
* Customer lifetime value.
* Retention and repeat purchase performance where relevant.
* Marketing budget performance against forecast.
* Speed and effectiveness of testing.
* Performance improvement of underperforming funnels and campaigns.
* Delivery of major launches against commercial targets.
* Accuracy and reliability of marketing reporting.
* Reduction in duplicated or low\-value marketing activity across the portfolio.
* Effectiveness and performance of internal teams and external agencies.


Specific numerical targets should be agreed by business and reviewed regularly rather than applying arbitrary portfolio\-wide benchmarks.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------


This role would suit a senior marketing leader who has already proved they can grow one business and is ready to operate across a broader portfolio.


You will have:

* Significant autonomy.
* Direct access to the Chairman and Portfolio COO.
* Responsibility for shaping how marketing investment is deployed across multiple businesses.
* The opportunity to influence strategy across brands at different stages of maturity.
* A fully remote working environment, aligned to UK or Dubai working hours.


We are looking for someone who can see the whole portfolio, identify the greatest commercial opportunities and build the strategy, people, systems and accountability required to capture them.

title: Head of Innovation
description:
**Welcome to KFC. Home of the real ones.**


We sell the world’s best chicken. Seriously. And we’ve done it since 1939, when the idea of crispy, original recipe chicken took Kentucky by storm. Now, we’re proud to serve 1000\+ communities across the UK and Ireland, bringing the grit, pride and iconic reputation that we started with, all those years ago.


Across the Restaurant Support Centre (RSC), we come to work to be ourselves, and to make something of ourselves. We want to see our potential go that little bit further, as part of one of the world’s most iconic brands.


What’s the gig? Well, you support our restaurants — and we’ll support you every step of the way. Simple. Our doors are open — and they can take you anywhere.


All we ask is that you be you. Because that makes us, us. Sound good? Great. Let’s find out about that job.

 **THE TEAM**


Our Marketing team is a 50\-strong crew of bold thinkers, culture shapers and creative doers \- from Brand and Digital to Strategy, Corporate Affairs, Food Quality and Innovation. We’re here to keep KFC at the heart of culture across the UK \& Ireland, blending our iconic roots with fresh, fearless ideas that connect with real people. We don’t just make ads \- we build love, drive growth, and stay one step ahead of what’s next.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**


This is a senior growth role at the heart of KFC UK\&I’s future menu and customer strategy.


You’ll lead our three\-year Menu Vision, shape the occasions and need states we want to win, and own the Innovation portfolio that brings those opportunities to life. From new growth platforms and value innovation to partnerships and future menu ideas, you’ll help decide where we place our bets and what we prioritise.


You’ll connect customer insight, commercial opportunity and restaurant reality, bringing teams across Food, Brand, Commercial, Digital, Operations and Supply Chain together behind a clear growth agenda.


And because UK\&I is a lead market for KFC globally, your influence won’t stop here. You’ll also help shape Global thinking, investment and future innovation priorities.

  

  

**WHAT YOU’LL SPEND YOUR TIME DOING**  

  

**Menu Vision, CUO \& Value Growth Strategy**  

* Own our three\-year Menu Vision and define the customer occasions and need states we want to win.
* You’ll turn customer and cultural insight into clear growth priorities, setting the guardrails for Food, Brand, Commercial, Digital and Operations and translating them into AOP commitments and an 18–36 month roadmap.
* You’ll also shape how Innovation contributes to our Value agenda, making sure we’re creating compelling propositions for customers while delivering sustainable commercial growth.
 **Innovation Portfolio \& Growth Platform**  

* Own and prioritise the Innovation portfolio across core menu optimisation, value innovation, scalable platforms, calendar innovation, collaborations and longer\-term pipeline
* You’ll make clear choices around what we start, stop, accelerate or deprioritise, balancing customer opportunity, commercial return, restaurant complexity and available resource.
* For the biggest opportunities, you’ll build the case and recommend where KFC should place its next major bets.

  

**Growth System, Briefs \& Decision Making**  

* Create a clear and effective innovation system that takes ideas from insight through to test, learn and scale.
* You’ll set stage gates, lead decision forums and make go/no\-go calls within agreed guardrails.
* Most importantly, you’ll turn strategy into brilliant briefs and clear propositions that give teams the confidence and clarity to deliver.

  

**Commercial Accountability \& Enterprise Mobilisation**  

* Great ideas only matter if they drive growth.
* You’ll partner closely with Commercial and Finance to size opportunities, define success measures and build compelling business cases.
* You’ll use insight and commercial judgement to make clear recommendations, challenge thinking where needed and bring our Leadership Team, franchisees and cross\-functional teams behind the strongest opportunities.

  

**Global Lead Market \& Strategic Partnerships**  

* UK\&I plays an important role in shaping the future of KFC globally.
* You’ll represent UK\&I as a lead market across Menu Vision, Snacking and CUO growth, selected partnerships and future innovation.
* You’ll build strong relationships with Global teams, influence multi\-market priorities and make sure we’re using the best thinking and investment from across the KFC system.

  

**People Leadership \& Senior Leadership Deputy**  

* You’ll lead and coach our Innovation team, creating clarity, accountability and space for people to grow.
* You’ll also independently lead major Customer Strategy and Menu Growth agendas and deputise for the Strategy \& Innovation Director with senior leaders, franchisees and Global teams.

  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**  

Pretty much everyone.  

* You’ll work closely with our Strategy \& Innovation Director and wider leadership team, as well as teams across Insights \& CX, Food, Brand, Commercial, Finance, Digital, Operations and Supply Chain.
* You’ll also build strong relationships with franchisees, Global Menu and Innovation teams, and external partners and collaborators.
* This role isn’t about owning every piece of delivery yourself. It’s about creating clarity, making strong decisions and bringing brilliant people together behind the right opportunities.

  

**WHAT WE’D LOVE FROM YOU**  

* You’ll likely bring around **10\+ years’ experience** across innovation, food, menu, brand or customer growth within a fast\-moving consumer business.
* Experience in QSR, FMCG, retail, hospitality or another consumer\-led brand would be brilliant.

  

**We’d love to see:**  

* Experience owning a multi\-year innovation, customer growth or portfolio strategy, not just delivering individual projects.
* Strong understanding of customer behaviour, occasions and need states, and how to turn them into propositions people genuinely want.
* Commercial confidence, with experience sizing opportunities, developing business cases and making investment and resource trade\-offs.
* Experience leading innovation systems, including stage gates, test\-and\-learnand scaling successful platforms.
* Strong cross\-functional leadership and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on hierarchy.

 **WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**


We offer benefits that make your life that little bit easier, because we know the juggle is real.


From flexible, hybrid working to Fri\-Yay early finishes and Live Well Days, we’ve created a package that supports the real you, in and out of work.


You’ll get:

* Hybrid working from our Woking RSC (just 24 mins from London). This role is remote based but occasional visits to our RSC will be required.
* Up to 11% company pension contributions
* Fri\-Yay finishes at 1pm every Friday
* 25 days’ holiday (plus bank hols) a
* 5 Live Well Days a year, just for you
* Bonus scheme linked to company \& personal performance
* Private healthcare, Digital GP access \& mental health coaching
* Enhanced parental leave and flexible return options
* Study support, income protection, life cover \& more
* And yes \- 25% off the chicken


Because real ones deserve real rewards.

 **KFC FOR EVERYONE:**


Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, KFC is a place where you can bring the real you to work.


Our promise is this: every person who applies to a role at KFC, regardless of age, background, ethnicity, gender, ability, religion or sexual orientation, will have an equal opportunity to work here. We don’t just welcome, we encourage applications from underrepresented groups from all industries.


If you’d like any additional support with your application, have a disability or condition that may affect your performance during the recruitment process, or have any other requirements — just let us know. We’ll be there to help you be the real you.

 **Ready?**


We hope so, if you’re ready to be part of our community, now’s the time to apply.


Worried you aren’t ticking all the boxes? Don’t \- we’d still love to hear from you.

*Beware of fake job postings using Yum! and/or our brand logos \- KFC, Pizza Hut, Taco Bell and Habit Burger \& Grill \- on fraudulent sites. Yum! Brands only posts jobs on official careers pages and never asks for money during onboarding. Avoid unsolicited contacts via Telegram, WhatsApp or similar social apps.*
