title: Programme Manager
description:
We are looking for a Programme Manager to join our delivery team, covering national, regional and local programmes.

**Job title: Programme Manager (x2\)**

**Base:** Health Innovation KSSs primary place of business is The Beehive, located in Gatwick/Crawley, West Sussex. We have further satellite / hot\-desking arrangements at sites located in Guildford and Brighton. Contractually, your normal place of work will be Health Innovation KSSs primary place of business.

**Location:** The role is predominately remote, although Health Innovation KSS work on a hybrid basis. Post holders are expected to be based in, or be able to attend meetings in the Kent, Surrey, Sussex geography.

**Reports to:** Head of Portfolio

**Direct reports:** Project delivery resource and access to a pool of team members if required.

**Contract:** 1\-year Fixed Term Contract

**Salary:** £55,000 to £57,000 per annum depending on experience

**Job Purpose**

* Working as part of the programme and project resource team within Health Innovation, taking a leadership role for a portfolio of programme areas.
* The specific area of responsibility for the role (at appointment and/or as appropriate for individual role holders) will be outlined at **Appendix A.** Please note that any specific area of responsibility is subject to change, according to future programme delivery requirements.
* Managing a programme which may include some Senior Programme/Innovation Manager or Associate Director involvement.
* Taking a lead responsibility for the organisation and delivery of collaborative learning events in conjunction with Clinical Leads.
* Supporting innovation focused colleagues in the delivery of tailored packages of support to industry.
* Supporting innovation focused colleagues in having a range of conversations with organisations to help deliver the spread and adoption of innovation into practice, developing the innovation eco\-system and pipeline.
* Making a contribution to income and the income generation pipeline to generate income for Health Innovation KSS to ensure long\-term sustainability by:


. Contributing to bids or grant applications for funding to support services offered by Health Innovation KSS.


. Working closely with innovation focused colleagues in the identification and securing of contracts of tailored packages, in support of industry


. Delivering tailored packages of support to industry according to the agreed contract and reporting via ‘consultancy timesheet approach’


. Working closely with the appropriate Senior Programme/Innovation Managers and Associate Directors to support and facilitate:


. The development of new service offerings for our stakeholders and ensuring that a clear customer focus is maintained


. The cultivation of existing customer demand through the marketing of existing service provision


. The cultivation of new customers through service development opportunities.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

* To work closely with the relevant Associate Director(s), Senior Programme Manager(s) and where appropriate, Clinical Leads in the management and delivery of an assigned portfolio, which may include both local and national commissioned programmes of work.
* To create good working relationships with teams in organisations participating in those projects and programmes. Building expertise, trust and commitment to the goals of the projects and programmes.
* To create and exploit links between clinical teams, industry and academia wherever it supports delivery of project and programme goals.
* To horizon scan for examples of innovation within the project areas that can be spread and adopted.
* To make a contribution to income and the income generation pipeline through projects and programmes to generate income for Health Innovation KSS to ensure long\-term sustainability.
* To support organisations to adopt NICE Technology Appraisals relevant to the project areas.
* To ensure that any risks relating to the delivery of programmes within an assigned portfolio (including risks to the programme delivering within budget) are managed wherever possible and/or proactively alerted to the appropriate Senior Programme Manager, Associate Director and/or Service Delivery Director.
* To lead and facilitate meetings with clinical practitioners within and across health, social care, independent and voluntary sector organisations within Kent Surrey and Sussex.
* To identify and make recommendations on developmental needs across teams.
* To identify examples of best practice and solutions that can be shared and networked.
* To participate in data quality assurance audits and peer reviews in provider organisations.
* To work closely with external partners to ensure the provision of appropriate and timely analysis to support the implementation of programmes.
* To support and facilitate providers in the development of metrics and impact measures.
* To prepare reports, briefings and presentations as required and present at meetings and conferences.
* To interpret relevant national policy with regard to service and productivity improvement and ensure appropriate implementation.
* To represent Health Innovation KSS at meetings with NHSI/NHSE and other national bodies as appropriate.
* To work closely with commissioners to support the implementation of Health Innovation KSS objectives.

**General responsibilities**

* To act as part of 'one team'.
* To promote the values of Health Innovation KSS.
* To ensure effective communications within and between project teams, be involved in and participate in meetings, team briefings, development days, corporate events etc.
* To engage with line manager in regular performance and development reviews against agreed objectives. To be responsible for actively identifying own development needs and committing to a personal development plan based on continuous learning.

**Values and behaviours**


Health Innovation KSS has developed a clear vision for the direction of the company. A set of values and behaviours have also been developed and agreed to underpin this vision. Our values and behaviours framework can be found below. Applicants and employees will be expected to demonstrate an understanding of and commitment to these values and behaviours, which will be assessed through the recruitment, selection and appraisal processes.

**Diversity and equal opportunities**


It is the desire of Health Innovation KSS to broaden diversity within its workforce.


Health Innovation KSS is an equal opportunities employer and ensures that all new, existing and prospective employees are treated fairly through the principles of equal treatment and promotion of diversity.


This includes:

* ensuring that all individuals who come into contact with Health Innovation KSS, whether as employees, stakeholders or in any other capacity are treated with dignity and respect;
* ensuring that the opportunities Health Innovation KSS provides for learning, personal development and employment are made available on a non\-discriminatory basis and;
* providing a safe, supportive and welcoming environment for employees, stakeholders, visitors and others.


Along with 15 HINs in the HIN Network, we are committed to a series of pledges to further support the diversity and innovation agenda.

**Person Specification: Programme Manager**

**Education, Qualifications \& Training**

**Essential**

* Educated to degree standard or equivalent in a relevant discipline
* Project or portfolio management qualification or equivalent experience
* Evidence of continuous professional development; record of CPD shows strong self\-development ethos and learning

**Desirable**

* An appropriate professional qualification or Master’s degree

**Knowledge \& Experience**

**Essential**

* Significant recent management experience in the NHS or other organisation in a relevant sector
* Evidence of effective partnership working
* Proven experience of managing large scale projects or programmes in the public sector
* Managing resources to support the delivery of projects / programmes.
* Financial and performance management experience.
* Experience of working with a range of staff at all levels, including clinicians.
* Experience of clinical transformation projects
* Significant knowledge of the health and/or social care sectors

**Desirable**

* Experience of undertaking reviews of national policy.
* Experience of providing advice to senior managers and consultants.

**Skills \& Abilities**

* Sound knowledge of the NHS, social care, current government policies and change / innovation programmes
* Able to think strategically and analytically
* Ability to develop strong working relationships
* Analysis and synthesis of complex information
* Able to make a contribution to Health Innovation KSS income generation pipeline through innovation programmes
* Excellent communication, influencing and negotiating skills.
* Advanced IT skills and good working knowledge of IT systems e.g. Excel and Access.
* Drive, energy, enthusiasm and determination.
* Creative and lateral thinker
* Facilitation skills to direct and support teams to achieve change through measurable outcomes

**Desirable**

* Sound knowledge of the NHS, social care, current government policies and change / innovation programmes.
* Bid writing skills.

**Personal Style \& Behaviours**

**Essential**

* Constructively challenges current practice
* Has a flexible and adaptable approach to work
* Helps others to develop themselves
* Values diversity and looks for opportunities to improve equality
* Acts with integrity and presents themselves as a good role model
* Smart, professional appearance and outlook

**Other requirements**

**Essential**

* Reliable work record
* Travel, as required, within the KSS patch.

**Desirable**

* Possesses a driving licence

title: Director of Creative, Luxury Hospitality
description:
**Luxury storyteller. Creative leader. Brand obsessive.**
 Luxury is felt long before it is booked. If you know how to create work that makes people stop, look twice and want to be there, this is a rare opportunity to do it on a global stage.
   

  

 Six Senses, Regent, InterContinental, Vignette Collection and Kimpton sit at the heart of the IHG Hotels \& Resorts Luxury \& Lifestyle portfolio. Each has its own character, its own following and its own sense of place. As the portfolio grows, and as our Upper Luxury brands take centre stage, we are creating dedicated creative leadership to protect what makes each one distinctive and push the work further.
   

  

 As Creative Director, you will set the creative vision for our luxury and lifestyle brands and be the senior creative partner to the people who lead them. Your thinking will shape campaigns, content, hotel openings and guest moments, from the first image someone sees to the detail they notice on arrival.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Global Creative Services and based in Windsor, you will work across global and regional teams, with international travel part of the rhythm of the role.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Set and champion the creative vision for the Luxury \& Lifestyle portfolio, keeping every brand true to its own voice.
* Partner closely with brand, marketing and commercial leaders, bringing a clear point of view to the decisions that shape how we show up.
* Lead global multi\-channel campaigns and content that build desire and deliver commercially, across owned, earned and paid.
* Raise the bar on craft, from photography and film to design systems, experiential moments and digital.
* Mentor creative talent and get the best from our studio and agency partners.
* Shape how creative works at IHG, including where new technology and AI tools genuinely add something, without losing the human judgement behind great work.


**What You'll Bring**
* A career built in creative leadership, within luxury hospitality, luxury retail, travel, lifestyle or premium consumer brands.
* A portfolio that speaks for itself, with storytelling and visual craft at a level our guests would expect.
* A genuine point of view on modern luxury and what makes it feel current rather than expected.
* Confidence with senior leaders, and the presence to take them with you.
* Proven success leading integrated global campaigns across multiple markets.
* The instinct to lead multidisciplinary teams and agencies well, and to build something that scales.
* Experience with ultra\-premium or Upper Luxury brands is a real advantage, as is time spent on both agency and client side.


 If you want your work to live in some of the most beautiful hotels in the world, and to lead the creative story of a luxury portfolio in its next chapter, we would love to see it. Apply now.
   

  

*Closing date for applications Friday 2nd October 2026*
 At IHG Hotels \& Resorts, we work together to deliver True Hospitality for Good on a global scale. With corporate offices and over 6,000 hotel destinations worldwide, a career at IHG is the perfect way to broaden your horizons. You’ll experience our unique culture and brilliant colleagues who will support and inspire you. With a host of corporate opportunities to choose from, wherever you are on your career journey, and whatever you want to achieve there’s Room for You at IHG.
   

  

 Over recent years, we’ve transformed our company. We have bold ambitions to drive performance and maintain our relentless focus on growth in order to be the hotel company of choice that guests \& owners love.
   

  

 We are a hospitality business at our core and value connections and being together helps us foster a unique sense of belonging that also supports productivity. That’s why here at IHG, we give our colleagues flexibility and balance – working in a hybrid way, blending office and remote working collectively. We recognise that every role is different, that’s why leaders work with teams to determine how and when they collaborate.
   

  

 We provide a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life. These include impressive room discounts across our many properties, recharge days and volunteering days throughout the year. Through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace. We offer a unique and inclusive culture, where there is always Room for You to belong, grow and make a difference.
   

  

 Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels \& Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other category protected by applicable laws. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
   

  

 Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

title: Brand Manager
description:
No Relocation Assistance Offered
   

  

 Job Number \#175387 \- Del.Miguel Hidalgo, Mexico City, Mexico
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Colgate\-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specialising in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!
   

  

 Join Colgate\-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Are you passionate about premium skincare, innovative marketing, and making a real impact on brand growth? Join our dynamic team as a
 **Brand Manager for Filorga** 
 !
   

  

 In this role, you will be the key driver of local marketing execution, bridging global vision with impactful local activations. You will collaborate closely with our global team in France to adapt international brand guidelines and bring high\-profile launches, events, and campaigns to life across local markets. From orchestrating major medical congresses and Filorga Days to managing a robust digital and influencer strategy, you will shape how our brand connects with healthcare professionals, influencers, and consumers!

* Availability and willingness to travel nationally and internationally.
* Advanced project management, analytical, and cross\-functional communication skills.

* Master’s degree or MBA.
* Experience adapting global brand guidelines to local markets.
* Expertise in working with medical/dermatology influencers, healthcare professionals, or specialized congresses.
* Proven track record in public relations, agency management, and high\-impact brand partnerships.

 Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.

title: Director, Product Management and Design - Manufacturing Execution and Planning
description:
Application close date:


Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.
At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low\-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!


This role is part of Enterprise Technology (ET), where we’re developing the digital infrastructure needed to build the road to space, with an emphasis on digital capabilities required to advance Blue Origin’s mission. Enterprise Technology is the center of excellence for digital technology at Blue Origin, providing oversight and governance to align technology and business strategies.
We are building the road to space, which means rapidly expanding our mission cadence, increasing our manufacturing capabilities by orders of magnitude, and inventing new vehicles and systems such as lunar landers and Mars orbiters. Achieving these goals requires that we scale Blue Origin Manufacturing through software and artificial intelligence.


As Director, Product Management and Design, you will be responsible for Blue Origin's manufacturing execution system (MES), and be responsible for the core systems that help us achieve higher manufacturing rates. You will lead a capable team of product managers and UX designers, and forward deploy to the floor where we build rockets, engines, and satellites. Your team is the trusted partner that solves critical problems for manufacturing engineers, technicians, production planners, and operations executives, for example: how do we allocate materials / machines / labor to the right priorities, how do we improve yields and reduce defects, and how do we automate critical decisions and planning processes.


**Special Mentions**

* Relocation provided
* Travel expected up to 30% of the time

**In this role, you will:**

* Define strategy, roadmap, and priorities for Blue Origin's Manufacturing Execution (MES) and Production Planning systems
* Lead, mentor, and develop a multi\-disciplinary team of product and UX design
* Champion a culture of customer/user focus, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement across all manufacturing and planning domains
* Obsess over results and impact, not just software delivery
* Live on the factory floor in some weeks, solving problems alongside your team and your manufacturing operations partners
* Apply and sharpen your AI skills, both to deliver immediate results and to improve our judgment and thinking
* Develop incredible partnerships with your peer directors and VPs across software engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and Blue Origin's business units like New Glenn

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical field
* 10\+ years of product and software experience, with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles managing teams
* Demonstrated experience in the manufacturing or production planning domains, helping manufacturing leaders solve problems through software
* Proven ability to manage cross\-functional programs, balance competing priorities, and deliver under schedule and budget constraints
* Excellent communication skills with demonstrated ability to present complex technical topics to executive leadership and non\-technical stakeholders
* Ability to influence executives and drive complex decisions, including those in fields different from your own
* Proficiency with AI harnesses and coding tools
* Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep experience with aerospace industry and aerospace regulatory standards like AS9100, ITAR, EAR
* Master's degree or relevant experience in business and finance

**Culture Statement**

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.  



  

**Export Control Regulations**

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.  



  

**Background Check**

* Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre\-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical  
* 

  

**Benefits**

* Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long\-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
* Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)

 Cosign is on a mission to expand access to housing by helping landlords approve more qualified renters without increasing risk. We partner with owners and property managers to close the qualification gap caused by conditional approvals, thin credit files, and the absence of guarantors, materially improving leasing conversion and occupancy. We're building toward a near future where every U.S. property offers Cosign to renters who struggle to qualify, expanding housing choice while helping owners and operators convert demand into signed leases.
 



  





**OUR HIRING PHILOSOPHY** 




  





 At Cosign, we seek exceptional talent with relentless intellectual curiosity, individuals who:
 



  




* Challenge the status quo and drive continuous improvement
* Demand excellence from themselves and their colleagues
* Identify and solve problems others don't even recognize
* Create innovative solutions others believe impossible



  





 We deliberately seek these rare, high\-impact performers who attract similar talent. While most companies avoid hiring these exceptional individuals due to their demanding nature, we actively pursue them. When we find someone extraordinary, we move quickly to bring them onboard.
 



  





 We believe average talent builds average companies. By assembling a team of exceptional performers, we're creating the talent density needed to transform the rental industry and set new standards of excellence.
 



  





**THE OPPORTUNITY** 




  





 Calling all storytellers and brand builders. We're looking for a strategic, hands\-on Communications Manager who can own how Cosign shows up everywhere, externally and internally, from leadership's LinkedIn to the sales deck in a rep's hand. You will build the communications function from the ground up and define how Cosign sounds at every touchpoint.
 



  





 As our first
 
 Communications Manager
 
 , you will own the entire stack: owned\-channel strategy across LinkedIn, blog, website, PR, and executive communications, plus the messaging frameworks, sales collateral, and enablement materials that arm Sales, Partnerships, and Customer Success to sell with confidence. You will build the content engine behind our executive thought leadership and our Partnerships team's outreach, while partnering closely with leadership to keep every customer\-facing message clear, consistent, and on\-position.
 



  





 Reporting to the Head of Marketing, this is a player\-coach role: you'll ship high\-stakes content yourself while coaching and upskilling a Copywriter, raising the bar for every piece of writing that leaves the company. It is ideal for someone who thrives in a startup environment, has built a communications function from 0 to 1 before, and is excited to own the full narrative, inside and outside the company, in a fast\-moving, early\-stage context.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Own Cosign's external communications engine across LinkedIn, the website, blog, PR, executive communications, and every customer\-facing channel, ensuring a consistent, compelling brand voice at every touchpoint
* Own the communications strategy end\-to\-end: editorial direction, messaging frameworks, brand voice, content planning, and cross\-functional alignment across Marketing, Product, Sales, and Customer Success

**ABOUT YOU** 




  





 As a highly motivated and data\-driven communications expert, you take full ownership of the communications function, from messaging strategy to final content execution, without needing direction. You are deeply committed to your targets, remain structured under pressure, and distinguish true impact from mere output.
 



  





 You thrive in early\-stage landscapes where processes are still evolving. Instead of seeing gaps as obstacles, you view them as chances to innovate, bring fresh ideas, and find energy in constructing something new rather than simply working inside it.
 



  





 You are a storyteller at heart, comfortable adapting your voice across executives, customers, partners, media, and internal teams, and using SEO insights and AI to drive the highest\-performing content.
 



  





**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE** 




  





 We are looking for a passionate communications leader who is excited to shape Cosign's voice and build a world\-class communications function from the ground up.
 



  




* 3\-5\+ years of experience in Communications, Content Marketing, Corporate Communications, Editorial, Brand Marketing, or a related field, ideally within a startup environment

* Strong cross\-functional leadership and the ability to influence Product, Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, and executive stakeholders without formal authority
* A passion for building systems from scratch, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment



  





**WHAT MAKES THIS OPPORTUNITY DIFFERENT** 




  





 This is an opportunity to join one of the fastest\-growing companies in U.S. PropTech at a pivotal moment in our growth. You will shape how Cosign communicates with the world, building the voice, content engine, and communications strategy that define our brand across customers, partners, investors, and the broader industry.

 Cosign is looking for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment and is excited to build alongside an ambitious team. Senior Couture Pattern Maker \& Sample Maker

We are looking for a freelancer highly experienced and technically skilled Senior Couture Pattern Maker \& Sample Maker to join our fashion atelier.

The ideal candidate must be able to take a design from concept or sketch through the full garment\-development process, including pattern making, draping, fabric cutting, garment construction, fitting, alterations, and couture\-level finishing.

This role requires someone with strong technical knowledge, excellent craftsmanship, and the ability to work independently on complex womenswear and couture pieces.

Key Responsibilities

\* Interpret fashion sketches, reference images, and creative direction and translate them into technically feasible garments.

\* Create accurate patterns from sketches, measurements, existing garments, or draped toile.

\* Draping directly on the mannequin to develop silhouettes, volume, gathers, pleats, asymmetric shapes, and flowing designs.

\* Prepare toiles and prototypes for fitting and development.

\* Cut fabrics accurately, including delicate and luxury materials such as silk, chiffon, organza, satin, lace, tulle, crepe, and other couture fabrics.

\* Construct complete garments from first sample through final piece.

\* Perform both machine sewing and high\-quality hand sewing.

\* Apply couture finishing techniques, including invisible hems, hand finishing, internal finishing, delicate closures, and clean seam construction.

\* Understand garment structure, balance, fit, proportion, and movement.

\* Conduct fittings and make necessary pattern and garment adjustments.

\* Develop solutions for internal garment support, boning, lining, interfacing, corsetry, and structured areas when required.

\* Work carefully with complex draping, bias\-cut garments, layered fabrics, and intricate silhouettes.

\* Ensure every garment meets a very high standard of craftsmanship, fit, and finishing.

\* Recommend appropriate construction methods based on the design and selected fabric.

\* Minimize fabric waste while maintaining accurate cutting and quality.

\* Maintain organized patterns, samples, and garment\-development records.

\* Work closely with the Creative Director to develop and refine each design while maintaining the original creative vision.

Required Experience \& Skills

\* Strong professional experience in couture, bridal, eveningwear, luxury womenswear, or high\-end bespoke fashion.

\* Advanced pattern\-making skills.

\* Advanced draping skills.

\* Excellent fabric\-cutting ability.

\* Excellent machine\-sewing and hand\-sewing skills.

\* Strong understanding of garment construction and couture finishing.

\* Ability to work with delicate, expensive, and difficult fabrics.

\* Strong knowledge of women’s garment fitting and alterations.

\* Ability to understand a sketch and independently determine how the garment should be constructed.

\* Experience creating samples and prototypes from the development stage through the final garment.

\* Excellent attention to detail and precision.

\* Strong problem\-solving skills when translating creative designs into wearable garments.

\* Ability to work independently and manage several designs during collection development.

Preferred

\* Experience working in a couture atelier, bridal house, luxury fashion house, or bespoke studio.

\* Experience with evening gowns, draped dresses, corsetry, and complex silhouettes.

\* Knowledge of embroidery, embellishment, fabric manipulation, and hand\-applied details is an advantage.

\* Experience developing garments from original designer sketches rather than only following existing patterns.

What We Are Looking For

We are specifically looking for someone who is not limited to one technical area. The candidate should be capable of managing the complete garment\-development process:

Sketch → Draping / Pattern Making → Toile → Fitting → Pattern Correction → Cutting → Sewing → Couture Finishing → Final Garment

The right candidate should combine technical expertise with an understanding of design, proportion, movement, and luxury craftsmanship.

title: Senior Director, Global Design, Construction & Space Standards
description:
**Company Description**  

Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today’s needs and tomorrow’s next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we’re living in and that we have the power to shape.


Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry\-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality.


Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward.

 **Job Description**  

The Senior Director, Global Design, Construction \& Space Standards leads the company’s global design, construction, workplace planning and space standards capabilities across a diverse international portfolio. This leader establishes how offices, laboratories, technical environments, collaboration spaces and employee amenities are programmed, designed, approved and delivered, while allowing appropriate adaptation for local codes and operating conditions.


The role leads the global project design and construction team, directs regional resources and external partners, and serves as the principal authority for design standards, space planning, project governance, design quality and workplace performance. The role also provides executive oversight for headquarters initiatives, major capital investments, campus transformations and other high\-visibility projects.

**Business Context**


The company requires a scalable global model that replaces inconsistent, project\-by\-project practices with clear standards, reliable space data, disciplined programming, defined decision rights, strong supplier accountability and integrated management of scope, cost, schedule, risk and operational readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Global Design \& Space Standards**

* Develop, implement and maintain global standards for workplace, laboratory and technical environments, including planning principles, space typologies, furniture, finishes, lighting, acoustics, accessibility, signage, workplace technology and brand integration.
* Define mandatory global requirements, appropriate regional adaptations and a documented standards\-exception process.
* Maintain a controlled standards library and continuously improve it using project outcomes, post\-occupancy findings, business needs, sustainability goals and market innovation.

**2\. Global Space Planning \& Portfolio Enablement**

* Establish the global space\-planning operating model, including intake, programming, decision rights, service levels and accountability among global, regional, site and external teams.
* Ensure headcount, attendance, utilization, equipment, technology, security and future\-growth assumptions are reflected in workplace and laboratory programs.
* Establish ownership and quality expectations for drawings, occupancy, capacity, allocation and utilization data to support portfolio decisions.

**3\. Global Project Leadership \& Executive Governance**

* Lead headquarters initiatives, major capital investments, campus transformations, flagship workplace projects and other strategically important programs across the global portfolio.
* Establish project governance, stage gates, standards, controls and executive reporting to ensure consistent delivery of scope, budget, schedule, quality, safety and operational readiness.
* Provide executive oversight for complex, high\-risk or high\-visibility projects and prepare clear business cases, project updates and decision materials for C\-suite leaders and executive governance forums.
* Drive alignment across Real Estate, Facilities, IT, Security, EHS, HR, Finance, Procurement, Communications and business stakeholders.
* Capture lessons learned from major projects and incorporate them into global standards, governance and future delivery strategies.

**4\. Team Leadership \& Capability Development**

* Lead, coach and develop a globally distributed team of design, construction, project\-management and space\-planning professionals.
* Define accountabilities across global, regional and site resources; establish expectations for technical review, stakeholder management, documentation, escalation and performance.
* Build succession plans, professional capability and a culture of transparency, constructive challenge and early problem\-solving.

**5\. External Partner \& Supplier Management**

* Establish performance expectations for architecture, engineering, project\-management, construction, cost\-management, furniture, workplace\-strategy and space\-planning partners.
* Develop consistent scopes, deliverables, selection criteria and review processes; ensure the assigned partner team has relevant experience, capacity and accountability.
* Monitor supplier performance against cost, schedule, design quality, risk, regulatory coordination, documentation and stakeholder outcomes in partnership with Procurement and Legal.

**6\. Workplace Quality, Sustainability \& Compliance**

* Translate company culture, employee needs and operational requirements into measurable workplace design principles and appropriate stakeholder\-engagement processes.
* Embed sustainability, energy efficiency, accessibility, well\-being, resilience, safety, maintainability and regulatory compliance into standards and project reviews.
* Ensure projects include effective change coordination, commissioning, handover, operational readiness and post\-occupancy evaluation.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, Interior Architecture, Real Estate, Workplace Strategy or a related field; master’s degree preferred.
* 15 or more years of progressive experience in design, construction, workplace, space planning, corporate real estate or capital programs, including significant global or multi\-region leadership.
* Demonstrated success leading major headquarters, campus, laboratory, workplace or capital programs and establishing enterprise standards or delivery frameworks.
* Experience leading internal teams and external architecture, engineering, project\-management, cost\-management and construction partners.
* Strong command of programming, design, cost planning, scheduling, permitting, procurement, construction, commissioning, occupancy and closeout.
* Executive presence and demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders, present complex recommendations clearly and align cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Ability to travel internationally and operate effectively across cultures, time zones and matrixed organizations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional registration or certification such as RA, PE, PMP, LEED, WELL, RICS or DBIA.
* Experience with laboratories, R\&D, advanced manufacturing support, critical environments or other technically complex workplaces.
* Experience with CAD/BIM, workplace\-management, occupancy, portfolio and project\-reporting platforms.
* Experience leading a design, construction, workplace or project\-delivery center of excellence and working within outsourced service\-provider models.

**Leadership Profile**

* Strategic and hands\-on, able to define a global model and intervene directly in complex or high\-risk issues.
* Technically credible, commercially astute, data oriented and decisive in ambiguity.
* A strong people leader and standards builder who converts fragmented practices into practical, scalable tools.
* An effective executive communicator who translates complex design, construction, financial and technical information into clear decisions.

  

**Additional Information**

We also prohibit harassment of any individual on any of the characteristics listed above. Our non\-discrimination policy applies to all aspects of employment. We comply with the laws and regulations set forth in the "Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal” poster. Our pay transparency policy is available here.

title: Director, Enterprise Experience Strategy and Design - Remote
description:

Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely \* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**


Enterprise Experience Strategy:

* Identify opportunities to improve constituent outcomes, engagement, satisfaction, retention, and growth across channels and lines of business
* Translate consumer needs, market insights, and business requirements into actionable experience recommendations and investment priorities.

* Demonstrated experience leveraging qualitative and quantitative research, Voice of Customer data, operational metrics, and market insights to develop recommendations, influence decision\-making, and establish performance measurement frameworks

* Demonstrated solid business acumen with experience building business cases, prioritizing investments, and connecting experience improvements to growth, operational performance, and financial outcomes

* Proven ability to lead large\-scale, cross\-functional initiatives and influence executive stakeholders across complex, highly matrixed organizations

title: Client Experience & Operations Coordinator
description:

title: Senior Director, Commercial Product Strategy HIV Treatment
description:

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.
  

  

**Job Description**  



At Gilead our pursuit of a healthier world for all people has yielded a cure for hepatitis C, revolutionary improvements in HIV treatment and prevention as well as advancements in therapies for viral and inflammatory diseases and certain cancers.  



  

We set and achieve bold ambitions in our fight against the world's most devastating diseases, united in our commitment to confronting the largest public health challenges of our day and improving the lives of patients for generations to come.

You will serve as a strategic leader within the HIV franchise, partnering across Commercial, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Value \& Access, Analytics, Public Affairs, Government Affairs, and regional stakeholders to develop and execute a differentiated global strategy.  



  

**This position is based onsite at Gilead's headquarters in Foster City, California. Remote work is not available for this role. Candidates must reside within a reasonable commuting distance of the Foster City area and be available to work onsite as required.**

  

**Global Launch \& Commercial Strategy**

* Lead the global go\-to\-market strategy for HIV Treatment, including brand positioning, value proposition, messaging architecture, and campaign strategy.
* Develop and drive integrated global launch and indication strategies that support market access, regulatory requirements, and country\-level execution.
* Ensure global strategic priorities inform and enable successful local commercialization plans.

**Strategic Insight \& Business Leadership**

* Translate complex market, competitive, customer, and product insights into actionable commercial strategies and business recommendations.
* Identify unmet needs and opportunities that strengthen brand differentiation and drive market adoption.
* Contribute to HIV portfolio strategy and cross\-brand positioning efforts.

**Enterprise Cross\-Functional Leadership**

* Partner across functions and geographies to align stakeholders around launch objectives and strategic priorities.
* Influence decision\-making by building strong partnerships with global and regional teams.
* Drive execution excellence across multiple workstreams while ensuring compliance with regulatory and corporate requirements.

**Commercial Planning \& Performance**

* Support development of earnings call materials, forecasts, long\-range planning activities, and leadership guidance.
* Lead development and implementation of innovative commercial initiatives aligned with brand objectives and growth priorities.
* Monitor strategic execution and adjust plans to address evolving market dynamics and business needs.

**Operational Excellence**

* Lead complex projects with accountability for quality, timelines, budget management, and stakeholder alignment.
* Foster disciplined execution and continuous improvement across launch and commercialization activities.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Life Sciences, Marketing, or related field and 14 years' relevant experience; OR
* Master's degree and 12 years' relevant experience; OR
* PhD and 12 years' relevant experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* MBA, advanced life sciences degree, or medical degree.
* HIV therapeutic area expertise.
* Global product launch experience.
* Country\-level marketing leadership or business unit leadership experience.
* Experience working across diverse global markets and cultures.
* Demonstrated success in multi\-channel marketing and global pharmaceutical planning.
* Experience supporting forecasting, long\-range planning, and executive communications.
* Background in management consulting, business transformation, or change management.
Advanced proficiency using Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.  
*

----------------------------------

* Develop Talent – understand the skills, experience, aspirations, and potential of their employees and coach them on current performance and future potential. They ensure employees are receiving the feedback and insight needed to grow, develop, and realize their purpose.
* Empower Teams – connect the team to the organization by aligning goals, purpose, and organizational objectives and holding them to account. They provide the support needed to remove barriers and connect their team to the broader ecosystem.

title: Senior Cloud / AWS Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Senior Cloud / AWS Infrastructure Engineer**


IT / Infrastructure \| Full\-Time, Salaried, Individual Contributor \| Reports to Director of IT

**Company** Seeking.com (Reflex Media)

**Location** Remote, anywhere in the USA.

**Compensation** $130,000 to $180,000 base.

**Schedule** Three evenings per week (5:30 to 7:30 PM US Pacific) to overlap with our Singapore Dev and DevOps partners. Flexed time available during the day.

**Travel** Occasional travel to Las Vegas for planning, incident postmortems, and team weeks.

**About the Role**


Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas. We are hiring a Senior Cloud / AWS Infrastructure Engineer to build, operate, and secure the AWS environment that runs our products.


The environment is AWS Organizations with Control Tower, accounts vended through Account Factory for Terraform, and governance applied through global and per\-account customization layers. Infrastructure is Terraform, delivered through a versioned in\-house module library. Workloads run across ECS Fargate, Aurora MySQL and PostgreSQL, ElastiCache, EFS, Lambda, OpenSearch, Redshift, MWAA, and Bedrock, with Cloudflare at the edge.


Disaster recovery. We are building cross\-region DR for a flagship platform, essentially from the ground up. Today the platform is regionally concentrated. You will define the DR plan against real RPO and RTO targets, design and build the replication and failover path, and prove it with real exercises.


Security engineering. Identity hardening, replacing static credentials with federated and role\-based access, extending preventive and detective controls, and turning findings into engineering fixes.

**Who Should Apply**

* Senior Cloud or Platform Engineers at consumer subscription, marketplace, or SaaS companies who have run AWS Organizations at scale.
* Site Reliability Engineers with a heavy IaC and security bias who have taken a regionally concentrated platform to cross\-region DR.
* DevOps Engineers from a Terraform\-first shop who own module libraries other teams depend on.
* Cloud Security Engineers who built the guardrails, the SCPs, and the federated access patterns their org runs on today.

**What You Will Do**

**Cloud Architecture and Infrastructure as Code**

* Extend the Terraform module library and the AFT customization layers (VPC and IPAM allocation, private hosted zones, SSM access, backup vaults, account baselines) so new accounts land secure and consistent by default.
* Design VPC architecture, cross\-account networking, and shared services in a hub\-and\-spoke configuration model.
* Migrate legacy brand infrastructure into the current account structure, state backend model, and module standards.

**Disaster Recovery**

* Design and build cross\-region recovery for a flagship platform: Aurora replication topology, cross\-region backup copy, S3 and EFS replication, container image distribution, DNS failover, and region\-parity IaC.
* Establish RPO and RTO targets with the business, map dependencies into recovery tiers, and define restoration order.
* Standardize backup policy and retention across the estate, including organization\-level backup policy and centralized vaults.
* Run scheduled DR tests and game days, and write runbooks that make recovery repeatable by anyone on call.

**Security**

* Design least\-privilege IAM policy and IAM Identity Center permission sets. Reduce standing access and direct assignments.
* Replace long\-lived IAM access keys with federated SSO, OIDC, and assumed\-role access, including in CI/CD.
* Author and maintain SCPs and organization controls, plus automated remediation where prevention is not possible.
* Extend detective controls: AWS Config rules and conformance packs, Security Hub standards coverage, GuardDuty feature coverage, and consistent finding handling across regions.
* Own secrets management on Secrets Manager and SSM Parameter Store, including rotation.
* Support incident response and CloudTrail forensics, and convert findings into durable engineering fixes.

**Reliability and Automation**

* Operate core infrastructure: monitoring, alerting, AWS Backup, and patch and lifecycle management.
* Improve our Prometheus, Grafana, and Alertmanager stack and its CloudWatch alarm coverage so real issues page quickly.
* Debug production issues across compute, storage, networking, and databases.
* Automate operational work in Python and Bash, and improve CI/CD for infrastructure.
* Keep Control Tower and the landing zone current, and contribute to cost visibility and optimization.

**Required Qualifications**

* Five or more years building and operating production AWS infrastructure.
* Strong Terraform in a team setting: module design and versioning, remote state, drift, and PR\-based workflows.
* Multi\-account AWS Organizations or Control Tower experience, including SCPs and cross\-account IAM.
* Deep IAM: policy and trust\-policy design, permission boundaries, and least privilege in practice.
* Production container experience on ECS or Kubernetes, and managed relational databases.
* Python or Bash for automation and tooling.
* Experience migrating or consolidating legacy infrastructure without downtime, and the judgment to sequence that work safely.
* Clear writing, and the judgment to weigh risk, cost, and delivery speed against each other.
* Daily use of Claude, Claude Code, and Cowork in your engineering workflow.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* AFT, Landing Zone Accelerator, or similar account\-vending automation.
* IAM Identity Center or SAML / OIDC federation with an external IdP.
* Designing and testing cross\-region DR against defined RPO and RTO targets.
* Aurora operations at scale: replication topology, failover, and backup and restore.
* Security Hub, GuardDuty, AWS Config, or SIEM\-style CloudTrail analysis. EDR tooling such as CrowdStrike.
* AWS Backup at organization scale, including cross\-region and cross\-account copy.
* Cloudflare or a comparable CDN and WAF at the edge.
* Data or AI workloads on AWS (Redshift, MWAA, Bedrock).
* Working with distributed teams across time zones.
* AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, SysOps, Security Specialty).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent operational track record.

**How We Work**

* Infrastructure is code, reviewed in pull requests.
* Human access to AWS is federated through SSO, short\-lived, and least privilege by default.
* Security, reliability, and cost are design inputs, not afterthoughts.
* We fix the cause rather than automate around it.
* Engineering work is tracked in Jira. Decisions and runbooks live in Confluence.

**Why This Role Matters**


Seeking.com serves more than 50 million members across more than 130 countries. The AWS environment behind that experience is what keeps the promise. This role is the senior engineer who makes sure a region\-wide event does not become a member\-facing event, and that our security posture matches the trust our members place in us. The work is consequential, the mandate is real, and the person who does it well earns more scope every quarter.

**Compensation and Benefits**


Base salary: $130,000 to $180,000, commensurate with experience.


99 percent coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance. 65 percent coverage for qualified dependents. 100 percent coverage of short\-term disability, long\-term disability, and life insurance. 50 percent 401(k) match up to 6 percent per month. Flexible Spending Account. Flexible paid time off. Professional development budget covering AWS certifications and conferences.

Candidates are encouraged to apply for qualified positions regardless of race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristics as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and the needs of the company. All offers of employment are contingent upon the completion of a full background and reference check.

title: Director, Brand & Integrated Marketing
description:
The Director of Brand \& Integrated Marketing will own MeUndies’ overall brand strategy and translate it into a cohesive marketing calendar, compelling campaigns, culturally relevant content, and consistent execution across every customer touchpoint. This leader will oversee the Brand and Social teams while owning integrated campaign planning, product\-launch briefing, content strategy, influencer and affiliate strategy, licensing marketing, and brand partnerships. This is not a role for someone who only develops high\-level strategy or manages agencies. We are looking for a hands\-on leader who can set the vision, write a strong brief, lead teams through execution, make decisions quickly, and measure what worked.
   

  

 This role will work closely with Creative, Growth, Retention, E\-commerce, Merchandising, Product, Wholesale, and Licensing to ensure the entire organization is working from one clear brand and commercial calendar.
   

  

****Please note that this is a hybrid position of 4 days/week in our Los Angeles office.****
**What You'll Do**
* Brand Strategy and Positioning
* Own and evolve the MeUndies brand strategy, positioning, voice, visual identity, and cultural point of view.
* Ensure the brand remains distinctive, relevant, emotionally resonant, and consistent across DTC, retail, wholesale, and licensed products.
* Translate company and commercial priorities into clear customer\-facing narratives.
* Maintain and evolve brand guidelines while ensuring teams and external partners apply them consistently.
* Protect long\-term brand equity while helping the company achieve near\-term revenue goals.


 Integrated Marketing Calendar
   

  

* Own the master MeUndies marketing calendar across product launches, promotions, seasonal moments, collaborations, licensing, retail, and cultural opportunities.
* Create one source of truth connecting Brand, Creative, Growth, Retention, E\-commerce, Merchandising, Product, and Wholesale.
* Lead cross\-functional planning meetings and ensure teams understand the objective, audience, message, deliverables, owners, deadlines, and success metrics for every major initiative.
* Identify calendar conflicts, missed opportunities, and resource constraints early.


 Campaigns and Product Launches
   

  

* Lead the end\-to\-end go\-to\-market process for major campaigns, product launches, collaborations, and licensed collections.
* Develop sharp, actionable briefs grounded in customer insight, business goals, channel needs, and a clear creative proposition.
* Ensure briefs include the audience, insight, objective, positioning, key message, deliverables, channel strategy, timing, budget, and measurement plan.
* Partner with Creative to develop concepts that are both brand\-building and commercially effective.
* Maintain launch readiness and hold cross\-functional teams accountable to deadlines and deliverables.


 Content and Social Strategy
   

  

* Own the integrated content strategy across organic social, campaigns, editorial, community, creators, partnerships, and emerging channels.
* Lead the Social team and establish clear channel roles, content pillars, publishing cadence, and platform\-specific strategies.
* Build a content engine that allows MeUndies to respond quickly to cultural moments without losing brand consistency.
* Balance polished campaign content with creator\-led, community\-driven, educational, entertaining, and conversion\-oriented content.
* Establish a disciplined testing and learning process for formats, messages, talent, and platforms.


 Influencer, Creator, and Affiliate Strategy
   

  

* Own the strategy for influencers, creators, ambassadors, affiliates, and other external brand advocates.
* Develop a clear approach to seeding, paid partnerships, long\-term creator relationships, performance affiliates, and brand ambassadors.
* Build programs that generate both culturally relevant content and measurable customer acquisition.
* Partner with Growth to define channel economics, attribution, testing budgets, and performance expectations.
* Identify creators and partners who authentically represent the MeUndies customer and brand values.


 Licensing, Collaborations, and Partnerships
   

  

* Lead the marketing strategy for entertainment licenses, collaborations, and strategic brand partnerships.
* Partner with Product, Merchandising, Creative, Legal, and licensors from concept through launch.
* Develop a balanced licensing calendar that can drive customer acquisition and revenue without overwhelming the core MeUndies brand.
* Identify new collaboration and partnership opportunities that expand cultural relevance, audience reach, and commercial potential.
* Ensure all licensed marketing meets partner requirements while still feeling unmistakably MeUndies.


 Consumer Insights and Cultural Relevance
   

  

* Build a strong understanding of the MeUndies customer through research, social listening, reviews, community feedback, competitive analysis, and performance data.
* Translate customer and cultural insights into actionable campaign, product, and content opportunities.
* Track cultural shifts, category trends, emerging platforms, and competitor activity.
* Serve as the internal voice of the customer and help teams understand what is changing in the market.


 Brand Communications and Community
   

  

* Partner with internal and external resources on PR, earned media, founder communications, events, and brand reputation.
* Develop strategies that deepen customer participation, advocacy, and community.
* Identify opportunities for experiential marketing, events, pop\-ups, and earned cultural moments.
* Help shape how MeUndies responds to sensitive cultural, customer, or reputational issues.


 Measurement and Hindsights
   

  

* Establish clear success metrics before every campaign and launch.
* Lead formal post\-launch hindsights that assess creative performance, channel performance, customer response, operational execution, and commercial results.
* Turn findings into specific changes for future campaigns instead of simply reporting results.
* Develop a brand\-health measurement framework covering awareness, consideration, sentiment, engagement, customer growth, and brand relevance.
* Partner with Growth and Finance to understand incrementality, return on marketing investment, and the relationship between brand activity and revenue.


 Leadership and Operations
   

  

* Lead, develop, and hold accountable the Brand and Social teams.
* Build clear workflows, decision rights, timelines, and standards for excellent execution.
* Manage relevant agencies, freelancers, creators, production partners, and brand budgets.
* Prioritize resources across competing initiatives and maintain a high bar for quality, speed, and accountability.
* Present strategies, plans, results, and recommendations to senior leadership.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* MeUndies operates from one clear and reliable integrated marketing calendar.
* Every major launch begins with a strong brief, launches on time, and concludes with a useful hindsight.
* The brand has a more recognizable and culturally relevant point of view.
* Social and content become more consistent, responsive, and commercially effective.
* Influencer and affiliate programs have clear strategies, economics, and measurement.
* Licensing and collaborations support both revenue growth and long\-term brand equity.
* Cross\-functional teams have clearer priorities, ownership, and deadlines.
* Brand investment is measured with the same discipline as performance marketing.


**What You Have**
* 8–12\+ years of brand, integrated marketing, or consumer marketing experience, ideally within a modern DTC, apparel, lifestyle, beauty, or consumer brand.
* Experience leading brand strategy and integrated campaigns across multiple channels.
* Demonstrated success building marketing calendars and launching products, collaborations, or licensed collections.
* Strong understanding of organic social, creators, influencers, affiliates, partnerships, and content development.
* Ability to connect brand\-building activity with commercial performance.
* Excellent briefing, storytelling, presentation, and written communication skills.
* Strong understanding of consumer insights, cultural trends, and modern customer behavior.
* Experience managing teams, agencies, budgets, and complex cross\-functional projects.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment with high expectations and limited bureaucracy.
* Willingness to work at both the strategic and executional levels.


**The base salary range for this full\-time position is $125,000\-$150,000\. Within this range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the base salary range provided in this posting does not include any bonus, equity, or benefits you may be eligible for.**
****WHY WORK AT MEUNDIES?****
****It's more than a job.****
 We have focused on building a team of people who emulate our core values. We look for people who stay balanced, go further, build relationships, champion differences, and are humble. At MeUndies, we continue to maintain a stellar brand by working collaboratively and encouraging growth with learning opportunities. There is no such thing as a small achievement here \- we celebrate it all!
   

  

****We look at the necessities.****
 We offer competitive salary packages, including targeted annual bonuses, generous parental leave, a 401k, fantastic health benefits, open time off, and more.
   

  

****We have an office you’ll enjoy going to.****
 We work in our office Monday \- Thursday. Friday is a remote/work\-from\-home day. We’re set up to support comfortable working \- hot desks, lounge, and casual seating areas, a Mother’s Room, an on\-site gym \& shower, and a kitchen that makes you feel like you’ve never left home. We’re dog\-friendly, so your furry coworker can join you anytime.
   

  

****We don’t forget the most important things.****
 We want MeUndies to be a place where you feel safe and comfortable, and we encourage our employees to hold us accountable for keeping it that way. We encourage open communication and a People Ops team that is ready to help. When you work at MeUndies, we take your needs as an employee (and a person) seriously. Our doors are always welcome to feedback and suggestions!

 We also know how important it is to connect with your team members outside of everyday work. We offer catered lunches every in\-office day, holiday parties, off\-sites, happy hours, and an annual retreat. You’ll also get a sweet employee discount to rebuild your underwear drawer with our top\-notch prints.

**Director of Brand Marketing**

 Four days in office, one day remote

 Electric Picks is a rapidly growing jewelry brand known for trend\-forward styles, meaningful storytelling, and a lifetime guarantee. We’re entering an exciting new chapter and looking for a Director of Brand Marketing who can help define what the brand becomes next.
 



  





 This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of an established brand with significant momentum. You’ll work closely with our Head of Marketing, Founder, and Senior Art Director to translate our vision into campaigns, collaborations, cultural moments, and consumer experiences that grow both brand affinity and the business.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




  





 The Director of Brand Marketing, will lead how Electric Picks shows up in the world.
 



 You’ll set the strategic direction while remaining close to the work—from developing campaign concepts and go\-to\-market plans to building partnerships, creating real\-world experiences, and shaping our social presence.
 



  





 This is a unique opportunity for someone who is looking build the next big lifestyle brand. If you have strong ideas, commercial instincts, and the ability to turn vision into action this role is for you.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 




  





**Shape the Brand** 




  




* Partner with the Head of Marketing and Senior Art Director to define and evolve the Electric Picks brand strategy.
* Translate company priorities into integrated marketing plans that build awareness, attract new customers, and drive revenue.
* Identify opportunities to increase cultural relevance through positioning, storytelling, partnerships, activations, and community.
* Bring consumer insights, cultural trends, and competitive intelligence into the brand’s decision\-making.

* Lead integrated campaign planning across eCommerce, Social, CRM, PR, Wholesale, and Paid Media.
* Ensure every campaign has clear objectives, channel roles, timelines, and measures of success.



  





**Create Cultural Moments** 




  




* Lead experiential events, community activations, influencer trips, OOH, partnerships, and other real\-world brand experiences.
* Partner with the Founder to identify and develop talent, brand, and cultural collaborations.
* Build a strategic pipeline of UGC and commissioned content that supports both organic storytelling and paid acquisition.
* Find new ways for Electric Picks to participate in culture and connect meaningfully with its community.



  





**Lead the Team and the Work** 




  




* Manage, mentor, and develop members of the Brand Marketing and Social teams.
* Shape the brand’s social presence so that every touchpoint reflects a consistent voice, point of view, and personality.
* Serve as the central marketing partner across Creative, Growth, eCommerce, PR, Product, and Wholesale.
* Establish clear priorities, ownership, and expectations across the team.
* Build scalable workflows and planning tools that improve clarity, accountability, and execution.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, curiosity, high standards, and strong follow\-through.



  





**What You’ll Bring** 




  




* 6\+ years of brand marketing experience, ideally within fashion, jewelry, beauty, lifestyle, luxury, or another consumer\-led category.
* A track record of developing integrated campaigns that increased awareness, created demand, and supported business growth.
* Strong instincts for storytelling, culture, partnerships, events, community, and consumer behavior.
* Experience translating business priorities into cohesive omnichannel marketing plans.
* The ability to move comfortably between strategy, creative development, planning, and hands\-on execution.
* Strong cross\-functional leadership skills and experience partnering with Creative, Growth, Digital, PR, Product, and Commercial teams.
* Experience managing and developing high\-performing team members.
* Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Commercial fluency and the ability to balance creative ambition with budgets, timelines, and measurable results.



  





**You’ll Thrive Here If You Are** 




  




* A brand builder who is excited by the opportunity to help define the next chapter of a growing company.
* A strategic operator who can see the big picture and translate it into a clear, actionable plan.
* A creative thinker with strong taste, cultural curiosity, and a distinct point of view.
* A hands\-on leader who is willing to jump into the work and help move it forward.
* A natural owner who identifies opportunities, solves problems, and creates momentum.
* A clear and thoughtful communicator who brings people together around a shared vision.
* A low\-ego, high\-EQ collaborator who knows when to lead, support, and execute.
* A mentor who raises the quality of thinking and execution across the team.



  





**Why Electric Picks** 




  





 You’ll join Electric Picks at a pivotal moment, with the opportunity to influence the brand’s long\-term vision while making an immediate impact. You’ll work closely with senior leadership, lead high\-visibility initiatives, and help build the campaigns, experiences, team, and operating foundation that support our next stage of growth.
